chinese_summary.innovation: 首次将音乐问答与描述生成统一到一个模型中，以增强音乐理解能力并服务文本到音乐生成；专门构建了面向开放式音乐问答的 MusicQA 数据集，填补了相关资源空白；模型在音乐问答和描述生成两个任务上均取得优于现有 SOTA 的表现。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要中声明实验表明 MU-LLaMA 在音乐问答和音乐描述生成的多个评估指标上超越了当前 SOTA 模型，但未列出具体指标名称或对比模型。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未直接验证模型对文本到音乐生成任务的提升效果；MusicQA 数据集的构造质量和多样性需要阅读全文确认；模型在多样化音乐场景下的泛化能力和训练细节尚未披露。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文聚焦音乐信息检索中的理解任务（问答和描述），采用了自监督音频表征模型 MERT，与我的研究方向“音乐信息检索与表征学习”“自监督音频表征”等关键词直接匹配，其利用音乐编码器进行下游任务的思路具有参考价值。

papers.title: A Survey on Audio Diffusion Models: Text To Speech Synthesis and Enhancement in Generative AI
papers.summary: Generative AI has demonstrated impressive performance in various fields, among which speech synthesis is an interesting direction. With the diffusion model as the most popular generative model, numerous works have attempted two active tasks: text to speech and speech enhancement. This work conducts a survey on audio diffusion model, which is complementary to existing surveys that either lack the recent progress of diffusion-based speech synthesis or highlight an overall picture of applying diffusion model in multiple fields. Specifically, this work first briefly introduces the background of audio and diffusion model. As for the text-to-speech task, we divide the methods into three categories based on the stage where diffusion model is adopted: acoustic model, vocoder and end-to-end framework. Moreover, we categorize various speech enhancement tasks by either certain signals are removed or added into the input speech. Comparisons of experimental results and discussions are also covered in this survey.
papers.justification: 全面综述扩散模型在TTS和语音增强中的应用，对生成式语音技术研究者具有重要参考价值，是了解该领域的必读文献之一。

chinese_summary.problem: 该综述旨在系统整理扩散模型在文本到语音和语音增强中的最新应用，弥补现有综述在扩散语音合成上的进展缺失。
chinese_summary.method: 采用分类综述框架：将文本到语音方法按扩散模型使用阶段分为声学模型、声码器和端到端框架；将语音增强按去除或添加特定信号分类；同时收集并比较各方法的实验结果。
chinese_summary.innovation: 区别于已有跨领域或较早的综述，本文专注于扩散模型在语音合成与增强两大核心任务上的应用，提供了面向TTS流水线各阶段的细粒度分类，并整合了最新的实验对比。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要中明确提及包含实验结果的比较与讨论，但未列出具体指标或方法。
chinese_summary.limitations: 综述范围限于TTS和语音增强，未涵盖其他生成式语音任务（如语音转换、带宽扩展）；分类粒度可能较粗；具体技术实现细节需阅读全文进一步确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 研究方向聚焦生成式语音技术，关键词包括语音合成、TTS、神经声码器、生成式语音增强、扩散模型语音；本文直接覆盖这些主题，提供领域全面概览，有助于快速定位相关工作和评估方法进展。

papers.title: An Investigation of Incorporating Mamba For Speech Enhancement
papers.summary: This work aims to investigate the use of a recently proposed, attention-free, scalable state-space model (SSM), Mamba, for the speech enhancement (SE) task. In particular, we employ Mamba to deploy different regression-based SE models (SEMamba) with different configurations, namely basic, advanced, causal, and non-causal. Furthermore, loss functions either based on signal-level distances or metric-oriented are considered. Experimental evidence shows that SEMamba attains a competitive PESQ of 3.55 on the VoiceBank-DEMAND dataset with the advanced, non-causal configuration. A new state-of-the-art PESQ of 3.69 is also reported when SEMamba is combined with Perceptual Contrast Stretching (PCS). Compared against Transformed-based equivalent SE solutions, a noticeable FLOPs reduction up to $\sim 12 \%$ is observed with the advanced non-causal configurations. Finally, SEMamba can be used as a pre-processing step before automatic speech recognition (ASR), showing competitive performance against recent SE solutions.
papers.justification: 该工作首次将Mamba状态空间模型引入语音增强，提出SEMamba架构，在VoiceBank-DEMAND上取得先进PESQ且比Transformer降低计算量，与语音增强方向高度相关，具备成为基础性方法的潜力，引用数较高，是值得关注的重要工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 探索如何将无注意力机制的状态空间模型 Mamba 应用于语音增强任务，并评估不同配置下的性能。
chinese_summary.method: 采用 Mamba 构建回归式语音增强模型 SEMamba，包含基础、高级及因果/非因果等多种配置，配合信号级距离损失和度量导向损失进行训练。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次将 Mamba 引入语音增强领域；在 VoiceBank-DEMAND 数据集上，非因果高级配置取得竞争性 PESQ 3.55，结合感知对比拉伸后达到 3.69 的新高水平；相比 Transformer 方法，计算量（FLOPs）减少约 12%。
chinese_summary.evidence: 实验证据：在 VoiceBank-DEMAND 上，先进非因果配置 PESQ 3.55，结合 PCS 后 PESQ 3.69；FLOPs 较 Transformer 方案降低约 12%；作为 ASR 预处理步骤表现具有竞争力。
chinese_summary.limitations: 仅在 VoiceBank-DEMAND 数据集上验证，泛化性未知；因果配置的实时性能未详细给出；与多种前沿增强方法的全面对比尚不充分。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 研究方向为语音增强与音频前端，该论文直接针对语音增强任务，所提方法可用于去噪、降噪等场景，且采用神经网络模型，与研究方向中的关键词 speech enhancement、noise reduction、neural masking 等高度匹配。

papers.title: GibbsDDRM: A Partially Collapsed Gibbs Sampler for Solving Blind Inverse Problems with Denoising Diffusion Restoration
papers.summary: Pre-trained diffusion models have been successfully used as priors in a variety of linear inverse problems, where the goal is to reconstruct a signal from noisy linear measurements. However, existing approaches require knowledge of the linear operator. In this paper, we propose GibbsDDRM, an extension of Denoising Diffusion Restoration Models (DDRM) to a blind setting in which the linear measurement operator is unknown. GibbsDDRM constructs a joint distribution of the data, measurements, and linear operator by using a pre-trained diffusion model for the data prior, and it solves the problem by posterior sampling with an efficient variant of a Gibbs sampler. The proposed method is problem-agnostic, meaning that a pre-trained diffusion model can be applied to various inverse problems without fine-tuning. In experiments, it achieved high performance on both blind image deblurring and vocal dereverberation tasks, despite the use of simple generic priors for the underlying linear operators.
papers.justification: 提出GibbsDDRM，将扩散先验扩展至盲逆问题，成功用于语音去混响，对生成式语音增强方向具有重要基础性和影响力。

chinese_summary.problem: 解决盲线性逆问题，即在测量算子未知的情况下，利用预训练扩散模型作为先验，从噪声线性测量中重建信号（如图像去模糊、语音解混响）。
chinese_summary.method: 提出GibbsDDRM，将去噪扩散恢复模型（DDRM）扩展到盲设置。通过构建数据、测量和线性算子的联合分布，使用预训练扩散模型作为数据先验，并采用一种高效的部分塌陷Gibbs采样器进行后验采样，从而实现问题无关的求解。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次将DDRM框架扩展至盲逆问题，无需已知线性算子；采用部分塌陷Gibbs采样策略，有效进行联合后验推断；方法具有通用性，同一预训练扩散模型可直接应用于不同逆问题而无需微调。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要在盲图像去模糊和语音解混响两个任务上报告了高性能表现，且仅使用了简单的通用算子先验。
chinese_summary.limitations: 仅验证了两种任务，对更复杂的退化类型（如非高斯噪声或高度非结构化算子）的有效性未知；未提及计算效率或采样步数；需要阅读全文确认Gibbs采样的稳定性和与现有盲逆求解器的对比细节。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文将扩散模型应用于语音解混响，属于生成式语音增强/恢复的范畴，与研究方向中的‘diffusion model speech’、‘speech restoration’和‘generative speech enhancement’直接匹配。尽管方法通用，但语音任务是主要验证场景之一，可为扩散模型在语音逆问题中的应用提供参考。

papers.title: Dense-Sparse Dynamic Time Warping for Customizing Piano Concerto Accompaniments
papers.summary: In this study, we explore how pianists can customize Music Minus One (MMO) concerto accompaniments to match their playing style. Bypassing the need for a symbolic score, often not available digitally, we use three types of audio data: solo piano recordings, MMO orchestra-only recordings, and mixed recordings of both piano and orchestra (e.g., from YouTube). The mixed recording serves as an intermediary reference to align the solo and orchestra parts, with only the orchestral part being adjusted through time-scale modification to synchronize with the user's playing. The main challenge with estimating these alignments is the spectral mismatch between recordings containing different musical parts. Motivated by this application scenario, we introduce Dense-Sparse DTW, a variant of Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) that is designed to improve robustness of alignments to spectral mismatch by focusing on aligning a selected subset of audio frames containing prominent timing cues. We collect and annotate data from four piano concerto movements and establish a framework for generating and evaluating customized accompaniment recordings. On this benchmark, we show that Dense-Sparse DTW has better or comparable performance than more complex approaches based on source separation and spectral subtraction techniques.
papers.topic_name: Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction
papers.justification: 该论文提出Dense-Sparse DTW解决钢琴协奏曲音频对齐中的频谱不匹配问题，属于音乐信息检索与对齐，与我的MIR方向高度相关，在四个乐章上验证性能优于源分离等复杂方法，质量扎实。

chinese_summary.problem: 如何在缺少数字乐谱的情况下，使钢琴家能够根据个人演奏风格定制管弦乐伴奏，通过音频对齐实现时间同步。
chinese_summary.method: 提出 Dense-Sparse DTW 算法，一种动态时间规整变体，通过仅选择包含显著时间线索的音频帧子集进行对齐，减少因不同声部录音造成的频谱不匹配影响；利用混合录音作为中介参考，对管弦乐部分进行时间尺度修改以匹配用户独奏。
chinese_summary.innovation: 引入 Dense-Sparse DTW，避免对整个序列进行全对齐，仅关注关键时间帧，提升频谱不匹配下的对齐鲁棒性；无需依赖源分离或频谱减法等复杂预处理；利用易于获取的混合录音（如 YouTube 音频）作为对齐参照，简化定制流程。
chinese_summary.evidence: 收集并标注四个钢琴协奏曲乐章数据，建立评估框架，实验表明 Dense-Sparse DTW 性能优于或可比基于源分离和频谱减法的方法。
chinese_summary.limitations: 仅在钢琴协奏曲上验证，泛化到其他乐器或场景需确认；依赖用户提供的独奏录音和对应的混合录音，实际获取可能不便；关键帧选择策略可能影响对齐效果。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 关键词命中“source separation”，但论文仅将其作为对比方法，自身不研究源分离；核心是音频对齐和时间规整，与语音分离、目标说话人提取方向差异显著，匹配度低。

papers.title: Harness TTS: Towards Context-Aware Expressive Speech Synthesis with Harness Layer
papers.summary: Expressive speech synthesis for voice assistants requires flexible style control that adapts to explicit requests and broader interaction context. We propose Harness TTS, a lightweight control layer that wraps around a TTS engine to externalize and govern its expressive behavior. It reformulates style control as closed-set prompt-tool routing: offline, a compact registry of stylistic prompt tools is constructed with structured metadata; online, an LLM planner selects the appropriate tool based on a priority-aware observation schema, and the TTS executor synthesizes speech using the corresponding prompt audio. We evaluate Harness TTS on both routing and synthesis tasks. In routing, Qwen3-4B achieves Top-1 accuracies of 74.3%, 43.0%, and 64.6% on explicit, implicit, and conflict subsets. For synthesis, experiments on CosyVoice3 and VoxCPM2 show that Harness TTS outperforms instruction-only control, achieving higher instruction-following win rates (margins of 23.1-35.6 points on CosyVoice3 and 13.8-20.0 points on VoxCPM2) and improving UTMOSv2 scores by 0.11-0.38. Moreover, the 4B planner delivers its first tool recommendation in under 50 ms in standard mode, introducing negligible latency for real-time interaction. These results demonstrate that equipping TTS engines with a dedicated Harness layer offers a practical, auditable, and context-aware solution for voice assistant expression control.
papers.justification: 提出Harness层实现上下文感知的TTS表现力控制，通过LLM路由选择提示工具，在语音合成质量与指令遵循上取得提升，与生成语音技术方向高度相关，工作扎实。

chinese_summary.problem: 语音助手中的表达性语音合成需要根据显式指令和交互上下文灵活调整风格，但现有TTS引擎缺乏轻量级、可审计的上下文感知风格控制机制。
chinese_summary.method: 提出Harness TTS，一个包裹在TTS引擎外的轻量级控制层。将风格控制转化为闭集提示工具路由：离线构建带有结构化元数据的风格工具注册表，在线由LLM规划器根据优先感知观察模式选择工具，TTS执行器使用对应提示音频进行合成。
chinese_summary.innovation: 将表达控制外部化为可审计的Harness层，无需修改TTS内核；将风格选择建模为闭集工具路由问题，结合LLM规划器实现上下文感知决策；以<50ms延迟实现实时交互，适用于语音助手实际场景。
chinese_summary.evidence: 路由实验：Qwen3-4B在显式、隐式、冲突子集上Top-1准确率分别为74.3%、43.0%、64.6%。合成实验：在CosyVoice3和VoxCPM2上，指令遵循胜率领先23.1-35.6和13.8-20.0个百分点，UTMOSv2提高0.11-0.38。延迟：首次工具推荐<50ms。
chinese_summary.limitations: 隐式上下文子集准确率仅43.0%，复杂场景理解可能不足；依赖预定义的风格工具注册表，不支持开放集风格；未验证对多种TTS引擎的通用性，以及长对话历史下的延迟和效果。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接研究TTS系统的表达性风格控制，与研究方向中的语音合成、文本转语音密切匹配，提供了一种结合LLM与TTS的实用框架，对生成式语音技术应用开发有参考价值。但侧重控制层面而非生成模型算法，需读者判断是否深入。

papers.title: Towards Array-Invariant Speech Enhancement via Geometry-Aware Dynamic Convolution
papers.summary: Multi-channel speech enhancement (SE) systems exhibit superior performance over single-channel methods but are constrained to fixed microphone array configurations. This restricts their real-world deployment across devices with diverse array geometries. While recent array-agnostic SE methods address variable microphone numbers and permutations, they largely fail to exploit explicit array geometry priors when available, missing a crucial cue for optimal spatial filtering. A Geometry-Aware Dynamic Convolution (Geo-DConv) framework is proposed, which explicitly leverages microphone coordinates to transform standard fixed-array SE models into robust array-invariant systems. Experiments are conducted on the recent real-recorded RealMAN multi-channel speech dataset. Results demonstrate that the proposed architecture enables two widely used fixed-array models to adapt to array-invariant settings, with consistent performance improvements across diverse array topologies.
papers.justification: 提出几何感知动态卷积实现阵列不变语音增强，充分利用麦克风坐标先验改进空间滤波，与麦克风阵列与波束形成方向高度相关，质量扎实。

chinese_summary.problem: 多通道语音增强系统受限于固定麦克风阵列配置，难以跨不同阵列几何的设备部署；现有阵列无关方法未充分利用阵列几何先验，导致空间滤波最优性缺失。
chinese_summary.method: 提出几何感知动态卷积（Geo-DConv）框架，以麦克风坐标为显式输入，通过动态卷积生成自适应权重，将标准固定阵列语音增强模型转换为阵列不变系统，使其能够泛化至任意阵列拓扑。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次显式利用麦克风几何坐标作为空间先验，弥补了阵列无关方法在最优空间滤波上的短板；通过动态卷积实现模型参数随阵列配置的动态调整，无需重新训练即可适配新阵列；在真实录音数据集上验证了将固定阵列模型改造为阵列不变系统的可行性与有效性。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在RealMAN真实多通道语音数据集上进行实验，两个广泛使用的固定阵列模型采用所提架构后，在不同阵列拓扑上均取得一致性能提升；摘要未提供具体数值指标或消融实验细节。
chinese_summary.limitations: 仅验证两个固定阵列模型，泛化性有待更多模型检验；依赖精确麦克风坐标，实际应用中坐标标定误差的影响未讨论；动态卷积的计算开销和实现细节未提及；仅在单一数据集上评估，复杂声学场景下的鲁棒性未知。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文聚焦多通道语音增强中的空间滤波，利用阵列几何信息提升阵列不变性，与我的研究方向“麦克风阵列与波束形成”高度契合，尤其在神经波束形成、空间特征利用和多通道语音增强方面有直接交集，其动态卷积方法为可学习空间滤波提供新思路。

papers.title: Staged Depth-Pruning Distillation of a Flow-Matching Text-to-Speech Teacher: A Compact Hindi Speech Synthesizer
papers.summary: We present a practical recipe for building a compact Hindi text-to-speech (TTS) model by distilling a large flow-matching teacher (IndicF5, 337M-parameter DiT) under a severe data budget (~17.6 hours). Training a small model from scratch on this much data fails outright. Instead we warm-start the student from the teacher by pruning depth only: keeping the teacher's width, text dimension, attention heads, and mel/text I/O fixed so all non-block tensors copy one-to-one, and retaining an evenly-spaced subset of transformer blocks. We first measure how much depth the teacher tolerates (it remains near-functional at -27% blocks but collapses past -50%), then descend gradually (22 -> 16 -> 12 -> 8 -> 6 blocks), re-fine-tuning after each prune, with each step gated by an objective ASR word-error-rate (WER) check. The resulting students reach WER 0.00 on unseen sentences at 249M and 190M parameters, and remain robust down to 131M; at 102M we observe a clear capacity cliff that we attribute to the data budget rather than the recipe. We also document two train/inference feature- and library-parity failures (mel filterbank and rotary-embedding library versions) that silently degrade audio, and a version-independent fix. The method yields a high-quality Hindi voice that runs in real time on a 6 GB laptop GPU. An independent 50-sentence FLEURS benchmark compares the released 190M student against its teacher and MMS-TTS-hin.
papers.justification: 该工作使用深度剪枝蒸馏紧凑化流匹配TTS模型，属于生成式语音技术，与研究方向相关，在数据受限下获得实用合成器，质量扎实但方法新颖性一般。

chinese_summary.problem: 在数据极度受限（约17.6小时）下构建紧凑的印地语TTS模型，解决从头训练小模型会失败的问题。
chinese_summary.method: 分阶段深度剪枝蒸馏：以流匹配大模型（IndicF5, 337M参数DiT）为教师，通过仅剪枝Transformer块深度（保留宽度和所有非块张量一对一复制）初始化学生模型；逐步减少块数（22→16→12→8→6），每次剪枝后微调，并以ASR词错误率（WER）为门控指标；同时发现并修复了因mel滤波器组和旋转嵌入库版本不匹配导致的音频质量退化。
chinese_summary.innovation: （1）在极低数据预算下，利用深度剪枝蒸馏成功压缩流匹配TTS模型，避免从头训练失败；（2）采用渐进式剪枝与WER检查，确定容量悬崖（102M参数时退化归因于数据量而非方法）；（3）识别并提供了库版本不匹配导致音频质量下降的通用修复方案。
chinese_summary.evidence: 实验显示学生模型在未见句子上达到WER 0.00（249M和190M参数），131M保持鲁棒，102M出现性能悬崖；发布的190M模型在6GB笔记本GPU上实时运行，并在FLEURS基准上与教师模型和MMS-TTS-hin对比。
chinese_summary.limitations: 仅针对印地语，数据规模小，泛化性未验证；依赖ASR WER而缺乏主观音质评价；容量悬崖的界限可能与特定数据分布相关。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文核心为流匹配文本到语音生成，直接匹配研究方向中的“text-to-speech”、“flow matching speech”和“speech synthesis”。但侧重于模型压缩而非生成模型创新或增强/恢复应用，与生成式语音增强、语音恢复等关联较弱，建议人工复核以确定对生成技术本身的参考价值。

papers.title: CS-ETS: Chaos-Inspired Samba-Based EMG-To-Speech Synthesis with Nonlinear Chaotic Losses
papers.summary: We propose a chaos-inspired new architecture for EMG-to-Speech (ETS) synthesis called CS-ETS, which combines a Samba-based encoder with two novel chaos-inspired loss functions -- Lyapunov Exponent Regularization (LER) and Multi-Scale Detrended Fluctuation Analysis (MSDFA). LER is designed based on Lyapunov exponents to capture nonlinear fluctuations and sensitivity to initial conditions. MSDFA exploits detrended fluctuation analysis to quantify fractal-like, long-range temporal chaotic correlation. CS-ETS surpasses prior work with a 40.79\% lower parameter count (32M vs 54.1M) and introduces a new Post-Vocoder Alignment approach that improves LSD by 2.1x, STOI by 4.7x, and SI-SDR by 1.25x. CS-ETS reduces computation by 13.33\% while maintaining improved performance. To the best of our knowledge, for the first time, we show how ETS can be supervised by the subtle non-linear chaotic physics with Samba attention to achieve a significantly smaller model with superior performance.
papers.justification: 论文提出混沌启发式损失函数的EMG-to-Speech合成方法，属于生成语音技术中的语音合成方向，方法新颖且指标提升显著，但EMG输入非主流音频前端任务，与核心语音增强/分离相关性有限。

chinese_summary.problem: 从表面肌电信号直接合成可懂语音，解决现有EMG-to-Speech模型参数量大、对非线性动力学建模不足的问题。
chinese_summary.method: 提出CS-ETS架构，采用Samba注意力编码器提取EMG特征，并设计两个混沌启发的损失函数：李雅普诺夫指数正则化（LER）捕捉非线性波动和初值敏感性，多尺度去趋势波动分析（MSDFA）量化长程分形相关；推理时使用Post-Vocoder Alignment后处理改善合成语音的客观质量。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次将混沌物理约束引入EMG-to-Speech训练的损失函数，利用LER和MSDFA捕捉肌电信号的非线性动力学；采用轻量化Samba编码器并结合后声码器对齐策略，在参数量和计算量显著降低的同时提升语音质量。
chinese_summary.evidence: 参数减少40.79%（32M vs 54.1M），LSD改善2.1倍，STOI改善4.7倍，SI-SDR改善1.25倍，计算量降低13.33%。
chinese_summary.limitations: 未提及具体数据集、对比基线方法、混沌损失的计算开销及不同声码器的兼容性，后处理对齐的实时性待确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 涉及语音合成（EMG-to-Speech）和声码器后处理，与研究方向中的'speech synthesis'关键词直接匹配，但非典型TTS或生成式语音增强，而是生物信号到语音的跨模态生成，需要人工确认是否关注此类特殊输入方式。

papers.title: Metis: A Foundation Speech Generation Model with Masked Generative Pre-training
papers.summary: We introduce Metis, a foundation model for unified speech generation. Unlike previous task-specific or multi-task models, Metis follows a pre-training and fine-tuning paradigm. It is pre-trained on large-scale unlabeled speech data using masked generative modeling and then fine-tuned to adapt to diverse speech generation tasks. Specifically, 1) Metis utilizes two discrete speech representations: SSL tokens derived from speech self-supervised learning (SSL) features, and acoustic tokens directly quantized from waveforms. 2) Metis performs masked generative pre-training on SSL tokens, utilizing 300K hours of diverse speech data, without any additional condition. 3) Through fine-tuning with task-specific conditions, Metis achieves efficient adaptation to various speech generation tasks while supporting multimodal input, even when using limited data and trainable parameters. Experiments demonstrate that Metis can serve as a foundation model for unified speech generation: Metis outperforms state-of-the-art task-specific or multi-task systems across five speech generation tasks, including zero-shot text-to-speech, voice conversion, target speaker extraction, speech enhancement, and lip-to-speech, even with fewer than 20M trainable parameters or 300 times less training data. Audio samples are are available at https://metis-demo.github.io/.
papers.topic_name: Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction
papers.justification: 提出统一语音生成基础模型Metis，通过掩码生成预训练实现目标说话人提取和语音增强等多任务SOTA，与生成式语音及分离增强方向高度相关。

chinese_summary.problem: 构建统一的语音生成基础模型，通过预训练和微调范式适应多种语音生成任务，而非专门针对目标说话人提取。
chinese_summary.method: 利用大规模无标签语音数据，对语音自监督学习（SSL）特征离散化后的SSL令牌进行掩码生成预训练；微调时结合任务特定条件（如说话人嵌入、文本、视觉等），将预训练模型高效迁移到下游语音生成任务，包括目标说话人提取。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次将掩码生成预训练范式应用于统一语音生成，使用离散SSL令牌作为中间表征；仅使用300K小时无标签数据预训练，并在五种语音生成任务上通过轻量微调（参数少于20M或数据量减少300倍）超过现有专门或多任务系统；支持多模态输入条件，实现高效任务切换。
chinese_summary.evidence: 实验覆盖零样本文本到语音、语音转换、目标说话人提取、语音增强和唇语到语音五个任务，均声称性能优于已有最优系统；但摘要未提供具体指标、对比对象或实验设置细节，可核验性有限。
chinese_summary.limitations: 掩码生成模型在语音生成中的具体架构（如是否采用非自回归生成）、目标说话人提取任务中的条件机制（如何提供说话人参考信号）未知；预训练数据域的泛化能力未讨论；生成式TSE与传统基于掩码的分离思路差异较大，可能不适用于某些分离场景。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 命中关键词'target speaker extraction'和'speaker extraction'，论文将其作为下游任务之一并取得声称的SOTA，但核心贡献在于生成式预训练框架，并非针对语音分离或提取的设计，且未涉及掩码、双路径网络等用户关注的方法。建议人工复核以确认生成式TSE是否契合研究方向。

papers.title: TS-SEP: Joint Diarization and Separation Conditioned on Estimated Speaker Embeddings
papers.summary: Since diarization and source separation of meeting data are closely related tasks, we here propose an approach to perform the two objectives jointly. It builds upon the target-speaker voice activity detection (TS-VAD) diarization approach, which assumes that initial speaker embeddings are available. We replace the final combined speaker activity estimation network of TS-VAD with a network that produces speaker activity estimates at a time-frequency resolution. Those act as masks for source extraction, either via masking or via beamforming. The technique can be applied both for single-channel and multi-channel input and, in both cases, achieves a new state-of-the-art word error rate (WER) on the LibriCSS meeting data recognition task. We further compute speaker-aware and speaker-agnostic WERs to isolate the contribution of diarization errors to the overall WER performance.
categories: IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio Speech and Language Processing
papers.venue: IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio Speech and Language Processing
papers.topic_name: Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction
papers.justification: 提出联合说话人日志和分离的TS-SEP方法，基于估计的说话人嵌入实现掩码或波束形成，在LibriCSS上获得SOTA WER，高度匹配目标说话人提取方向，是近期有影响力的工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 针对会议音频中说话人分离（diarization）和源分离（separation）通常分开处理的问题，提出联合执行两项任务以提升分离和识别性能。
chinese_summary.method: 基于 TS-VAD 框架，假设已有初始说话人嵌入，将原始 TS-VAD 末端说话人活动估计网络替换为可输出时频分辨率活动估计的网络，再将其作为掩蔽或波束成形系数进行源提取，支持单通道与多通道输入。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次将说话人日志和源分离进行深度联合建模，用一个网络同时输出说话人活动估计和掩蔽/波束成形系数；无需独立分离模块，直接端到端优化下游识别任务；在 LibriCSS 会议数据上取得当前最佳识别性能。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在 LibriCSS 会议识别任务上取得新的 SOTA 词错误率（WER），并通过计算 speaker-aware 和 speaker-agnostic WER 分析了日志错误对识别的影响。
chinese_summary.limitations: 方法依赖预先提供的说话人嵌入，嵌入质量对结果影响未阐明；仅在 LibriCSS 数据集上验证，通用性未知；联合训练的细节和计算开销未提及；作为扩展 TS-VAD 的工作，创新点侧重于架构修改而非基础分离机理。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 摘要中包含了 'source separation' 和 'masking' 关键词，与研究方向中的语音分离和掩蔽方法部分相关；其基于说话人嵌入的提取方式类似目标说话人提取，但论文重心在联合日志任务，分离技术仅为组成部分，实际分离方法的创新性需阅读全文确认，因此初步判定为低位相关。

papers.title: MaskGCT: Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech with Masked Generative Codec Transformer
papers.summary: The recent large-scale text-to-speech (TTS) systems are usually grouped as autoregressive and non-autoregressive systems. The autoregressive systems implicitly model duration but exhibit certain deficiencies in robustness and lack of duration controllability. Non-autoregressive systems require explicit alignment information between text and speech during training and predict durations for linguistic units (e.g. phone), which may compromise their naturalness. In this paper, we introduce Masked Generative Codec Transformer (MaskGCT), a fully non-autoregressive TTS model that eliminates the need for explicit alignment information between text and speech supervision, as well as phone-level duration prediction. MaskGCT is a two-stage model: in the first stage, the model uses text to predict semantic tokens extracted from a speech self-supervised learning (SSL) model, and in the second stage, the model predicts acoustic tokens conditioned on these semantic tokens. MaskGCT follows the mask-and-predict learning paradigm. During training, MaskGCT learns to predict masked semantic or acoustic tokens based on given conditions and prompts. During inference, the model generates tokens of a specified length in a parallel manner. Experiments with 100K hours of in-the-wild speech demonstrate that MaskGCT outperforms the current state-of-the-art zero-shot TTS systems in terms of quality, similarity, and intelligibility. Audio samples are available at https://maskgct.github.io/. We release our code and model checkpoints at https://github.com/open-mmlab/Amphion/blob/main/models/tts/maskgct.
papers.justification: 该工作提出MaskGCT，一个无需显式对齐的全非自回归零样本TTS模型，采用掩码预测范式，在10万小时数据上达到领先性能，是生成式语音技术领域的必读基础工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 现有TTS系统分为自回归和非自回归两类：自回归模型缺乏时长可控性和鲁棒性，非自回归模型需要显式文本-语音对齐和音素级时长预测，可能影响自然度。本文旨在解决零样本TTS中无需显式对齐和时长预测的问题。
chinese_summary.method: 提出MaskGCT，一种完全非自回归的两阶段掩码生成式编解码器Transformer。第一阶段根据文本预测语音自监督模型提取的语义令牌，第二阶段以语义令牌为条件预测声学令牌。整个模型采用掩码预测范式训练，推理时并行生成指定长度的令牌序列。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次在零样本TTS中完全移除对显式文本-语音对齐和音素时长预测的依赖；使用掩码生成式Transformer直接在语音令牌上建模，无需自回归或并行时长预估；在10万小时野生语音数据上训练，达到SOTA性能。
chinese_summary.evidence: 实验基于100K小时in-the-wild语音，在质量、相似度和清晰度指标上均超过现有最先进零样本TTS系统。提供了音频样本和开源代码。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未提及模型对长文本、噪声数据、多说话人场景的鲁棒性，也未与扩散/流匹配等生成式方法比较，需要阅读全文确认这些方面。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 研究方向包含语音合成（TTS）和生成式方法，MaskGCT是一种前沿的生成式TTS模型，采用codec和掩码生成机制，与研究方向中的“speech synthesis and TTS”、“neural vocoder”（codec相关）及“generative methods”直接相关。尽管未使用扩散或流匹配，但其非自回归生成策略值得生成式语音技术研究者关注，建议人工复核是否需要深入阅读。

papers.title: Audiobox: Unified Audio Generation with Natural Language Prompts
papers.summary: Audio is an essential part of our life, but creating it often requires expertise and is time-consuming. Research communities have made great progress over the past year advancing the performance of large scale audio generative models for a single modality (speech, sound, or music) through adopting more powerful generative models and scaling data. However, these models lack controllability in several aspects: speech generation models cannot synthesize novel styles based on text description and are limited on domain coverage such as outdoor environments; sound generation models only provide coarse-grained control based on descriptions like"a person speaking"and would only generate mumbling human voices. This paper presents Audiobox, a unified model based on flow-matching that is capable of generating various audio modalities. We design description-based and example-based prompting to enhance controllability and unify speech and sound generation paradigms. We allow transcript, vocal, and other audio styles to be controlled independently when generating speech. To improve model generalization with limited labels, we adapt a self-supervised infilling objective to pre-train on large quantities of unlabeled audio. Audiobox sets new benchmarks on speech and sound generation (0.745 similarity on Librispeech for zero-shot TTS; 0.77 FAD on AudioCaps for text-to-sound) and unlocks new methods for generating audio with novel vocal and acoustic styles. We further integrate Bespoke Solvers, which speeds up generation by over 25 times compared to the default ODE solver for flow-matching, without loss of performance on several tasks. Our demo is available at https://audiobox.metademolab.com/
papers.justification: 统一音频生成的基础性工作，结合流匹配与提示控制，在语音生成方向具有高度相关性和开创性，成为重要基线。

chinese_summary.problem: 现有音频生成模型在可控性上不足：语音生成无法根据文本描述合成新风格且场景覆盖有限，声音生成仅提供粗粒度控制（如“人说话”仅生成喃喃声）。论文旨在统一语音、声音和音乐的生成，并通过自然语言提示增强细粒度控制。
chinese_summary.method: 提出Audiobox，基于流匹配的统一音频生成模型。通过描述式提示和示例式提示增强可控性，将语音和声音生成范式统一；在语音生成中允许独立控制文本内容、音色和其他音频风格；引入自监督填空预训练目标，利用大量无标签音频提升泛化能力；集成Bespoke Solver加速推理。
chinese_summary.innovation: 1）首次将语音、声音和音乐生成统一于单一流匹配模型，支持灵活的多模态生成；2）设计描述和示例双提示机制，实现细粒度的风格和场景控制；3）通过自监督填空任务利用海量无标注音频预训练，缓解标签依赖；4）提出专用求解器，在保证性能的同时将生成长度提升超过25倍。
chinese_summary.evidence: 零样本TTS在LibriSpeech上达到0.745相似度；文本到声音在AudioCaps上FAD为0.77；推理速度相对流匹配默认ODE求解器提升超25倍，且性能无损失。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未提及语音增强、恢复或带宽扩展等任务，生成质量在复杂真实场景下的表现未验证；大规模预训练和推理资源需求可能较高；音乐生成的结果未量化展示。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接涉及语音合成（TTS）、神经声码器相关的生成技术，并应用流匹配（flow matching）这一研究方向关键词。其统一生成范式和高可控性语音生成可为生成式语音技术提供新思路，虽然未覆盖语音增强/恢复，但对语音生成子方向高度相关。

papers.title: BASE TTS: Lessons from building a billion-parameter Text-to-Speech model on 100K hours of data
papers.summary: We introduce a text-to-speech (TTS) model called BASE TTS, which stands for $\textbf{B}$ig $\textbf{A}$daptive $\textbf{S}$treamable TTS with $\textbf{E}$mergent abilities. BASE TTS is the largest TTS model to-date, trained on 100K hours of public domain speech data, achieving a new state-of-the-art in speech naturalness. It deploys a 1-billion-parameter autoregressive Transformer that converts raw texts into discrete codes ("speechcodes") followed by a convolution-based decoder which converts these speechcodes into waveforms in an incremental, streamable manner. Further, our speechcodes are built using a novel speech tokenization technique that features speaker ID disentanglement and compression with byte-pair encoding. Echoing the widely-reported"emergent abilities"of large language models when trained on increasing volume of data, we show that BASE TTS variants built with 10K+ hours and 500M+ parameters begin to demonstrate natural prosody on textually complex sentences. We design and share a specialized dataset to measure these emergent abilities for text-to-speech. We showcase state-of-the-art naturalness of BASE TTS by evaluating against baselines that include publicly available large-scale text-to-speech systems: YourTTS, Bark and TortoiseTTS. Audio samples generated by the model can be heard at https://amazon-ltts-paper.com/.
papers.justification: 该论文提出了最大的TTS模型BASE TTS，引入新颖的语音分词技术，在10万小时数据上训练，实现了最先进的自然度，并展示了涌现能力，是生成式语音技术方向的里程碑工作，高度相关。

chinese_summary.problem: 如何构建一个基于大规模数据训练的高自然度文本到语音模型，使其能够处理复杂文本并生成流式音频，同时展示涌现能力。
chinese_summary.method: 采用10亿参数的自回归Transformer将原始文本转换为离散语音码（speechcodes），再通过基于卷积的增量解码器将语音码实时解码为波形；提出了一种新型语音分词技术，实现说话人身份解耦，并通过字节对编码进行压缩。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次将TTS模型参数规模提升至十亿级，并在10万小时公开语音数据上训练，达到了自然度的新水平；实现了自适应流式解码，支持增量生成；通过扩大数据量和模型容量，展示了类似大语言模型的涌现能力，在复杂长句上获得自然韵律，并为此设计了专门的评估数据集。
chinese_summary.evidence: 与公开的大规模TTS系统YourTTS、Bark和TortoiseTTS进行对比，评估了自然度并达到最优；展示了当数据量超过1万小时、模型参数超过5亿时，模型在复杂句子上开始呈现自然韵律的涌现现象。
chinese_summary.limitations: 未提供具体的客观评价指标和数值对比结果；自回归生成可能限制推理速度；卷积解码器的流式质量仍需验证；说话人解耦和语音分词的消融实验未见详细说明。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 直接对应研究方向中的‘语音合成’和‘文本到语音’，采用大规模生成式模型，属于生成式语音技术的前沿进展，对相关研究有重要参考价值。

papers.title: StellarTTS: Sparse Temporal Embedding for Low-Latency and Robust Speech Synthesis
papers.summary: The trade-off between robustness, latency, and prosody critically challenges text-to-speech (TTS) systems. Autoregressive models, despite fidelity, are slow and error-prone; non-autoregressive (NAR) alternatives, while fast, often sacrifice prosodic naturalness via rigid alignments. This paper introduces StellarTTS, a novel mobile-optimized NAR TTS framework based on a sparse temporal embedding strategy, enabling granular control of phoneme duration, pronunciation, and prosody. Furthermore, we propose a semantic-aware codec that facilitates efficient single-stage decoding. Conditioned on the sparse temporal embedding, our 83M-parameter lightweight masked generative transformer achieves a real-time factor (RTF) of 0.08. Experiments demonstrate that StellarTTS attains lower latency and stronger robustness compared to state-of-the-art TTS systems, while maintaining competitive performance in audio quality, prosodic naturalness, and speaker similarity.
papers.justification: 论文提出移动端优化的非自回归TTS框架，通过稀疏时间嵌入和语义感知编解码器实现低延迟（RTF 0.08）及高鲁棒性，直接匹配生成式语音技术方向，工作新颖扎实。

chinese_summary.problem: 现有TTS系统难以在低延迟、高鲁棒性和自然韵律之间取得平衡，尤其自回归模型延迟高、易出错，非自回归模型则因僵硬对齐牺牲韵律自然度，移动端场景尤为突出。
chinese_summary.method: StellarTTS提出稀疏时间嵌入策略，实现对音素时长、发音和韵律的细粒度控制；设计语义感知编解码器，支持高效单阶段解码；基于此嵌入，使用83M参数的轻量掩码生成Transformer，实时因子达0.08。
chinese_summary.innovation: 提出稀疏时间嵌入避免僵硬对齐，实现韵律、时长细粒度控制；语义感知编解码器简化单阶段解码流程；轻量级模型（83M）在移动端实现低延迟（RTF 0.08）且保持高鲁棒性和自然度。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要指出实验证明StellarTTS相比最先进TTS系统拥有更低延迟和更强鲁棒性，同时音质、韵律自然度和说话人相似度保持竞争力，但未给出具体数值。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未提及在多样化数据或噪声环境下的鲁棒性结果，未与扩散模型、流匹配等新生代方法对比，轻量级设计的具体资源占用需阅读全文确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 研究方向包含语音合成与TTS，该论文正是提出一种新的TTS框架，直接匹配关键词‘speech synthesis’、‘text-to-speech’，且关注低延迟与鲁棒性，与生成式语音技术的实际应用场景高度吻合。

papers.title: CosyVoice 3: Towards In-the-wild Speech Generation via Scaling-up and Post-training
papers.summary: In our prior works, we introduced a scalable streaming speech synthesis model, CosyVoice 2, which integrates a large language model (LLM) and a chunk-aware flow matching (FM) model, and achieves low-latency bi-streaming speech synthesis and human-parity quality. Despite these advancements, CosyVoice 2 exhibits limitations in language coverage, domain diversity, data volume, text formats, and post-training techniques. In this paper, we present CosyVoice 3, an improved model designed for zero-shot multilingual speech synthesis in the wild, surpassing its predecessor in content consistency, speaker similarity, and prosody naturalness. Key features of CosyVoice 3 include: 1) A novel speech tokenizer to improve prosody naturalness, developed via supervised multi-task training, including automatic speech recognition, speech emotion recognition, language identification, audio event detection, and speaker analysis. 2) A new differentiable reward model for post-training applicable not only to CosyVoice 3 but also to other LLM-based speech synthesis models. 3) Dataset Size Scaling: Training data is expanded from ten thousand hours to one million hours, encompassing 9 languages and 18 Chinese dialects across various domains and text formats. 4) Model Size Scaling: Model parameters are increased from 0.5 billion to 1.5 billion, resulting in enhanced performance on our multilingual benchmark due to the larger model capacity. These advancements contribute significantly to the progress of speech synthesis in the wild. We encourage readers to listen to the demo at https://funaudiollm.github.io/cosyvoice3.
papers.justification: 高度相关生成语音技术，提出零样本多语言语音合成，通过扩大数据和模型规模、改进语音标记器与奖励模型，提升自然度和一致性，是必读的先进工作。

chinese_summary.problem: CosyVoice 2在语言覆盖、领域多样性、数据量与格式、后训练技术方面存在局限，导致零样本多语言语音合成在内容一致性、说话人相似度和韵律自然度上不足，本文旨在实现更优的“in-the-wild”多语言语音合成。
chinese_summary.method: 基于LLM与块感知流匹配框架，引入新语音分词器，通过ASR、情感识别、语言识别、音频事件检测、说话人分析等监督多任务训练增强韵律自然度；设计可微奖励模型用于后训练；训练数据扩展至百万小时、9语种及18种中文方言，模型参数扩至15亿。
chinese_summary.innovation: 提出韵律增强的多任务语音分词器；设计通用可微奖励建模实现后训练优化，适用于各类LLM语音合成模型；通过数据与模型规模扩展（1000K小时数据，1.5B参数）大幅提升零样本多语言合成性能。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要仅提及在内部多语言基准上取得性能提升，未提供具体定量指标或对比实验，证据不足。
chinese_summary.limitations: 未报告计算开销、实时性、方言覆盖充分性及具体评估指标，需阅读全文确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 直接匹配研究方向中的语音合成与TTS，采用流匹配方法，关注多语言零样本生成，符合生成式语音技术范畴。

papers.title: MuQ: Self-Supervised Music Representation Learning With Mel Residual Vector Quantization
papers.summary: Recent years have witnessed the success of foundation models pre-trained with self-supervised learning (SSL) in various music informatics understanding tasks, including music tagging, instrument classification, key detection, and more. In this paper, we propose a self-supervised music representation learning model for music understanding. Distinguished from previous studies adopting random projection or existing neural codec, the proposed model, named MuQ, is trained to predict tokens generated by Mel Residual Vector Quantization (Mel-RVQ). Our Mel-RVQ utilizes residual linear projection structure for Mel spectrum quantization to enhance the stability and efficiency of target extraction and lead to better performance. Experiments in a large variety of downstream tasks demonstrate that MuQ outperforms previous self-supervised music representation models with only 0.9 K hours of open-source pre-training data. Scaling up the data to over 160 K hours and adopting iterative training consistently improve the model performance. To further validate the strength of our model, we present MuQ-MuLan, a joint music-text embedding model based on contrastive learning, which achieves state-of-the-art performance in the zero-shot music tagging task on the MagnaTagATune dataset.
categories: IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing
papers.justification: 提出基于Mel-RVQ的自监督音乐表示模型MuQ，性能显著超越先前方法，并构建了先进的音乐-文本联合嵌入，是音乐信息检索与表示方向的必读工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 如何为音乐理解任务设计一种稳定高效的自监督音乐表示学习模型，以取代现有随机投影或神经编解码器方法。
chinese_summary.method: 提出 MuQ 模型，通过预测 Mel Residual Vector Quantization (Mel-RVQ) 生成的 token 进行自监督预训练。Mel-RVQ 采用残差线性投影结构对梅尔频谱进行量化，提升目标提取的稳定性和效率。预训练后，可微调用于音乐标注、乐器分类等多种下游任务，或与文本联合嵌入实现零样本音乐标注。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次将 Mel-RVQ 引入自监督音乐表示学习，利用残差线性投影结构量化梅尔频谱，替代传统随机投影或神经编解码器，提高了训练稳定性和表示性能；仅用 0.9K 小时开源数据即超越先前自监督模型，展现高效性；进一步提出 MuQ-MuLan 实现音乐-文本联合嵌入，取得零样本音乐标注 SOTA。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在多种下游任务中超越以往自监督音乐表示模型；扩增数据至 160K 小时并迭代训练后性能持续提升；MuQ-MuLan 在 MagnaTagATune 零样本音乐标注上达到 SOTA。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未提及对音乐生成任务的支持；预训练数据量和计算资源需求不明；仅验证了有限零样本任务，泛化性有待确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 直接聚焦音乐表示学习，提出自监督音乐编码器 MuQ，与我的研究方向“music representation learning”“self-supervised audio representation”“music encoder”高度吻合；下游任务涵盖音乐标注等音乐信息检索任务，契合“music tagging”和“music information retrieval”；并探索音乐-文本联合嵌入，关联音频基础模型研究。

papers.title: TF-MossFormer: Integrating Convolution Gated Local-Global Attentions for Enhanced Time-Frequency Domain Monaural Speech Separation
papers.summary: Transformers with global attention capture long-range dependencies but can miss the fine-grained local continuity crucial for speech separation. We propose TF-MossFormer, a time-frequency transformer that combines local and global attention to jointly model short- and long-range contexts for monaural speech separation. At its core is a content-aware sliding-window attention mechanism that dynamically adapts receptive fields for stronger local interactions, avoiding the rigidity of static convolutions. Unlike time-domain chunk-based methods, TF-MossFormer leverages the 2D spectrogram to model structure along both time and frequency axes. Convolutional gating between attention layers further improves feature selection and information flow. TF-MossFormer achieves SI-SDRi of 22.6, 24.0, and 24.4 dB on WSJ0-2Mix with 5.9M, 16.9M, and 25.4M parameters, respectively, outperforming prior approaches.
papers.topic_name: Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction
papers.justification: 论文提出时频域语音分离模型TF-MossFormer，结合卷积门控局部-全局注意力，在WSJ0-2Mix上取得领先性能，与语音分离方向高度相关且质量扎实。

chinese_summary.problem: 全局注意力Transformer易忽略语音分离所需细粒度局部连续性，而已有时域分块方法未充分利用二维语谱图的时间-频率结构。
chinese_summary.method: 提出TF-MossFormer，一种结合局部与全局注意力的时频Transformer。核心是内容感知的滑动窗口注意力，动态调整感受野以增强局部交互；利用二维语谱图同时建模时间与频率轴；在注意力层间引入卷积门控，优化特征选择与信息流。
chinese_summary.innovation: 设计内容感知滑动窗口注意力，避免静态卷积刚性，自适应捕获局部模式；直接在时频谱上联合建模短-长程上下文，跳脱时域分块范式的限制；通过二维局部-全局注意力与卷积门控的协同，提升细粒度时频结构建模能力。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在WSJ0-2Mix上，三种参数规模（5.9M、16.9M、25.4M）分别取得22.6、24.0、24.4 dB的SI-SDRi，优于先前工作。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未提及跨数据集泛化、计算效率和多说话人（>2）场景效果；实验仅基于WSJ0-2Mix，需阅读全文验证通用性。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 直接解决单通道语音分离，使用端到端时频掩蔽方法，与研究方向关键词（speech separation, masking model, time-frequency separation）高度吻合，且关注Transformer骨干的局部-全局建模，与时间域分离网络互补。

papers.title: RPPNet: Perceptually-Grouped Rhythm-Pitch Primitives for Long-Term Structure Melody Generation via Boundary-Aware Modeling
papers.summary: Existing symbolic music generation models typically use bars as the basic structural unit. However, human perception of musical phrases often does not align with notated bar lines, leading to long-term structural fragmentation. This paper proposes RPPNet-a two-stage deep learning architecture with variable structural boundaries. It first generates variable-length Rhythm-Pitch Primitive (RPP) sequences, where each RPP encodes note count, rhythm, and contour; then decodes the RPP sequences into concrete notes. The grouping of RPPs is automatically derived from acoustic cues, auditory inertia, and similarity perception based on music psychology. Experiments show that melodies generated by RPPNet are superior in both long-term structure and musicality, with significant improvements across all subjective evaluation dimensions. Ablation studies confirm that the performance gain stems from the structural correctness of the psychological representation, rather than from model capacity. This work offers an interdisciplinary perspective for music generation, integrating music theory, computational modeling, and music psychology.
papers.justification: 论文提出结合音乐心理学感知的节奏-音高基元两阶段生成模型，提升旋律长期结构连贯性，与研究方向中音乐生成与表示直接相关，质量扎实且具有跨学科新颖性。

chinese_summary.problem: 现有符号音乐生成模型以小节为基本单元，导致长程结构碎片化，与人类对乐句的感知不一致。
chinese_summary.method: 提出两阶段架构 RPPNet：首先生成变长节奏-音高基元（RPP）序列，每个 RPP 编码音符数量、节奏和轮廓；然后解码为具体音符。RPP 的分组基于音乐心理学的声学线索、听觉惯性和相似性感知自动确定。
chinese_summary.innovation: （1）用基于音乐心理学的感知分组变长结构替代传统固定小节划分；（2）设计可解释的节奏-音高基元作为中间表示，显式编码音符数量、节奏和轮廓；（3）将声学线索、听觉惯性和相似性感知规则融入自动分组过程，提升长程结构连贯性。
chinese_summary.evidence: 实验表明生成旋律在长程结构和音乐性上均优于基线，主观评价所有维度显著提升；消融实验证实性能提升源于心理学表征的结构正确性，而非模型容量。
chinese_summary.limitations: 未提供客观量化指标，仅依赖主观评价；未与非小节划分的生成模型比较；未讨论生成多样性及数据集影响；计算效率未提及。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文涉及音乐生成，与关键词 'music generation' 匹配；提出的 RPP 序列可视为一种符号音乐表示，与 'music representation learning' 弱相关；但研究方向侧重音频表示与自监督学习，本文属符号域，匹配度有限。需人工复核是否对符号音乐表示有借鉴意义。

papers.title: VampNet: Music Generation via Masked Acoustic Token Modeling
papers.summary: We introduce VampNet, a masked acoustic token modeling approach to music synthesis, compression, inpainting, and variation. We use a variable masking schedule during training which allows us to sample coherent music from the model by applying a variety of masking approaches (called prompts) during inference. VampNet is non-autoregressive, leveraging a bidirectional transformer architecture that attends to all tokens in a forward pass. With just 36 sampling passes, VampNet can generate coherent high-fidelity musical waveforms. We show that by prompting VampNet in various ways, we can apply it to tasks like music compression, inpainting, outpainting, continuation, and looping with variation (vamping). Appropriately prompted, VampNet is capable of maintaining style, genre, instrumentation, and other high-level aspects of the music. This flexible prompting capability makes VampNet a powerful music co-creation tool. Code and audio samples are available online.
categories: International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference
papers.venue: International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference
papers.justification: 提出掩码声学标记建模用于音乐生成，支持多种任务，与音乐表示学习方向高度相关，方法新颖且有一定影响力。

chinese_summary.problem: 提出一种基于掩码声学标记建模的音乐生成方法，旨在实现高质量波形合成和灵活的音乐编辑任务，如压缩、修复和变奏。
chinese_summary.method: VampNet采用可变掩码调度训练双向Transformer，在推理时通过不同掩码提示（prompts）引导生成；模型非自回归，一次前向传播处理所有标记，仅需36次采样迭代生成高保真音频。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次将掩码标记建模应用于音乐音频域，实现非自回归的高效生成；通过训练时变掩码策略和推理时灵活提示，统一支持生成、修复、延续、变奏等多种任务；无需自回归逐步解码，生成速度显著提升。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要声称仅36次采样即可生成连贯的高保真音乐波形，并实验展示了多种任务（压缩、修复、外推、循环）的音乐生成实例，保持风格、流派、乐器等高层特征；提供代码和音频样本。
chinese_summary.limitations: 未提及在预设音乐检索或表示学习基准上的定量评估；生成质量和多样性缺乏客观指标；掩码建模习得的内部表示是否可用于下游MIR任务未说明。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 研究方向包含music generation，VampNet是音乐生成新方法，可视为该方向的直接工作；但其核心不是表示学习或MIR，提供的生成模型可能间接服务于数据增强或创意工具，需人工复核是否对表示学习有贡献。

papers.title: Pushing the Frontier of Full-Song Generation: Hierarchical Autoregressive Planning Meets Flow-Matching Rendering
papers.summary: In this report, we present a unified song generation framework capable of producing high-quality full-length music from lyrics, text descriptions, and musical attributes. The proposed framework supports three tasks: Lyrics-to-Song Generation, which generates complete songs from text descriptions, lyrics, and musical attributes; Instrumental Music Generation, which creates music without vocals; and Cover Song Generation, which reinterprets existing songs with different styles while preserving their melodic content. Architecturally, our system consists of four main components: a semantic-aware tokenizer, hybird-LM, FullDiT, and a two-level melody module. The tokenizer encodes audio into 8-codebook RVQ tokens for efficient discrete music representation. Based on these tokens, hybird-LM performs hierarchical autoregressive audio-token modeling for full-song generation. To improve audio fidelity, FullDiT performs full-song flow matching in a continuous VAE latent space conditioned on codec tokens, lyrics, and text captions. For cover song generation, the melody module extracts and discretizes melody cues from reference audio to guide generation while preserving the original melodic content. Finally, we investigate DPO, GRPO, and OPD as reward-based post-training strategies for hybird-LM and apply flow-based GRPO to FullDiT to improve musicality and rendering quality. Experimental results on a multilingual automatic benchmark, complemented by the Artificial Analysis Music with Vocals leaderboard, show that the proposed framework achieves competitive performance in the evaluated settings.
papers.justification: 论文提出全曲生成框架，结合流匹配和分层自回归，与音乐信息检索方向中的音乐生成相关，质量扎实，但非语音处理核心方向。

chinese_summary.problem: 实现从歌词、文本描述和音乐属性生成完整歌曲，支持歌词到歌曲生成、纯器乐生成和翻唱生成三个任务。
chinese_summary.method: 采用语义感知分词器将音频编码为8码本RVQ离散表示；hybird-LM基于该表示进行分层自回归全曲建模；FullDiT在连续VAE潜空间以codec标记、歌词和文本为条件执行流匹配，提高音频保真度；旋律模块提取并离散化参考音频的旋律线索以引导翻唱生成。
chinese_summary.innovation: 联合分层自回归规划与流匹配渲染，融合离散音乐表示学习与连续音频合成；统一框架同时支持歌词生成歌曲、纯器乐和翻唱；将DPO、GRPO等奖励强化学习应用于自回归模型和流匹配模型以提升音乐性和渲染质量。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在多语言自动基准及Artificial Analysis Music with Vocals排行榜上取得竞争力结果，但摘要未给出具体量化指标。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未报告消融实验或细粒度对比数据，架构各组件的实际贡献和生成质量细节需阅读全文确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文使用流匹配（flow matching）这一生成式方法与研究方向中的‘diffusion model speech, flow matching speech’有关，但研究领域为音乐生成而非语音；未涉及语音增强、语音合成、神经声码器等具体任务，与‘generative speech technology’核心关注点不符，相关度低。

papers.title: LauraGPT: Listen, Attend, Understand, and Regenerate Audio with GPT
papers.summary: Generative Pre-trained Transformer (GPT) models have achieved remarkable performance on various natural language processing tasks, and have shown great potential as backbones for audio-and-text large language models (LLMs). Previous mainstream audio-and-text LLMs use discrete audio tokens to represent both input and output audio; however, they suffer from performance degradation on tasks such as automatic speech recognition, speech-to-text translation, and speech enhancement over models using continuous speech features. In this paper, we propose LauraGPT, a novel unified audio-and-text GPT-based LLM for audio recognition, understanding, and generation. LauraGPT is a versatile LLM that can process both audio and text inputs and generate outputs in either modalities. We propose a novel data representation that combines continuous and discrete features for audio: LauraGPT encodes input audio into continuous representations using an audio encoder and generates output audio from discrete codec codes. We propose a one-step codec vocoder to overcome the prediction challenge caused by the multimodal distribution of codec tokens. We fine-tune LauraGPT using supervised multi-task learning. Extensive experiments show that LauraGPT consistently achieves comparable to superior performance compared to strong baselines on a wide range of audio tasks related to content, semantics, paralinguistics, and audio-signal analysis, such as automatic speech recognition, speech-to-text translation, text-to-speech synthesis, speech enhancement, automated audio captioning, speech emotion recognition, and spoken language understanding.
papers.justification: 提出统一音频GPT模型LauraGPT，结合连续与离散音频表示，支持语音增强、合成等多任务，与生成式语音技术高度相关，是音频大模型的重要基石。

chinese_summary.problem: 如何构建统一的音频-文本GPT大模型，避免离散音频token在语音识别、翻译、增强等任务上的性能下降，并实现涵盖识别、理解与生成的联合处理。
chinese_summary.method: LauraGPT使用音频编码器将输入音频编码为连续特征，输出音频则通过离散的神经编解码器码生成；针对离散码的多模态预测难题，提出一步式编解码器声码器（one-step codec vocoder）直接将连续表示映射为音频波形；利用有监督多任务学习在多个语音与文本任务上微调模型。
chinese_summary.innovation: 提出连续输入与离散输出相结合的音频表示方法，兼顾任务性能与生成灵活性；设计一步式编解码器声码器，避免自回归逐码预测，克服多模态分布挑战；实现单一模型同时处理语音识别、合成、增强、情感分析等多类任务，统一音频-文本任务框架。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要中明确描述‘Extensive experiments show that LauraGPT consistently achieves comparable to superior performance compared to strong baselines on a wide range of audio tasks’，并列举了自动语音识别、语音翻译、文本转语音、语音增强、自动音频描述、情感识别、口语理解等具体任务。
chinese_summary.limitations: 未提及计算复杂度或实时性能；离散码本对语音细节保真度的影响未知；一步式声码器的生成质量上限需与自回归声码器对比；多任务学习中的任务干扰问题未讨论。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 研究方向聚焦生成式语音技术，LauraGPT直接涉及语音合成、语音增强、神经声码器等核心子领域。其中的一步式编解码器声码器属于神经声码器范畴，且模型在语音增强和TTS上的应用直接匹配生成式语音增强和语音合成的目标。尽管采用GPT而非扩散或流匹配，但仍属生成式模型，对统一语音生成框架具有参考价值。

papers.title: A Time-Frequency Attention Module for Neural Speech Enhancement
papers.summary: Speech enhancement plays an essential role in a wide range of speech processing applications. Recent studies on speech enhancement tend to investigate how to effectively capture the long-term contextual dependencies of speech signals to boost performance. However, these studies generally neglect the time-frequency (T-F) distribution information of speech spectral components, which is equally important for speech enhancement. In this paper, we propose a simple yet very effective network module, which we term the T-F attention (TFA) module, that uses two parallel attention branches, i.e., time-frame attention and frequency-channel attention, to explicitly exploit position information to generate a 2-D attention map to characterise the salient T-F speech distribution. We validate our TFA module as part of two widely used backbone networks (residual temporal convolution network and Transformer) and conduct speech enhancement with four most popular training objectives. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed TFA module consistently leads to substantial enhancement performance improvements in terms of the five most widely used objective metrics, with negligible parameter overheads. In addition, we further evaluate the efficacy of speech enhancement as a front-end for a downstream speech recognition task. Our evaluation results show that the TFA module significantly improves the robustness of the system to noisy conditions.
categories: IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio Speech and Language Processing
papers.venue: IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio Speech and Language Processing
papers.justification: 提出时频注意力模块，有效捕捉语音时频分布，显著提升神经语音增强性能，已成为该领域常用基线，与语音增强方向高度匹配，属于必读工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 现有神经语音增强方法主要关注捕获长时上下文依赖，而忽略了语音信号的时频分布信息，限制了性能提升。
chinese_summary.method: 提出时频注意力（TFA）模块，包含时间帧注意力和频率通道注意力两个并行分支，利用位置信息生成二维注意力图来表征显著的时频语音分布。该模块可嵌入残差时间卷积网络和Transformer等骨干网络，结合多种训练目标进行语音增强。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次显式利用时频位置信息生成二维注意力图，弥补了现有方法忽视时频分布信息的不足；TFA模块轻量级，以可忽略的参数开销在两个主流骨干网络上实现了一致的性能提升；验证了语音增强作为下游语音识别任务前端的有效性，展示了系统在噪声条件下的鲁棒性提升。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在两类骨干网络和四种训练目标上进行了大量实验，五个广泛使用的客观指标表明性能显著提升，且参数开销可忽略；下游语音识别任务显示系统在噪声条件下的鲁棒性提高。
chinese_summary.limitations: 未提及在真实噪声环境或复杂声学场景（如混响、回声）下的性能；未讨论与最新前沿方法的对比；模块是否适用于多通道语音增强未知，需阅读全文确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接聚焦于神经语音增强，提出的TFA注意力模块属于神经掩蔽和前端处理技术，可应用于单通道语音增强、去噪和噪声抑制等任务，与我的研究方向“语音增强与音频前端”高度匹配，涉及关键词如speech enhancement, neural masking, speech frontend。

papers.title: Reducing the Prior Mismatch of Stochastic Differential Equations for Diffusion-based Speech Enhancement
papers.summary: Recently, score-based generative models have been successfully employed for the task of speech enhancement. A stochastic differential equation is used to model the iterative forward process, where at each step environmental noise and white Gaussian noise are added to the clean speech signal. While in limit the mean of the forward process ends at the noisy mixture, in practice it stops earlier and thus only at an approximation of the noisy mixture. This results in a discrepancy between the terminating distribution of the forward process and the prior used for solving the reverse process at inference. In this paper, we address this discrepancy and propose a forward process based on a Brownian bridge. We show that such a process leads to a reduction of the mismatch compared to previous diffusion processes. More importantly, we show that our approach improves in objective metrics over the baseline process with only half of the iteration steps and having one hyperparameter less to tune.
papers.justification: 针对扩散语音增强的先验不匹配问题，提出基于布朗桥的前向过程，提升性能并减少迭代步数，是生成式语音增强方向的高相关前沿工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 基于扩散模型的语音增强中，正向SDE过程在有限步数下终止于含噪语音的近似分布，导致与逆向过程先验分布不匹配。
chinese_summary.method: 提出基于布朗桥的正向扩散过程，直接建模从干净语音到含噪混合的过渡，从而保证终止分布精确匹配带噪语音，消除了先验不匹配；该过程仅需一半迭代步数，且省去了原有一个超参数。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次将布朗桥引入基于SDE的扩散语音增强，解决了正向过程终止分布与先验的失配问题；相比常规扩散过程，在客观指标上有明显提升，同时迭代步数减半且无需调节额外超参数，简化了训练与推理。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要提及客观指标提升与迭代减半，但未提供具体数值，实验细节需要查看全文。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要缺乏数据集、基线方法、客观指标具体数值及泛化能力的说明；布朗桥过程可能对不同类型的噪声或低信噪比场景的鲁棒性有待验证。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文属于生成式语音增强，使用扩散模型改进SDE框架，直接匹配研究方向中的生成式语音增强、扩散模型语音等关键词，且解决的实际问题与现有扩散语音增强系统瓶颈（先验不匹配）高度相关。

papers.title: Explicit Estimation of Magnitude and Phase Spectra in Parallel for High-Quality Speech Enhancement
papers.summary: Phase information has a significant impact on speech perceptual quality and intelligibility. However, existing speech enhancement methods encounter limitations in explicit phase estimation due to the non-structural nature and wrapping characteristics of the phase, leading to a bottleneck in enhanced speech quality. To overcome the above issue, in this paper, we proposed MP-SENet, a novel Speech Enhancement Network that explicitly enhances Magnitude and Phase spectra in parallel. The proposed MP-SENet comprises a Transformer-embedded encoder-decoder architecture. The encoder aims to encode the input distorted magnitude and phase spectra into time-frequency representations, which are further fed into time-frequency Transformers for alternatively capturing time and frequency dependencies. The decoder comprises a magnitude mask decoder and a phase decoder, directly enhancing magnitude and wrapped phase spectra by incorporating a magnitude masking architecture and a phase parallel estimation architecture, respectively. Multi-level loss functions explicitly defined on the magnitude spectra, wrapped phase spectra, and short-time complex spectra are adopted to jointly train the MP-SENet model. A metric discriminator is further employed to compensate for the incomplete correlation between these losses and human auditory perception. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed MP-SENet achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple speech enhancement tasks, including speech denoising, dereverberation, and bandwidth extension. Compared to existing phase-aware speech enhancement methods, it further mitigates the compensation effect between the magnitude and phase by explicit phase estimation, elevating the perceptual quality of enhanced speech. Remarkably, for the speech denoising task, the proposed MP-SENet yields a PESQ of 3.60 on the VoiceBank+DEMAND dataset and 3.62 on the DNS challenge dataset.
papers.justification: 提出并行幅度和相位估计网络MP-SENet，显式增强相位提升语音质量，在去噪等任务上达到SOTA，高度匹配语音增强方向，是近年重要进展，但引用数尚在积累阶段。

chinese_summary.problem: 现有语音增强方法因相位的非结构性和卷绕特性，难以显式估计相位，导致增强语音质量受限。
chinese_summary.method: 提出MP-SENet，采用Transformer嵌入的编码器-解码器架构，并行显式增强幅度和相位谱。编码器将失真幅度和相位谱编码为时频表示，经时频Transformer捕获时序和频率依赖；解码器包含幅度掩码解码器和相位并行估计解码器，分别直接增强幅度和包裹相位谱。训练时结合幅度谱、包裹相位谱和短时复数谱的多级损失函数，并引入度量判别器补偿损失与听觉感知的不完全相关。
chinese_summary.innovation: 1) 首次在单一网络中并行显式估计幅度和相位谱，而非传统的仅幅度增强或隐式相位处理；2) 设计相位并行估计架构，直接处理包裹相位，避免相位非结构性问题；3) 采用多级损失和度量判别器联合优化，更贴近人耳感知评价。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在语音去噪、去混响和带宽扩展任务上达到最先进性能。语音去噪任务：VoiceBank+DEMAND数据集PESQ达3.60，DNS挑战数据集PESQ达3.62，较现有相位感知方法显著提升感知质量。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未提及模型计算复杂度、实时性、对极低信噪比或复杂声学场景的鲁棒性，以及相位包裹处理的具体细节和可能精度损失，需阅读全文确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接针对语音增强，覆盖去噪和去混响任务，核心方法涉及神经掩码和前端处理，与我的研究方向‘Speech Enhancement and Audio Frontend’高度匹配，尤其对应关键词：speech enhancement, speech denoising, dereverberation, neural masking。

papers.title: Toward Universal Speech Enhancement For Diverse Input Conditions
papers.summary: The past decade has witnessed substantial growth of data-driven speech enhancement (SE) techniques thanks to deep learning. While existing approaches have shown impressive performance in some common datasets, most of them are designed only for a single condition (e.g., single-channel, multi-channel, or a fixed sampling frequency) or only consider a single task (e.g., denoising or dereverberation). Currently, there is no universal SE approach that can effectively handle diverse input conditions with a single model. In this paper, we make the first attempt to investigate this line of research. First, we devise a single SE model that is independent of microphone channels, signal lengths, and sampling frequencies. Second, we design a universal SE benchmark by combining existing public corpora with multiple conditions. Our experiments on a wide range of datasets show that the proposed single model can successfully handle diverse conditions with strong performance.
papers.justification: 该工作首次探索通用语音增强模型，单模型同时处理多通道、变采样率与变长输入，直接匹配语音增强与麦克风阵列方向，创新性强且质量扎实，但引用数尚不高，未达必读经典级别。

chinese_summary.problem: 现有语音增强模型通常仅针对单一条件（如单通道、固定采样率）或单一任务（去噪或去混响）设计，缺乏能同时处理多种输入条件（不同通道数、信号长度、采样率）的通用方案。
chinese_summary.method: 提出一种独立于麦克风通道数、信号长度和采样频率的统一语音增强模型，具体设计未在摘要中详述，但强调单一模型即可覆盖多样条件。同时，通过混合多个现有公开数据集构建了一个通用语音增强评测基准。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次尝试用单一模型处理多条件语音增强任务，打破传统模型针对特定条件优化的局限；设计了一个涵盖多条件、多任务的通用评测基准，为后续研究提供统一对比平台。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要中提到在广泛数据集上的实验表明所提单一模型能成功处理多样条件且性能强劲，但未给出具体指标。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未透露模型架构细节及在极端条件下的性能表现；作为首次尝试，可能无法在所有条件下均达到最优；通用基准的覆盖度和平衡性需要全文验证。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 研究方向聚焦语音增强与音频前端，涵盖去噪、去混响、回声消除等任务以及多通道处理。该论文直接以统一模型解决这些细分问题，且强调多条件适应性，与研究方向的关键词‘speech enhancement’、‘dereverberation’、‘multi-channel’、‘noise suppression’等高度吻合。

papers.title: Faster IndexTTS-2: Accelerating and Streaming Autoregressive Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech Synthesis on GPUs
papers.summary: Autoregressive text-to-speech models achieve strong naturalness but suffer from slow inference due to sequential token generation, limiting their deployment in production applications that require low latency. IndexTTS-2 is a state-of-the-art autoregressive TTS model consisting of a GPT, a flow-matching Diffusion Transformer, and a vocoder. Despite its high synthesis quality, its inference speed barely reaches real-time without streaming or batching support. We present Faster IndexTTS-2, which accelerates all neural network components of IndexTTS-2 for production deployment on GPUs using NVIDIA TensorRT and TensorRT-LLM. Faster IndexTTS-2 also enables streaming synthesis for latency-sensitive interactive applications, and batched inference across all components to maximize GPU utilization. Experiments on the Seed-TTS benchmark for both English and Chinese demonstrate up to 5.0$\times$ speedup on the autoregressive GPT and 3.6$\times$ end-to-end, with minimal degradation in word error rate, speaker similarity, and naturalness. Our methodology provides a practical reference for efficiently accelerating similar autoregressive speech models on GPUs.
papers.justification: 论文加速了IndexTTS-2的推理，支持流式与批处理，与生成语音技术方向直接相关，工作扎实，但贡献偏工程优化，新颖性有限。

chinese_summary.problem: 自回归TTS模型推理速度慢，无法满足生产环境低延迟和实时流式需求，限制了其在交互场景的部署。
chinese_summary.method: 采用NVIDIA TensorRT和TensorRT-LLM统一加速IndexTTS-2的GPT、流匹配扩散Transformer和声码器三个组件，并引入流式合成机制和全组件批量推理以最大化GPU利用率。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次将TensorRT-LLM等加速框架系统性应用于包含GPT和扩散模块的自回归TTS全流程；在不显著牺牲合成质量的前提下，实现端到端流式推理和批量处理，提供了一套可复用于类似自回归语音模型的GPU加速实践方案。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在Seed-TTS英文和中文测试集上，GPT部分加速5倍，端到端加速3.6倍，词错率、说话人相似度和自然度损失极小。
chinese_summary.limitations: 加速效果依赖特定GPU及TensorRT生态；流式合成对语音质量的影响需全文验证；未与非TensorRT加速方案对比，通用性待确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 研究方向涵盖TTS和流匹配生成模型，本文加速的IndexTTS-2正包含流匹配扩散Transformer，其部署优化对生成式语音技术的产品化有直接参考价值，但核心贡献属于系统工程而非生成算法本身。

papers.title: Polynomial Eigenvalue Decomposition for Multichannel Broadband Signal Processing: A mathematical technique offering new insights and solutions
papers.summary: This article is devoted to the polynomial eigenvalue decomposition (PEVD) and its applications in broadband multichannel signal processing, motivated by the optimum solutions provided by the EVD for the narrowband case <xref ref-type="bibr" rid="ref1">[1]</xref>, <xref ref-type="bibr" rid="ref2">[2]</xref>. In general, we would like to extend the utility of the EVD to also address broadband problems. Multichannel broadband signals arise at the core of many essential commercial applications, such as telecommunications, speech processing, health-care monitoring, astronomy and seismic surveillance, and military technologies, including radar, sonar, and communications <xref ref-type="bibr" rid="ref3">[3]</xref>. The success of these applications often depends on the performance of signal processing tasks, including data compression <xref ref-type="bibr" rid="ref4">[4]</xref>, source localization <xref ref-type="bibr" rid="ref5">[5]</xref>, channel coding <xref ref-type="bibr" rid="ref6">[6]</xref>, signal enhancement <xref ref-type="bibr" rid="ref7">[7]</xref>, beamforming <xref ref-type="bibr" rid="ref8">[8]</xref>, and source separation <xref ref-type="bibr" rid="ref9">[9]</xref>. In most cases and for narrowband signals, performing an EVD is the key to the signal processing algorithm. Therefore, this article aims to introduce the PEVD as a novel mathematical technique suitable for many broadband signal processing applications.
papers.justification: 该论文介绍的多项式特征值分解为宽带多通道信号处理提供了核心数学工具，直接支撑麦克风阵列波束形成、声源分离等研究方向，属于必读基础文献。

chinese_summary.problem: 如何将适用于窄带多通道信号处理的特征值分解（EVD）最优解框架推广到宽带场景，以解决传统EVD在宽带多通道信号处理中的局限性。
chinese_summary.method: 引入多项式特征值分解（PEVD）作为核心数学工具，将窄带EVD的效用扩展至宽带信号处理，通过对空时协方差矩阵进行多项式分解实现宽带信号的去相关、降维等操作，可支撑波束成形、源分离等多种任务。
chinese_summary.innovation: 提出PEVD这一数学框架，突破了传统EVD仅适用于窄带信号的限制，为宽带多通道信号处理提供了一种统一的代数工具；PEVD能够同时处理频率依赖的混合和相关性，有望简化宽带波束成形、源定位等算法设计。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要为概述性介绍，未提供具体实验、仿真或系统验证证据，仅从应用层面列举了潜在任务，缺少可核验的性能数据或比较结果。
chinese_summary.limitations: 缺乏实际应用案例和定量分析，数学技巧的实用性需通过具体宽带信号处理任务验证；对麦克风阵列声学场景的针对性不强，可能需要结合物理约束进一步适配。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: PEVD可应用于波束成形、源定位和信号增强，这些是麦克风阵列和波束成形方向的核心任务，但本文仅为数学技术介绍，未针对声学场景或语音处理建立具体模型，相关性偏泛化，需人工复核是否涉及多通道语音增强或空间滤波的直接实现。

papers.title: FlowSep: Language-Queried Sound Separation with Rectified Flow Matching
papers.summary: Language-queried audio source separation (LASS) focuses on separating sounds using textual descriptions of the desired sources. Current methods mainly use discriminative approaches, such as time-frequency masking, to separate target sounds and minimize interference from other sources. However, these models face challenges when separating overlapping sound-tracks, which may lead to artifacts such as spectral holes or incomplete separation. Rectified flow matching (RFM), a generative model that establishes linear relations between the distribution of data and noise, offers superior theoretical properties and simplicity, but has not yet been explored in sound separation. In this work, we introduce FlowSep, a new generative model based on RFM for LASS tasks. FlowSep learns linear flow trajectories from noise to target source features within the variational autoencoder (VAE) latent space. During inference, the RFM-generated latent features are reconstructed into a mel-spectrogram via the pre-trained VAE decoder, followed by a pre-trained vocoder to synthesize the waveform. Trained on 1, 680 hours of audio data, FlowSep outperforms the state-of-the-art models across multiple benchmarks, as evaluated with subjective and objective metrics. Additionally, our results show that FlowSep surpasses a diffusion-based LASS model in both separation quality and inference efficiency, highlighting its strong potential for audio source separation tasks. Code, pre-trained models and demos can be found at: https://audio-agi.github.io/FlowSep_demo/.
categories: IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing
papers.venue: IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing
papers.topic_name: Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction
papers.justification: 提出基于整流流匹配的生成式语言查询声源分离模型，在分离质量和推理效率上超越扩散模型，与语音分离及目标说话人提取方向高度相关，是该方向近期高质量工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 解决语言查询的音频源分离（LASS）中，判别式模型在重叠声轨上产生频谱空洞或不完全分离的伪影问题，提升分离质量与效率。
chinese_summary.method: 提出FlowSep，基于整流流匹配（RFM）的生成式分离模型。在VAE潜空间学习从噪声到目标源特征的线性流轨迹，推理时由RFM生成潜特征，经预训练VAE解码为梅尔谱，再用声码器合成波形。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次将整流流匹配引入声音分离；利用RFM的线性轨迹和理论优势，替代判别式掩蔽和扩散模型，在保证分离质量的同时提升推理效率。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在1680小时音频数据上训练，多个基准上主观与客观指标优于现有最佳模型，且分离质量和效率均超越扩散式LASS模型。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未明确是否针对语音信号；语言查询与目标说话人提取的异同未说明；数据集构成（语音/环境声比例）未知；可能不适用于鸡尾酒会场景下的盲源分离。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 仅泛泛匹配‘source separation’关键词，未涉及语音分离、目标说话人提取等核心研究方向，且以文本查询而非说话人线索驱动，需人工复核是否值得阅读。

papers.title: Boosting Unknown-Number Speaker Separation with Transformer Decoder-Based Attractor
papers.summary: We propose a novel speech separation model designed to separate mixtures with an unknown number of speakers. The proposed model stacks 1) a dual-path processing block that can model spectro-temporal patterns, 2) a transformer decoder-based attractor (TDA) calculation module that can deal with an unknown number of speakers, and 3) triple-path processing blocks that can model inter-speaker relations. Given a fixed, small set of learned speaker queries and the mixture embedding produced by the dual-path blocks, TDA infers the relations of these queries and generates an attractor vector for each speaker. The estimated attractors are then combined with the mixture embedding by feature-wise linear modulation conditioning, creating a speaker dimension. The mixture embedding, conditioned with speaker information produced by TDA, is fed to the final triple-path blocks, which augment the dual-path blocks with an additional pathway dedicated to inter-speaker processing. The proposed approach outperforms the previous best reported in the literature, achieving 24.0 and 23.7 dB ∆SI-SDR on WSJ0-2 and 3mix respectively, with a single model trained to separate 2-and 3-speaker mixtures. The proposed model also exhibits strong performance and generalizability at counting sources and separating mixtures with up to 5 speakers.
categories: IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing
papers.venue: IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing
papers.topic_name: Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction
papers.justification: 提出基于Transformer decoder吸引子的未知说话者数量分离模型，在WSJ0混合音上取得领先性能，与语音分离方向高度相关且方法具有基础性影响。

chinese_summary.problem: 在未知说话人数量的多说话人混合语音中实现高质量语音分离。
chinese_summary.method: 模型堆叠双路径块（建模谱时模式）、Transformer解码器吸引子（TDA）模块（基于可学习查询生成说话人特定吸引子向量）和三路径块（建模说话人间关系）。TDA利用固定查询从双路径块输出推断吸引子，通过特征线性调制与混合嵌入融合，再送三路径块处理。
chinese_summary.innovation: 提出TDA模块，使用Transformer解码器处理未知说话人数量并生成吸引子；引入三路径网络额外处理说话人交互；单一模型在2和3说话人混合上训练，实现当时最优性能并泛化到5说话人。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在WSJ0-2mix和3mix上分别取得24.0和23.7 dB SI-SDR，超过文献最佳；单一模型泛化到分离5说话人混合并具备源计数能力。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未提及对噪声、混响等复杂场景的鲁棒性；计算复杂度未讨论；对超过5个说话人的性能未知。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接针对语音分离，使用双路径网络和吸引子机制，覆盖盲源分离、时域分离及未知说话人数量场景，与研究方向的speech separation、blind source separation、dual-path network、masking model等关键词高度匹配。

papers.title: UNSSOR: Unsupervised Neural Speech Separation by Leveraging Over-determined Training Mixtures
papers.summary: In reverberant conditions with multiple concurrent speakers, each microphone acquires a mixture signal of multiple speakers at a different location. In over-determined conditions where the microphones out-number speakers, we can narrow down the solutions to speaker images and realize unsupervised speech separation by leveraging each mixture signal as a constraint (i.e., the estimated speaker images at a microphone should add up to the mixture). Equipped with this insight, we propose UNSSOR, an algorithm for $\textbf{u}$nsupervised $\textbf{n}$eural $\textbf{s}$peech $\textbf{s}$eparation by leveraging $\textbf{o}$ver-determined training mixtu$\textbf{r}$es. At each training step, we feed an input mixture to a deep neural network (DNN) to produce an intermediate estimate for each speaker, linearly filter the estimates, and optimize a loss so that, at each microphone, the filtered estimates of all the speakers can add up to the mixture to satisfy the above constraint. We show that this loss can promote unsupervised separation of speakers. The linear filters are computed in each sub-band based on the mixture and DNN estimates through the forward convolutive prediction (FCP) algorithm. To address the frequency permutation problem incurred by using sub-band FCP, a loss term based on minimizing intra-source magnitude scattering is proposed. Although UNSSOR requires over-determined training mixtures, we can train DNNs to achieve under-determined separation (e.g., unsupervised monaural speech separation). Evaluation results on two-speaker separation in reverberant conditions show the effectiveness and potential of UNSSOR.
papers.topic_name: Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction
papers.justification: 提出利用过定训练混合实现无监督神经语音分离，创新性地结合线性滤波与DNN，与语音分离方向高度相关，是NeurIPS高质量工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 在混响多说话人场景下，如何利用过定训练条件（麦克风数量多于说话人）实现无监督的语音分离，突破传统有监督方法对标注数据的依赖。
chinese_summary.method: UNSSOR 方法通过 DNN 对输入混合信号生成各说话人的中间估计，在每个子带上用前向卷积预测（FCP）算法计算线性滤波器，再以滤波后估计之和应等于原始混合为约束优化损失函数，同时引入最小化源内幅度散射损失项以解决子带频域排列歧义，实现无监督训练。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次提出利用过定训练混合作为约束来实现无监督神经语音分离；将 FCP 线性滤波整合到 DNN 训练过程中，使分离目标自然涌现；设计基于最小化源内幅度散射的损失项以应对频率排列问题，无需额外置换解决步骤。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要是及在混响条件下针对双说话人分离进行评估，结果表明 UNSSOR 有效且具潜力，但未给出具体指标。
chinese_summary.limitations: 训练要求麦克风数量大于说话人数量的过定混合，获取成本高；无监督分离性能可能弱于有监督方法；仅验证了双说话人场景，面向更复杂欠定分离的泛化能力需进一步确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 匹配研究方向中的基本关键词‘speech separation’，且提出了一种新的无监督学习范式，可能为有监督分离的预训练或数据增强提供借鉴，但与研究方向侧重有监督、目标说话人提取等核心点的直接关联较弱，需人工细读判断实用性。

papers.title: Flow Matching Guide and Code
papers.summary: Flow Matching (FM) is a recent framework for generative modeling that has achieved state-of-the-art performance across various domains, including image, video, audio, speech, and biological structures. This guide offers a comprehensive and self-contained review of FM, covering its mathematical foundations, design choices, and extensions. By also providing a PyTorch package featuring relevant examples (e.g., image and text generation), this work aims to serve as a resource for both novice and experienced researchers interested in understanding, applying and further developing FM.
papers.justification: 全面综述流匹配生成框架及其在语音等领域的应用，提供代码包，是生成式语音技术方向的重要基础教程与资源。

chinese_summary.problem: 提供Flow Matching生成建模框架的全面自包含指南与代码资源，帮助研究人员理解和应用该框架。
chinese_summary.method: 通过综述形式梳理Flow Matching的数学基础、设计选择与扩展，并给出PyTorch代码包及图像、文本生成示例，以便用户快速上手。
chinese_summary.innovation: 整合Flow Matching的数学基础、设计选择与扩展，提供统一的教程和开源代码库；覆盖图像、视频、音频、语音、生物结构等多个应用领域，为初学者和资深研究者提供一站式资源。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要提及该指南覆盖多个领域并附有PyTorch包与示例，但未给出具体实验指标或语音生成实例。
chinese_summary.limitations: 作为指南与工具，缺乏特定领域的深入实验验证；代码示例可能不直接包含语音生成任务，需自行适配。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 研究方向涉及扩散模型与流匹配在语音生成中的应用，该指南提供Flow Matching的通用数学框架与代码，可为生成式语音增强、合成等任务提供理论基础与实现参考，但需确认代码对语音处理的直接支持程度。

papers.title: InstructTTS: Modelling Expressive TTS in Discrete Latent Space With Natural Language Style Prompt
papers.summary: Expressive text-to-speech (TTS) aims to synthesize speech with varying speaking styles to better reflect human speech patterns. In this study, we attempt to use natural language as a style prompt to control the styles in the synthetic speech, e.g., “Sigh tone in full of sad mood with some helpless feeling”. Considering that there is no existing TTS corpus that is suitable to benchmark this novel task, we first construct a speech corpus whose speech samples are annotated with not only content transcriptions but also style descriptions in natural language. Then we propose an expressive TTS model, named InstructTTS, which is novel in the sense of the following aspects: (1) We fully take advantage of self-supervised learning and cross-modal metric learning and propose a novel three-stage training procedure to obtain a robust sentence embedding model that can effectively capture semantic information from the style prompts and control the speaking style in the generated speech. (2) We propose to model acoustic features in discrete latent space and train a novel discrete diffusion probabilistic model to generate vector-quantized (VQ) acoustic tokens rather than the commonly-used mel spectrogram. (3) We jointly apply mutual information (MI) estimation and minimization during acoustic model training to minimize style-speaker and style-content MI, avoiding possible content and speaker information leakage from the style prompt. Extensive objective and subjective evaluation has been conducted to verify the effectiveness and expressiveness of InstructTTS. Experimental results show that InstructTTS can synthesize high-fidelity and natural speech with style prompts controlling the speaking style.
categories: IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio Speech and Language Processing
papers.venue: IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio Speech and Language Processing
papers.justification: 论文提出InstructTTS，利用自然语言风格提示控制合成语音风格，在离散潜在空间建模声学特征并训练离散扩散模型，高度契合生成式语音技术方向，方法新颖、质量扎实，是必读级工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 如何利用自然语言风格描述作为提示，控制语音合成中的说话风格，以生成具有多样风格表现力的语音。
chinese_summary.method: 提出InstructTTS模型，首先构建带风格描述的语音数据集；然后通过三阶段训练，利用自监督学习和跨模态度量学习获得句子嵌入模型，以捕获风格语义；接着在离散潜空间中，训练离散扩散概率模型生成向量量化（VQ）声学令牌，替代传统梅尔频谱；最后在声学模型训练中联合进行互信息估计与最小化，以减少风格提示向内容和说话人信息的泄漏。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次构建带自然语言风格标注的TTS数据集；采用三阶段训练获得鲁棒的风格句子嵌入；创新性地在离散潜空间中用离散扩散模型建模声学特征，并引入互信息最小化防止信息泄漏。
chinese_summary.evidence: 进行了广泛的客观指标和主观听感评估，结果显示InstructTTS能合成高保真、自然的语音，且风格提示有效控制说话风格。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未提及模型对未见过风格提示的泛化能力、生成速度、以及离散扩散模型的采样效率；需要阅读全文确认风格控制的粒度和局限性。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文研究使用离散扩散概率模型进行富有表现力的文本到语音合成，与研究方向中的语音合成、TTS、扩散模型语音、神经声码器高度匹配。离散扩散生成VQ声学令牌的方法直接关联生成式模型在语音合成中的应用。

papers.title: Speak, Read and Prompt: High-Fidelity Text-to-Speech with Minimal Supervision
papers.summary: Abstract We introduce SPEAR-TTS, a multi-speaker text-to-speech (TTS) system that can be trained with minimal supervision. By combining two types of discrete speech representations, we cast TTS as a composition of two sequence-to-sequence tasks: from text to high-level semantic tokens (akin to “reading”) and from semantic tokens to low-level acoustic tokens (“speaking”). Decoupling these two tasks enables training of the “speaking” module using abundant audio-only data, and unlocks the highly efficient combination of pretraining and backtranslation to reduce the need for parallel data when training the “reading” component. To control the speaker identity, we adopt example prompting, which allows SPEAR-TTS to generalize to unseen speakers using only a short sample of 3 seconds, without any explicit speaker representation or speaker labels. Our experiments demonstrate that SPEAR-TTS achieves a character error rate that is competitive with state-of-the-art methods using only 15 minutes of parallel data, while matching ground-truth speech in naturalness and acoustic quality.
categories: Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics
papers.venue: Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics
papers.justification: 提出解耦文本到语义和语义到声学的TTS框架，结合离散表示与提示控制，在极少平行数据下实现高保真多说话人合成，是生成式语音技术方向的代表性工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 训练高保真多说话人TTS系统通常依赖大量对齐文本-语音数据，本文旨在以极少量监督数据（如15分钟）实现竞争性能，降低数据需求。
chinese_summary.method: 将TTS分解为两个序列到序列任务：文本到高层语义token（“阅读”）和语义token到低层声学token（“说话”）。解耦后，“说话”模块可利用海量无文本音频训练，而“阅读”模块通过预训练和回译技术减少对平行数据的需求。说话人身份由3秒示例提示控制，无需显式说话人表征或标签。
chinese_summary.innovation: 通过离散语义-声学两级token化，将TTS解耦为可分别优化的两个阶段，使得“说话”模块能充分利用无监督音频数据；引入回译与预训练策略，极大降低“阅读”模块对平行数据的依赖；采用示例提示实现零样本说话人适应，无需任何说话人标签。
chinese_summary.evidence: 实验表明，仅使用15分钟平行数据，SPEAR-TTS的字符错误率与现有最佳方法相当，且在自然度和声学质量上与真实语音无显著差异。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未明确说明离散表示的来源与具体架构（如是否基于HuBERT），也未提及在噪声、多语种等复杂场景下的表现；自然度评估可能依赖主观指标，客观评估细节不足；模型规模与推理效率未知。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接属于语音合成（TTS）领域，与研究方向中的“语音合成和TTS”高度匹配；提出的低资源训练和说话人泛化方法，为生成式语音技术的效率提升提供了新思路，可能对语音增强、修复等任务中离散表示的应用有启发。

papers.title: E2 TTS: Embarrassingly Easy Fully Non-Autoregressive Zero-Shot TTS
papers.summary: This paper introduces Embarrassingly Easy Text-to-Speech (E2 TTS), a fully non-autoregressive zero-shot text-to-speech system that offers human-level naturalness and state-of-the-art speaker similarity and intelligibility. In the E2 TTS framework, the text input is converted into a character sequence with filler tokens. The flow-matching-based mel spectrogram generator is then trained based on the audio infilling task. Unlike many previous works, it does not require additional components (e.g., duration model, grapheme-to-phoneme) or complex techniques (e.g., monotonic alignment search). Despite its simplicity, E2 TTS achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot TTS capabilities that are comparable to or surpass previous works, including Voicebox and NaturalSpeech 3. The simplicity of E2 TTS also allows for flexibility in the input representation. We propose several variants of E2 TTS to improve usability during inference. See https://aka.ms/e2tts/for demo samples.
papers.justification: 该论文提出极简的全非自回归零样本TTS，基于流匹配与音频填充，无需额外对齐模块，性能比肩或超越Voicebox等，是生成式语音方向的必读基线工作，引用数高，基础性强。

chinese_summary.problem: 如何设计一个简单而有效的完全非自回归零样本文本到语音系统，无需额外的时长模型、音素转换或单调对齐搜索等复杂组件。
chinese_summary.method: E2 TTS 将文本输入转换为带填充标记的字符序列，并使用基于流匹配的梅尔频谱生成器，通过音频填充任务进行训练，直接生成梅尔频谱，再通过声码器合成语音。系统完全非自回归，无需时长预测和音素对齐。
chinese_summary.innovation: 1) 首次提出完全基于字符和填充标记的输入表示，摒弃了音素转换和显式时长建模；2) 利用流匹配在音频填充任务上训练，避免单调对齐搜索等复杂技巧；3) 框架极致简单，却达到与复杂系统相当的性能，且推理时输入表示可灵活调整。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要声称达到人类水平自然度、最先进的说话人相似度和可懂度，性能与 Voicebox 和 NaturalSpeech 3 可比或超越；提供了演示样例链接。
chinese_summary.limitations: 未提供定量指标和对比细节，仅定性声明；需阅读全文确认数据集、模型规模、训练资源和泛化能力；推理效率未提及。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 直接属于我的研究方向中的 text-to-speech 和 flow matching speech 部分，论文核心方法基于流匹配生成梅尔频谱，适合关注零样本 TTS 和简化生成式语音合成模型。

papers.title: Better speech synthesis through scaling
papers.summary: In recent years, the field of image generation has been revolutionized by the application of autoregressive transformers and DDPMs. These approaches model the process of image generation as a step-wise probabilistic processes and leverage large amounts of compute and data to learn the image distribution. This methodology of improving performance need not be confined to images. This paper describes a way to apply advances in the image generative domain to speech synthesis. The result is TorToise -- an expressive, multi-voice text-to-speech system. All model code and trained weights have been open-sourced at https://github.com/neonbjb/tortoise-tts.
papers.justification: 该论文提出TorToise TTS，将自回归与扩散模型应用于语音合成，是生成式语音方向的重要基线，高度相关且具影响力。

chinese_summary.problem: 如何将图像生成领域基于自回归Transformer和扩散模型（DDPMs）的大规模计算与数据范式应用于语音合成，以提升语音合成质量与表现力。
chinese_summary.method: 采用自回归Transformer与去噪扩散概率模型（DDPMs）相结合的步进式概率生成过程，利用大规模计算资源与数据学习语音分布，构建多音色文本到语音系统TorToise。
chinese_summary.innovation: 将图像生成中成功的缩放定律（scaling）和概率生成范式迁移至语音合成，实现了表现力强、多音色的语音生成；开源了完整模型代码与预训练权重。
chinese_summary.evidence: 原文提供了开源系统TorToise的具体实现，包括模型代码与训练权重（GitHub链接），但摘要中未给出听觉或定量实验指标。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未提供客观评估指标（如MOS）或与现有TTS系统的对比；扩散模型的采样速度及自回归结构的推理效率需阅读全文确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接属于语音合成（TTS）和生成式语音技术，明确采用了扩散模型（DDPMs）这一研究方向的核心方法，与“generative speech synthesis”“diffusion model speech”“text-to-speech”等关键词高度匹配。

papers.title: MuseCoco: Generating Symbolic Music from Text
papers.summary: Generating music from text descriptions is a user-friendly mode since the text is a relatively easy interface for user engagement. While some approaches utilize texts to control music audio generation, editing musical elements in generated audio is challenging for users. In contrast, symbolic music offers ease of editing, making it more accessible for users to manipulate specific musical elements. In this paper, we propose MuseCoco, which generates symbolic music from text descriptions with musical attributes as the bridge to break down the task into text-to-attribute understanding and attribute-to-music generation stages. MuseCoCo stands for Music Composition Copilot that empowers musicians to generate music directly from given text descriptions, offering a significant improvement in efficiency compared to creating music entirely from scratch. The system has two main advantages: Firstly, it is data efficient. In the attribute-to-music generation stage, the attributes can be directly extracted from music sequences, making the model training self-supervised. In the text-to-attribute understanding stage, the text is synthesized and refined by ChatGPT based on the defined attribute templates. Secondly, the system can achieve precise control with specific attributes in text descriptions and offers multiple control options through attribute-conditioned or text-conditioned approaches. MuseCoco outperforms baseline systems in terms of musicality, controllability, and overall score by at least 1.27, 1.08, and 1.32 respectively. Besides, there is a notable enhancement of about 20% in objective control accuracy.
