In addition, we have developed a robust large-scale model with 1.2 billion parameters, showcasing exceptional controllability and musicality.
papers.justification: 针对文本到符号音乐生成，符合音乐理解与生成方向，但引用数一般，尚未成为广泛应用的基线，非必读经典基础工作

chinese_summary.problem: 如何从文本描述生成可编辑的符号音乐，以便用户更灵活地操控音乐元素。
chinese_summary.method: MuseCoco将任务分解为文本到属性理解和属性到音乐生成两个阶段：首先利用ChatGPT基于预定义模板合成文本并提取属性，然后在自监督设置下直接从音乐序列中提取属性训练生成模型。
chinese_summary.innovation: 无需人工标注的数据高效设计，属性可直接从音乐中提取实现自监督学习；通过属性桥接实现文本到音乐的精确控制，并支持属性条件或文本条件多种控制方式。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在音乐性、可控性、总体得分上分别比基线高至少1.27、1.08、1.32分，客观控制精度提升约20%，并训练了一个12亿参数的大规模模型展示了出色的可控性和音乐性。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未明确实验中使用的基线系统名称；生成的符号音乐的具体格式（如MIDI）和评估细节需阅读全文；对于复杂文本描述的泛化能力未提及。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 匹配研究方向中的音乐生成（music generation）和自监督音频（self-supervised）在属性到音乐阶段的自监督学习，但论文聚焦于符号音乐而非音频表示学习，与音乐信息检索的核心任务关联较弱。

papers.title: The Song Describer Dataset: a Corpus of Audio Captions for Music-and-Language Evaluation
papers.summary: We introduce the Song Describer dataset (SDD), a new crowdsourced corpus of high-quality audio-caption pairs, designed for the evaluation of music-and-language models. The dataset consists of 1.1k human-written natural language descriptions of 706 music recordings, all publicly accessible and released under Creative Common licenses. To showcase the use of our dataset, we benchmark popular models on three key music-and-language tasks (music captioning, text-to-music generation and music-language retrieval). Our experiments highlight the importance of cross-dataset evaluation and offer insights into how researchers can use SDD to gain a broader understanding of model performance.
papers.justification: 该论文构建了音乐音频-文本描述数据集SDD，用于音乐-语言模型评估，属于音乐信息检索与表示领域，质量扎实但非核心必读。

chinese_summary.problem: 论文解决音乐-语言模型评估中缺乏高质量人工标注音乐描述数据集的问题。
chinese_summary.method: 通过众包方式收集706段音乐录音的1.1k条自然语言描述，构建Song Describer数据集；使用该数据集在音乐字幕、文本生成音乐和音乐-语言检索三个任务上对流行模型进行基准测试，以展示跨数据集评估的重要性。
chinese_summary.innovation: 提出了一个公开可用的高质量音乐描述数据集，所有音频均采用Creative Commons许可；通过跨数据集评估揭示了现有模型在不同数据分布下的性能差异，为音乐-语言任务的标准化评估提供了新基准。
chinese_summary.evidence: 实验证据不足：摘要仅提及在三个任务上基准测试了流行模型，未给出具体性能指标或对比结果。
chinese_summary.limitations: 数据集规模较小（仅1.1k描述），可能影响评估的统计显著性；未提出新的评估指标或模型改进；依赖众包质量，描述的主观性可能引入噪声。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 数据集可用于评估音乐表示学习模型在下游任务（如音乐字幕、检索）的性能，与研究方向中的音乐信息检索、音乐理解和自监督音频表示的应用评估相关，但论文自身未贡献新的表示学习方法或编码器。

papers.title: Memory Efficient Audio Synthesis with Decoupled Temporal Depth Diffusion Transformers
papers.summary: Siri Expressive Voices synthesize rich, configurable speech in real time and entirely on device, powered by AFM 3 Core Advanced, Apple's most powerful on-device foundation model. This work presents the memory-efficient audio synthesis architecture behind that capability: a detokenizer that converts the semantic audio tokens emitted by the foundation model into high-fidelity audio within the tight compute and memory budget of the Apple Matrix Coprocessor (AMX). We convert semantic audio tokens to a residual vector quantization (RVQ) representation with a three-component design, a streaming encoder, a temporal decoder, and a depth decoder, that systematically decouples temporal and depth processing. A single reusable depth decoder with Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-style stage conditioning generates all RVQ levels autoregressively, replacing the dedicated per-level decoders of prior multi-decoder architectures, while causal sliding window attention with fixed-window key-value caching yields constant memory complexity independent of sequence length. Deployed on the AMX, the detokenizer sustains roughly 10 ms per generation step, about 16x faster than real time, with a peak runtime memory of only 21 MB and 329 MB of on-device assets, enabling continuous streaming synthesis of 20-320 seconds of audio. This constant, small footprint replaces the linear and quadratic memory scaling of conventional transformer- and GAN-based approaches. Ablation studies validate the key architectural components, and audio quality assessment confirms that the architecture maintains synthesis fidelity while achieving efficiency gains over existing methods. Operating at a 1-billion-parameter activation size within AFM 3 Core Advanced, it improves Mean Opinion Score by +0.28 overall (4.15 vs. 3.87) and by +0.42 on conversational speech (4.24 vs. 3.82) over the prior on-device text-to-speech system.
papers.justification: 提出解耦时间深度扩散变换器，在设备端以极低内存实现实时高质量语音合成，属于生成式语音技术必读前沿工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 在设备端资源严格受限下，实现从语义音频令牌到高保真语音的实时合成，克服传统模型内存随序列长度线性或二次增长的问题。
chinese_summary.method: 提出一种三组件架构：流式编码器、时间解码器和深度解码器，将语义令牌转为残差矢量量化（RVQ）表示。通过解耦时间和深度处理，使用单个可重用的深度解码器（基于扩散变换器DiT，带阶段条件化）自回归生成所有RVQ层级，替代传统的每层级独立解码器。采用因果滑动窗口注意力与固定窗口键值缓存，实现恒定的O(1)内存复杂度，不随序列长度增长。整体部署在Apple矩阵协处理器上。
chinese_summary.innovation: 创新地解耦时间与深度维度，用一个带阶段条件的扩散变换器统一完成所有RVQ层级的生成，大幅减少模型参数和内存；通过因果滑动窗口注意力与固定窗口缓存，首次在语音合成降码器上实现恒定内存占用，突破了传统Transformer和GAN的线性/二次内存增长瓶颈；在设备端实现实时流式合成，兼顾高合成质量与极低资源消耗。
chinese_summary.evidence: 系统在Apple AMX上每生成步骤约10ms，比实时快16倍，峰值运行时内存仅21MB，资产329MB，可连续流式合成20-320秒音频。消融实验验证了关键架构组件的有效性，音频质量评估显示MOS总分提升0.28（4.15 vs. 3.87），对话语音MOS提升0.42（4.24 vs. 3.82），均优于上一代设备端TTS系统。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未提及模型在不同语言、说话人风格或噪声环境下的泛化性能；未知是否适用于除Apple AMX外的其他硬件平台；语义令牌的生成依赖上游基础模型，完整流水线的端到端表现未说明；可能需要阅读全文确认扩散步骤数、训练策略及对非语音音频的适用性。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 研究方向聚焦生成式语音技术，包括语音合成、TTS、神经声码器、扩散模型语音生成等。该论文直接提出一种基于扩散变换器的神经声码器/降码器架构，用于从令牌到波形的合成，属于设备端TTS系统的核心组件，与关键词“speech synthesis, text-to-speech, neural vocoder, diffusion model speech”精确匹配，且解决了实践中的内存效率瓶颈，对实际部署有重要参考价值。

papers.title: Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS: Freely Controllable and Highly Robust Speech Synthesis with Multi-Stage Training Paradigm
papers.summary: In this report, we present Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS, a production-oriented speech synthesis system that jointly advances content consistency, speaker similarity, prosodic naturalness, audio quality, controllability, multilingual coverage, efficiency, and robustness. It combines a 12.5~Hz low-frame-rate speech tokenizer for reduced inference latency with a five-stage progressive training paradigm for coordinated language model (LM) and flow-matching model (FM) optimization. The model provides production-level control through free-style natural-language instructions and fine-grained inline tags, while supporting 16 languages, 20 Chinese dialect regions, one-pass long-form synthesis up to 3 minutes, and robust generation from noisy, reverberant, or unclear reference speech. Across SEED-TTS-Eval, CV3-Eval, instruction-following, long-form, and acoustic-robustness evaluations, Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS achieves state-of-the-art performance on many reported dimensions or the strongest aggregate results. It also ranks first on the independent Artificial Analysis Text-to-Speech Leaderboard. These results establish Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS as a strong foundation for production-level speech synthesis.
papers.justification: 该工作直接对应生成式语音技术方向，提出多阶段训练范式实现高度可控、鲁棒的多语言语音合成，性能达到SOTA，属前沿必读。

chinese_summary.problem: 论文旨在构建一个生产级语音合成系统，联合提升内容一致性、说话人相似度、韵律自然度、音频质量、可控性、多语言覆盖、推理效率和声学鲁棒性，以解决现有TTS系统在实际部署中面临的多维度性能不足。
chinese_summary.method: 系统采用12.5 Hz低帧率语音分词器降低推理延迟，并设计五阶段渐进训练范式协同优化语言模型和流匹配模型。支持自由形式自然语言指令和细粒度标签实现灵活控制，覆盖16种语言、20种汉语方言，并支持最长3分钟的长文本一次性合成，同时从噪声、混响或不清晰参考语音中鲁棒生成。
chinese_summary.innovation: 1. 提出了五阶段渐进训练范式，有效协调语言模型和流匹配模型的联合学习；2. 采用极低帧率（12.5 Hz）语音分词器，显著提升推理效率；3. 结合自然语言指令和细粒度标签提供生产级可控性，并在多语言、长语音和强噪声场景下实现SOTA性能。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在SEED-TTS-Eval、CV3-Eval、指令跟随、长形式合成和声学鲁棒性等多项评估中达到最优或综合最强结果，并在独立机构Artificial Analysis的TTS排行榜上排名第一。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未提供各评测维度的详细数值，无法判断是否所有维度均有提升；多阶段训练的实际收敛性和资源消耗未说明；低帧率分词器对音质的影响需全文确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接属于语音合成（TTS）领域，核心使用流匹配生成模型，匹配您的研究关键词‘speech synthesis’、‘text-to-speech’、‘flow matching speech’和‘generative model audio’。其系统级设计亦涉及效率和鲁棒性，与生成式语音增强的瓶颈相关。

papers.title: Mamba in Speech: Towards an Alternative to Self-Attention
papers.summary: Transformer and its derivatives have achieved success in diverse tasks across computer vision, natural language processing, and speech processing. To reduce the complexity of computations within the multi-head self-attention mechanism in Transformer, Selective State Space Models (i.e., Mamba) were proposed as an alternative. Mamba exhibited its effectiveness in natural language processing and computer vision tasks, but its superiority has rarely been investigated in speech signal processing. This paper explores solutions for applying Mamba to speech processing by discussing two typical speech processing tasks: speech recognition, which requires semantic and sequential information, and speech enhancement, which focuses primarily on sequential patterns. The experimental results confirm that bidirectional Mamba (BiMamba) consistently outperforms vanilla Mamba, highlighting the advantages of a bidirectional design for speech processing. Moreover, experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of BiMamba as an alternative to the self-attention module in the Transformer model and its derivates, particularly for the semantic-aware task. The crucial technologies for transferring Mamba to speech are then summarized in ablation studies and the discussion section, offering insights for extending this research to a broader scope of tasks.
categories: IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing
papers.justification: 该论文系统性地将Mamba结构引入语音处理领域，验证双向Mamba可替代自注意力机制，在语音增强等任务中表现优异，与语音增强研究方向高度相关，且具有开创性，是必读级别的基础性工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 探索如何将选择性状态空间模型Mamba应用于语音处理，以替代Transformer中的自注意力机制，降低计算复杂度。
chinese_summary.method: 采用双向Mamba（BiMamba）替换Transformer中的自注意力模块，在语音识别（需语义和序列信息）和语音增强（需序列模式）两个典型任务上验证，并通过消融研究总结Mamba迁移至语音的关键技术。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次系统研究Mamba在语音信号处理中的应用，验证双向Mamba优于单向Mamba；证明BiMamba可作为自注意力模块的有效替代，尤其在语义感知任务上；通过消融实验提供将Mamba扩展到更广泛语音任务的指导。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要提及实验确认双向Mamba优于vanilla Mamba，且作为自注意力替代有效，但未给出具体指标数据。
chinese_summary.limitations: 仅涉及语音识别和语音增强两个任务，缺乏更广泛语音处理任务的验证；未提供量化性能对比；语音增强任务可能仅为序列模式应用的简单验证，深度和效果未知。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文包含语音增强任务，使用BiMamba替代自注意力模块，可能为语音增强模型架构设计提供新思路，但文章重点在Mamba替代自注意力且更关注语义任务，语音增强贡献有限，需人工复核具体增强性能。

papers.title: Extracting Voice Styles from Frozen TTS Models via Gradient-Based Inverse Optimization
papers.summary: Some text-to-speech systems ship a synthesis model and preset style vectors but not the reference encoder that turns audio into such a vector. The model still accepts a style vector; a user with a voice of their own cannot produce one. We solve for that input directly, inverting the released pipeline by gradient descent: every weight stays frozen and only the style vector is optimized, against time-pooled WavLM statistics of one recording. Because the objective discards the time axis, the synthesized text may differ from the recording, so no transcript and no alignment are needed. On 154 speakers from two corpora, ECAPA-TDNN similarity rises from 0.132 to 0.413 and ResNet from 0.099 to 0.401, improving for every speaker; a verifier at its equal-error point accepts 53% of the recovered voices as the target, against 1% for the presets they start from.
papers.justification: 提出通过梯度优化从冻结TTS模型中反向提取声音风格向量的新方法，无需参考编码器或对齐，与生成语音技术高度相关，质量扎实。

chinese_summary.problem: 部分TTS系统虽提供合成模型与预设风格向量，却未附带可从用户语音中提取风格向量的编码器，导致用户无法将自己的声音转换为风格向量来驱动合成。
chinese_summary.method: 将TTS合成模型冻结，仅优化输入风格向量，利用梯度下降最小化合成语音与目标录音在WavLM时间池化后统计量之间的差异。由于目标函数丢弃时间轴，合成文本可与录音内容不同，从而无需对齐和转录。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次提出通过梯度逆优化直接从冻结TTS模型中恢复风格向量，无需依赖参考编码器；利用WavLM的时间池化特征定义损失，解除了对文本和音素对齐的要求，使方案具有录音内容无关性。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在154名说话人上进行验证，ECAPA-TDNN说话人相似度从0.132提升至0.413，ResNet相似度从0.099提升至0.401，每名说话人均有改善；等错误点验证器对恢复声音的接受率为53%，而预设风格仅1%。
chinese_summary.limitations: 实验仅报告了说话人相似度指标，未评估合成语音自然度或可懂度；梯度优化过程的计算开销未讨论；方法对特定TTS架构的泛化性需进一步验证。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 直接命中研究方向关键词“text-to-speech”，论文涉及TTS模型下的风格向量提取，可为生成式语音合成中的个性化风格控制提供技术参考。但主要解决提取而非生成问题，故相关程度中等。

papers.title: Let Me Look at You: Advanced Facial Expression Modeling for Conversational Speech Synthesis
papers.summary: Conversational Speech Synthesis is a fundamental component of human-computer interaction, aiming to generate contextually appropriate, expressive, and empathetic speech. However, facial expressions encode subtle and rich affective cues that are crucial for empathetic speech interaction, whereas existing approaches often overlook this important modality. In addition, the lack of large-scale natural conversational datasets with both speech and visual modalities also limits the development of visual affect understanding in conversational settings.To address these limitations, we propose FacialTalker, a facial-expression-aware CSS framework built upon a large language model backbone. To efficiently encode facial expressions, we propose AUTokenizer, a single-codebook visual tokenizer that discretizes each frame-level facial expression into a compact token, trained with supervision from combinations of facial Action Units. We further introduce a dual direct preference optimization (DualDPO) strategy, which extends the DPO by jointly imposing preference constraints on both visual and speech token sequences, to enhance the model's understanding of facial expressions and speech semantics in multimodal conversational contexts. Moreover, we construct VSDD-1K, a large-scale multimodal dialogue dataset collected through a fully automated pipeline from real-world Internet conversations, comprising over 1,033 hours of synchronized speaker videos and speech, with more than 85\% of frames containing valid faces. Extensive objective and subjective experiments demonstrate that FacialTalker consistently outperforms strong baselines in facial-expression perception and speech synthesis quality, generating speech that is more natural, expressive, and better aligned with the conversational context. The results also validate the effectiveness of our training strategy and dataset construction pipeline.
papers.justification: 该论文提出融合面部表情的对话语音合成框架，引入AUTokenizer和DualDPO策略，构建大规模多模态数据集，生成更自然、富有表现力的语音，与生成式语音技术方向高度相关，质量扎实。

chinese_summary.problem: 在对话语音合成中，现有方法忽视面部表情这一重要情感模态，且缺乏大规模多模态对话数据集，导致生成的语音缺乏表现力和上下文对齐。
chinese_summary.method: 提出FacialTalker框架，以大型语言模型为骨干，利用AUTokenizer将帧级面部表情离散化为紧凑视觉标记（受面部动作单元监督训练），并通过双直接偏好优化（DualDPO）联合约束视觉和语音标记序列，增强多模态语义理解。同时构建了大规模同步视频-语音对话数据集VSDD-1K。
chinese_summary.innovation: 1) 设计AUTokenizer，将面部表情高效编码为单一码本标记，并用面部动作单元信号监督，实现表情的紧凑离散化。2) 引入DualDPO策略，同时对视觉和语音标记序列施加偏好约束，提升模型对表情和语音的多模态感知能力。3) 构建超过1033小时、85%以上帧含有效面部的大规模多模态对话数据集VSDD-1K，推动视觉情感理解在对话场景的研究。
chinese_summary.evidence: 进行了客观和主观实验，结果显示 FacialTalker 在面部表情感知和语音合成质量上持续优于强基线，生成了更自然、更富表现力且与对话上下文对齐更佳的语音，从而验证了方法和数据集的有效性。摘要未提供具体指标数值。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未说明 LLM 骨干的具体选择与集成方式；数据集收集的全自动流程可能存在噪声和偏差；方法依赖面部视频输入，限制了对纯语音场景的适用性；DualDPO 的训练效果和泛化能力需全文验证。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 该论文属于语音合成领域，与您研究方向的 speech synthesis 和 TTS 部分表面相关，但核心方法基于 LLM 和标记化，并非扩散模型或流匹配等生成模型；此外，其重点在多模态融入和对话场景，而非生成式增强或声码器。建议人工复核，以判断其技术思想是否可迁移。

papers.title: faster-enhancer.c: A Dependency-Free int8 Runtime for Streaming Speech Enhancement on Commodity CPUs
papers.summary: This is an implementation and measurement study of what it costs to run a streaming speech enhancer on a CPU. We port FastEnhancer-Medium at 48 kHz to faster-enhancer.c, a C runtime with six int8 GEMM tiers selected at initialization, leaving architecture and weights untouched. One Apple M2 core reaches 0.069 real-time factor, against 0.230 for the fp32 ONNX Runtime graph on the same machine, a 3.3x speedup. A Galaxy S23+ (Snapdragon 8 Gen 2) reaches 0.096. The speedup comes from specializing every layer of the runtime around one fixed model. Activation ranges are recomputed per frame, so no calibration set is needed; the k=3 convolutions use Winograd F(2,3); cross-stage state is fp16; the GRU and the dequantization epilogues are fused; and nothing is allocated after startup. Over 824 VoiceBank-DEMAND utterances the engine tracks fp32 to within -0.006 PESQ and -0.08 dB SNR. Speed alone does not settle deployment cost. The enhancer holds a fraction of a core for as long as the microphone is open, so its real-time factor is a duty cycle. A benchmark races through a file; an audio callback does not. Pacing to the 6.67 ms deadline costs 4.2x per frame, saves 49% of the energy, and leaves the cheapest core placement missing 96% of its deadlines. All SIMD tiers within an architecture family emit byte-identical output. The runtime is released as a dependency-free library.
papers.justification: 提出针对FastEnhancer-Medium的高效int8推理运行时，实现实时流式语音增强，与语音增强方向相关，工程优化扎实，但核心贡献在于系统实现而非增强算法本身的创新。

chinese_summary.problem: 如何在消费级CPU上以极低实时因子和能耗部署流式语音增强模型，同时保持与浮点模型相当的语音质量。
chinese_summary.method: 设计无依赖的C运行时faster-enhancer.c，将预训练的FastEnhancer-Medium模型转换为int8 GEMM，通过每帧动态计算激活范围避免校准集，采用Winograd F(2,3)加速3×3卷积，跨阶段状态保持fp16，融合GRU与反量化尾声，启动后零内存分配。初始化时从六个SIMD层级中选择最优配置，并通过音频回调节奏控制（pacing）将处理对齐到6.67 ms窗口，牺牲部分吞吐以换取低占空比和节能。
chinese_summary.innovation: 1) 无需校准数据集的在线量化方法，每帧独立计算激活范围，保证量化精度；2) 针对单一模型极度特化的运行时设计，层间融合、固定内存与Winograd卷积共同实现显著加速；3) 引入面向占空比的调度策略，以节能和满足截止时间为目标，而非单纯追求高吞吐，为实际部署提供新视角。
chinese_summary.evidence: 实验显示Apple M2单核实时因子0.069（fp32 ONNX Runtime为0.230），Galaxy S23+为0.096，加速达3.3倍；在824条VoiceBank-DEMAND测试中，PESQ损失仅0.006，SNR损失0.08 dB；节奏控制使每帧成本增加4.2倍，但节省49%能耗，最便宜核心放置无法满足截止时间；同一架构不同SIMD层级输出字节完全一致。
chinese_summary.limitations: 仅针对FastEnhancer-Medium模型，通用性未验证；量化恢复精度仅在VoiceBank-DEMAND上测试，其他噪声环境未评估；未探讨多通道或自适应场景下的性能。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 仅与‘speech enhancement’关键词外围相关，研究方向侧重生成式方法（扩散模型、流匹配等），本文不涉及生成式技术，而是传统增强模型的工程加速，匹配度低。如有部署需求可参考其优化技巧，但与生成式语音无直接联系。

papers.title: USEF-TSE: Universal Speaker Embedding Free Target Speaker Extraction
papers.summary: Target speaker extraction aims to separate the voice of a specific speaker from mixed speech. Traditionally, this process has relied on extracting a speaker embedding from a reference speech, in which a speaker recognition model is required. However, identifying an appropriate speaker recognition model can be challenging, and using the target speaker embedding as reference information may not be optimal for target speaker extraction tasks. This paper introduces a Universal Speaker Embedding-Free Target Speaker Extraction (USEF-TSE) framework that operates without relying on speaker embeddings. USEF-TSE utilizes a multi-head cross-attention mechanism as a frame-level target speaker feature extractor. This innovative approach allows mainstream speaker extraction solutions to bypass the dependency on speaker recognition models and better leverage the information available in the enrollment speech, including speaker characteristics and contextual details. Additionally, USEF-TSE can seamlessly integrate with other time-domain or time-frequency domain speech separation models to achieve effective speaker extraction. Experimental results show that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in terms of Scale-Invariant Signal-to-Distortion Ratio (SI-SDR) on the WSJ0-2mix, WHAM!, and WHAMR! datasets, which are standard benchmarks for monaural anechoic, noisy and noisy-reverberant two-speaker speech separation and speaker extraction. The results on the LibriMix and the blind test set of the ICASSP2023 DNS Challenge demonstrate that the model performs well on more diverse and out-of-domain data.
categories: IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing
papers.topic_name: Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction
papers.justification: 该论文提出无需说话人嵌入的目标说话人提取框架USEF-TSE，采用多头交叉注意力提取帧级特征，在多个基准上达到SOTA，与语音分离和目标说话人提取研究方向高度相关，方法新颖且性能优异，属于必读级别工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 传统目标说话人提取依赖说话人识别模型提取说话人嵌入，但选择合适模型困难，且嵌入可能非最优。本文解决如何在不使用说话人嵌入的情况下，有效利用注册语音信息进行目标说话人提取。
chinese_summary.method: 提出USEF-TSE框架，采用多头交叉注意力机制作为帧级目标说话人特征提取器，直接从注册语音中提取说话人特征和上下文细节，并能与时域或时频域语音分离模型无缝集成。
chinese_summary.innovation: 提出无说话人嵌入的目标说话人提取框架，摆脱对说话人识别模型的依赖；使用多头交叉注意力直接建模注册语音与混合语音的交互，更充分利用注册语音信息；可灵活嵌入现有分离模型。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在WSJ0-2mix、WHAM!、WHAMR!上达到SOTA SI-SDR，并在LibriMix和DNS Challenge盲测上表现良好，证明有效性和泛化性。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未提及模型复杂度、实时性、对注册语音长度的要求、在更多说话人场景下的表现，以及注意力机制可能引入的计算开销。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 直接属于目标说话人提取研究，匹配关键词target speaker extraction、speaker extraction、speech separation；提出的方法与我的研究方向紧密相关，可避免依赖外部说话人识别系统，有潜在应用价值。

papers.title: Universal Source Separation with Weakly Labelled Data
papers.summary: Universal source separation (USS) is a fundamental research task for computational auditory scene analysis, which aims to separate mono recordings into individual source tracks. There are three potential challenges awaiting the solution to the audio source separation task. First, previous audio source separation systems mainly focus on separating one or a limited number of specific sources. There is a lack of research on building a unified system that can separate arbitrary sources via a single model. Second, most previous systems require clean source data to train a separator, while clean source data are scarce. Third, there is a lack of USS system that can automatically detect and separate active sound classes in a hierarchical level. To use large-scale weakly labeled/unlabeled audio data for audio source separation, we propose a universal audio source separation framework containing: 1) an audio tagging model trained on weakly labeled data as a query net; and 2) a conditional source separation model that takes query net outputs as conditions to separate arbitrary sound sources. We investigate various query nets, source separation models, and training strategies and propose a hierarchical USS strategy to automatically detect and separate sound classes from the AudioSet ontology. By solely leveraging the weakly labelled AudioSet, our USS system is successful in separating a wide variety of sound classes, including sound event separation, music source separation, and speech enhancement. The USS system achieves an average signal-to-distortion ratio improvement (SDRi) of 5.57 dB over 527 sound classes of AudioSet; 10.57 dB on the DCASE 2018 Task 2 dataset; 8.12 dB on the MUSDB18 dataset; an SDRi of 7.28 dB on the Slakh2100 dataset; and an SSNR of 9.00 dB on the voicebank-demand dataset. We release the source code at https://github.com/bytedance/uss
papers.justification: 提出了基于弱标签的通用源分离框架，可统一处理语音增强、音乐分离等任务，与语音增强和语音分离方向高度相关，方法新颖且具有基础性影响。

chinese_summary.problem: 论文解决的是通用音源分离问题：利用大规模弱标签或无标签音频数据，训练一个统一模型来分离任意数量的声源，并自动检测和分层分离活动声源类别。
chinese_summary.method: 提出一个通用音源分离框架，包含：1) 基于弱标签数据训练的音频标记模型作为查询网络，提供声源条件信息；2) 条件源分离模型，以查询网络输出为条件，分离任意声源。框架支持分层分离策略，从 AudioSet 本体中自动检测并分离声源类别。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次构建了利用弱标签数据实现通用源分离的统一系统，可处理包括声音事件、音乐和语音在内的多种声源类型；提出了层次化分离策略，能自动检测并按层次分离活跃声类；仅使用 AudioSet 弱标签数据即达到在多个基准上的竞争性能。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在多个数据集上报告了定量结果：AudioSet 527类平均 SDRi 5.57 dB；DCASE 2018 Task 2 上 10.57 dB；MUSDB18 上 8.12 dB；Slakh2100 上 SDRi 7.28 dB；Voicebank-Demand 上 SSNR 9.00 dB。语音增强结果来自 Voicebank-Demand 数据集，证明系统具备语音增强能力。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未说明语音增强场景下的具体性能细节（如各类噪声、混响等条件下的表现），也未与专门语音增强方法对比；框架通用性强但可能在特定语音任务上未做优化；弱标签训练可能导致分离精度下降或源混淆；需阅读全文确认对语音前端瓶颈（如去混响、回声消除）的覆盖程度。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文提出的通用框架包含语音增强功能，在 Voicebank-Demand 数据集上取得了客观指标（SSNR 9.00 dB），可直接应用于降噪任务；条件源分离模型可作为语音增强前端组件；研究方向中的“神经掩蔽”、“U-Net 语音增强”与该框架中可能的条件分离网络结构有潜在关联。

papers.title: Llasa: Scaling Train-Time and Inference-Time Compute for Llama-based Speech Synthesis
papers.summary: Recent advances in text-based large language models (LLMs), particularly in the GPT series and the o1 model, have demonstrated the effectiveness of scaling both training-time and inference-time compute. However, current state-of-the-art TTS systems leveraging LLMs are often multi-stage, requiring separate models (e.g., diffusion models after LLM), complicating the decision of whether to scale a particular model during training or testing. This work makes the following contributions: First, we explore the scaling of train-time and inference-time compute for speech synthesis. Second, we propose a simple framework Llasa for speech synthesis that employs a single-layer vector quantizer (VQ) codec and a single Transformer architecture to fully align with standard LLMs such as Llama. Our experiments reveal that scaling train-time compute for Llasa consistently improves the naturalness of synthesized speech and enables the generation of more complex and accurate prosody patterns. Furthermore, from the perspective of scaling inference-time compute, we employ speech understanding models as verifiers during the search, finding that scaling inference-time compute shifts the sampling modes toward the preferences of specific verifiers, thereby improving emotional expressiveness, timbre consistency, and content accuracy. In addition, we released the checkpoint and training code for our TTS model (1B, 3B, 8B) and codec model publicly available.
papers.justification: 该论文直接对应生成式语音技术，提出了基于LLaMA的单阶段语音合成框架Llasa，系统探索训练与推理阶段的计算扩展，显著提升语音自然度、韵律和情感表达，并公开模型与代码，是必读级别的工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 当前基于LLM的TTS系统多为多阶段架构，需在LLM后级联扩散模型等独立模块，导致训练与推理时难以决定对哪个模型进行缩放，限制了计算效率与合成质量的最优平衡。
chinese_summary.method: 提出Llasa框架：采用单层向量量化编解码器和单一Transformer架构，完全对齐Llama等标准LLM，无需额外扩散模型。训练时缩放计算量（如模型大小、数据量）直接提升语音自然度和韵律复杂度；推理时引入语音理解模型作为验证器，通过搜索缩放推理计算，使采样偏好对齐验证器目标，增强情感表达、音色一致性与内容准确度。
chinese_summary.innovation: 将训练和推理计算缩放策略统一应用于单阶段TTS系统，消除了多模型级联的复杂性；通过验证器引导推理时搜索，实现了情感、音色、内容的可控优化；验证了纯LLM架构在语音合成任务上的缩放规律，为后续大模型设计提供参考。
chinese_summary.evidence: 实验表明，缩放训练计算持续改善合成语音的自然度，并生成更复杂准确的韵律模式；缩放推理计算通过特定验证器搜索，提升了情感表现力、音色一致性和内容准确性。公开了1B、3B、8B的TTS模型和编解码器。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未涉及多语种、零样本说话人适应等泛化能力；单层VQ编解码器的重建质量可能影响最终合成保真度；推理阶段依赖验证器，其偏好可能引入偏差，需进一步验证鲁棒性。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 研究方向包含speech synthesis、TTS和neural vocoder，该论文提出的Llasa属于先进的基于LLM的语音合成方法，与生成式语音合成高度相关，其训练与推理缩放策略对模型设计与优化有直接参考价值。

papers.title: XTTS: a Massively Multilingual Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech Model
papers.summary: Most Zero-shot Multi-speaker TTS (ZS-TTS) systems support only a single language. Although models like YourTTS, VALL-E X, Mega-TTS 2, and Voicebox explored Multilingual ZS-TTS they are limited to just a few high/medium resource languages, limiting the applications of these models in most of the low/medium resource languages. In this paper, we aim to alleviate this issue by proposing and making publicly available the XTTS system. Our method builds upon the Tortoise model and adds several novel modifications to enable multilingual training, improve voice cloning, and enable faster training and inference. XTTS was trained in 16 languages and achieved state-of-the-art (SOTA) results in most of them.
papers.justification: 提出大规模多语言零样本文语转换模型XTTS，在16种语言上达到SOTA，是生成式语音合成方向的重要基础工作，与零样本多语言TTS高度相关，引用数高，有望成为经典基线。

chinese_summary.problem: 现有零样本多说话人TTS系统大多仅支持单语言，多语言系统则局限于少数高资源语言，无法覆盖低中资源语言。本文旨在解决这一限制，实现支持16种语言的零样本文本转语音。
chinese_summary.method: 在Tortoise模型基础上进行多项改进，包括新增模块以实现多语言训练、增强声音克隆能力，并优化训练和推理速度。具体技术细节未在摘要中披露。
chinese_summary.innovation: 将单语言Tortoise模型扩展为多语言训练框架；改进了声音克隆技术，提升多说话人零样本合成质量；通过架构优化显著加快训练和推理效率。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要中声明训练了16种语言，并且在大多数语言上取得了最先进的结果，但未提供具体评估指标或数据集。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未说明具体的模型结构修改、训练数据来源、评测基准及对比细节，需要阅读全文才能评估实际性能和创新性。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文聚焦于零样本多语言TTS，直接匹配我的研究方向中的“text-to-speech”和“speech synthesis”，且与生成式语音技术紧密相关。

papers.title: Natural language guidance of high-fidelity text-to-speech with synthetic annotations
papers.summary: Text-to-speech models trained on large-scale datasets have demonstrated impressive in-context learning capabilities and naturalness. However, control of speaker identity and style in these models typically requires conditioning on reference speech recordings, limiting creative applications. Alternatively, natural language prompting of speaker identity and style has demonstrated promising results and provides an intuitive method of control. However, reliance on human-labeled descriptions prevents scaling to large datasets. Our work bridges the gap between these two approaches. We propose a scalable method for labeling various aspects of speaker identity, style, and recording conditions. We then apply this method to a 45k hour dataset, which we use to train a speech language model. Furthermore, we propose simple methods for increasing audio fidelity, significantly outperforming recent work despite relying entirely on found data. Our results demonstrate high-fidelity speech generation in a diverse range of accents, prosodic styles, channel conditions, and acoustic conditions, all accomplished with a single model and intuitive natural language conditioning. Audio samples can be heard at https://text-description-to-speech.com/.
papers.justification: 提出可扩展的合成标注方法，实现基于自然语言提示的高保真语音合成，工作质量高，与生成式语音技术方向高度相关。

chinese_summary.problem: 如何在大规模文本到语音合成中实现基于自然语言的说话人风格控制，同时避免对昂贵人工标注的依赖。
chinese_summary.method: 提出一种可扩展的自动标注方法，对说话人身份、风格、录音条件等多种属性进行合成标注；利用该方法处理一个4.5万小时的数据集，并训练一个语音语言模型；同时引入简单技巧提高生成音频的保真度，仅使用现有数据。
chinese_summary.innovation: 构建了无需人工、可大规模扩展的语音属性标注流程，解决了自然语言提示在TTS中依赖人工标签的瓶颈；将自动标注与语音语言模型结合，在单一模型中实现多口音、多风格、多声学条件的高保真生成；完全基于现存数据训练，性能显著超越近期工作。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要称在多种口音、韵律风格、信道和声学条件下实现了高保真生成，并提供了音频样本网站，但未给出具体实验指标，需要查阅全文验证。
chinese_summary.limitations: 自动标注的质量和覆盖度未经验证；无定量结果，难以评估真实提升幅度；自然语言提示的细粒度控制能力、对参考音频的替代程度尚不明确。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 直接属于研究方向中的text-to-speech和speech generation，并涉及高保真生成技术，与神经声码器、生成式语音模型紧密相关。

papers.title: VoxtLM: Unified Decoder-Only Models for Consolidating Speech Recognition, Synthesis and Speech, Text Continuation Tasks
papers.summary: We propose a decoder-only language model, VoxtLM, that can perform four tasks: speech recognition, speech synthesis, text generation, and speech continuation. VoxtLM integrates text vocabulary with discrete speech tokens from self-supervised speech features and uses special tokens to enable multitask learning. Compared to a single-task model, VoxtLM exhibits a significant improvement in speech synthesis, with improvements in both speech intelligibility from 28.9 to 5.6 and objective quality from 2.68 to 3.90. VoxtLM also improves speech generation and speech recognition performance over the single-task counterpart. Further, VoxtLM is trained with publicly available data and training recipes and model checkpoints are open-sourced to make fully reproducible work.
categories: IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing
papers.venue: IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing
papers.justification: 论文提出统一解码器模型整合语音识别、合成与文本生成，与生成式语音技术高度相关，使用离散语音标记实现多任务学习，质量扎实且开源，但作为2023年工作尚未成为长期基础基线。

chinese_summary.problem: 如何用一个统一的decoder-only语言模型同时执行语音识别、语音合成、文本生成和语音延续多任务，以提升各任务性能并简化系统设计。
chinese_summary.method: VoxtLM采用decoder-only架构，将文本词汇与从自监督语音特征（如HuBERT）提取的离散语音token融合为统一词汇表，通过插入特殊任务token指示任务类型，实现多任务联合训练。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次在decoder-only语言模型中整合语音识别、合成、文本生成和语音延续四项任务；利用多任务学习，语音合成和识别性能均超越单任务模型，尤其语音合成可懂度和质量提升显著；模型基于公开数据训练并完全开源。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要给出语音合成可懂度指标从28.9降至5.6（可能是词错误率），客观质量从2.68升至3.90（可能是MOS）；语音生成和识别性能也有改善；训练食谱和模型检查点已开源，可复现。
chinese_summary.limitations: 自回归生成可能延迟较高；离散语音token的语义与声学质量权衡需更多分析；多任务训练平衡及语音延续任务的实用效果未详述。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 匹配研究方向中的“语音合成”和“语音生成”，VoxtLM是一个生成式语音模型；但其核心是离散token的自回归语言模型，未涉及扩散模型或流匹配，也不包含语音增强或恢复，因此相关性中等，建议阅读全文以确认对语言模型方法是否感兴趣。

papers.title: MinMo: A Multimodal Large Language Model for Seamless Voice Interaction
papers.summary: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) and multimodal speech-text models have laid the groundwork for seamless voice interactions, enabling real-time, natural, and human-like conversations. Previous models for voice interactions are categorized as native and aligned. Native models integrate speech and text processing in one framework but struggle with issues like differing sequence lengths and insufficient pre-training. Aligned models maintain text LLM capabilities but are often limited by small datasets and a narrow focus on speech tasks. In this work, we introduce MinMo, a Multimodal Large Language Model with approximately 8B parameters for seamless voice interaction. We address the main limitations of prior aligned multimodal models. We train MinMo through multiple stages of speech-to-text alignment, text-to-speech alignment, speech-to-speech alignment, and duplex interaction alignment, on 1.4 million hours of diverse speech data and a broad range of speech tasks. After the multi-stage training, MinMo achieves state-of-the-art performance across various benchmarks for voice comprehension and generation while maintaining the capabilities of text LLMs, and also facilitates full-duplex conversation, that is, simultaneous two-way communication between the user and the system. Moreover, we propose a novel and simple voice decoder that outperforms prior models in voice generation. The enhanced instruction-following capabilities of MinMo supports controlling speech generation based on user instructions, with various nuances including emotions, dialects, and speaking rates, and mimicking specific voices. For MinMo, the speech-to-text latency is approximately 100ms, full-duplex latency is approximately 600ms in theory and 800ms in practice. The MinMo project web page is https://funaudiollm.github.io/minmo, and the code and models will be released soon.
papers.justification: 提出多模态大语言模型MinMo实现全双工语音交互，包含创新的语音解码器和多阶段对齐训练，在语音生成与理解多项基准达到SOTA，与生成式语音技术方向高度匹配且具基础影响力。

chinese_summary.problem: 现有对齐式多模态语音模型受限于小规模数据集和单一语音任务，缺乏全面的语音交互能力。
chinese_summary.method: MinMo是一个约80亿参数的多模态大语言模型，通过语音到文本对齐、文本到语音对齐、语音到语音对齐和双工交互对齐等多阶段训练，使用140万小时多样化语音数据覆盖广泛语音任务，并提出新型语音解码器实现全双工对话。
chinese_summary.innovation: 提出多阶段对齐训练框架，在保持文本大语言模型能力的同时实现语音理解和生成的全方位集成；设计新颖的语音解码器，在语音生成上超越之前模型；支持通过指令控制语音生成的情感、方言、语速和声音模仿等细粒度属性。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要声称在全双工对话、语音理解和生成的多项基准测试上达到最先进性能，语音转文本延迟约100ms，全双工理论延迟约600ms，实际800ms，但未给出具体基准名称或对比数值。
chinese_summary.limitations: 未说明语音生成的自然度、鲁棒性具体指标；未提及在噪声环境或远场条件下的性能；未透露模型是否开源及具体推理效率。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文涉及语音生成、文本到语音合成和神经声码器相关技术，与研究方向中的语音合成、TTS和神经声码器匹配；可能使用生成式方法（如扩散模型或流匹配）但摘要未明确说明，需人工确认生成模型细节。

papers.title: WeSep: A Modular and Cue-Composable Framework for Target Speaker Extraction
papers.summary: The study of Target Speaker Extraction (TSE) aims to isolate a desired speaker from overlapping speech mixture given auxiliary cues. Existing systems are typically designed for specific cue types, limiting flexibility when cue availability varies across scenarios. We present WeSep, a unified framework that reformulates TSE as a heterogeneous cue-conditioned learning problem. In WeSep, cue modules and separator backbones are decoupled through standardized interfaces, enabling configurable cue injection and flexible integration of diverse modalities. The design enables systematic study of cue structure, intra- and cross-modal interaction, and dynamic cue availability within a shared optimization framework, facilitating adaptation to real-world conditions. Experiments across enrollment, spatial, visual, and textual cues reveal modality-dependent characteristics and demonstrate stable optimization under heterogeneous cue availability. The toolkit will be publicly available.
papers.topic_name: Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction
papers.justification: 提出模块化、可组合线索的统一目标说话人提取框架，支持多模态线索，直接对应语音分离与目标说话人提取方向，工作新颖，必读。

chinese_summary.problem: 目标说话人提取系统通常针对特定辅助线索设计，缺乏灵活性，难以适应不同场景下线索可用性的变化。
chinese_summary.method: WeSep 将目标说话人提取重新表述为异构线索条件学习问题，通过标准化接口解耦线索模块和分离器骨干，支持可配置的线索注入和多种模态（注册、空间、视觉、文本）的灵活集成。
chinese_summary.innovation: 提出统一框架，将目标说话人提取建模为异构线索条件学习而非单一线索定制；模块化解耦设计实现线索模块与分离器的即插即用；能够系统性研究线索结构、模态交互和动态线索可用性，增强真实世界适应性。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要提及实验涉及注册、空间、视觉、文本四种线索，揭示了模态依赖特性，并演示了异构线索可用性下的稳定优化；但未提供具体性能指标或比较对象。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未给出定量结果和与现有特定线索系统的对比；需阅读全文确认泛化能力是否以性能损失为代价，以及工具包的实际可用性。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接研究目标说话人提取，与我的研究方向“Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction”高度契合，关键词完全匹配，且框架支持多模态辅助线索，属于我关注的核心领域。

papers.title: A Study on Online Mask-based Beamforming Using Per-channel Masking for Spatially Distributed Microphones
papers.summary: Mask-based beamforming is a popular geometry-agnostic approach for speech enhancement, typically applying a single mask across all microphones to estimate the required covariance matrices. While effective for compact arrays, this strategy may be suboptimal for spatially distributed microphones, where signal characteristics may vary strongly across microphones. To effectively capture the spatial diversity across microphones, we extend the mask-based beamformer to a multi-channel formulation, where each microphone is pre-filtered by a separate mask before covariance estimation. To address time-varying acoustic scenes, caused by spectro-temporal nonstationarity, we adopt a frame-causal online implementation with a sliding window. Experiments with simulated compact arrays and distributed microphones show that multi-channel masking yields a benefit over using a single mask when microphone signals differ substantially, while retaining similar performance in compact arrays. We further demonstrate the robustness of the multi-channel masking approach by comparing oracle ideal ratio masks to blind DNN-based mask estimation.
papers.justification: 论文将掩模波束形成扩展为每通道掩模，有效处理空间分布式麦克风场景下的信号差异，并提出在线实现方案，与麦克风阵列与波束形成方向高度相关，工作扎实新颖。

chinese_summary.problem: 针对空间分布麦克风场景，传统单掩蔽波束成形未充分考虑通道间信号差异，导致性能次优，需要有效捕获各麦克风空间多样性的增强方法。
chinese_summary.method: 将掩蔽波束成形扩展为每通道独立掩蔽，各麦克风信号在协方差估计前由单独掩蔽预滤波，并采用滑动窗口的帧因果在线实现以适应时变声学场景。
chinese_summary.innovation: 提出每通道掩蔽替代全局单掩蔽，以更好建模分布式麦克风间的信号差异；设计帧因果在线处理流程，保证实时性与非平稳环境适应性；通过模拟验证在信号差异大时性能提升且紧凑阵列下无退化。
chinese_summary.evidence: 模拟实验对比了紧凑阵列与分布式麦克风场景，显示多通道掩蔽在麦克风信号显著不同时优于单掩蔽，且与理想比率掩蔽和盲DNN估计掩蔽的比较证明了鲁棒性。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未提供实验数据集、噪声条件及具体评价指标细节；在线滑窗参数选择及计算代价需查阅全文；盲DNN掩蔽估计方法未说明，泛化性待验证。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 匹配研究方向中的波束成形、多通道语音增强和空间滤波，特别是将掩蔽策略用于增强，但侧重分布式麦克风，与常见紧凑阵列的神经波束成形细节有差异，需人工复核方法通用性。

papers.title: A Foundation Model for Music Informatics
papers.summary: This paper investigates foundation models tailored for music informatics, a domain currently challenged by the scarcity of labeled data and generalization issues. To this end, we conduct an in-depth comparative study among various foundation model variants, examining key determinants such as model architectures, tokenization methods, temporal resolution, data, and model scalability. This research aims to bridge the existing knowledge gap by elucidating how these individual factors contribute to the success of foundation models in music informatics. Employing a careful evaluation frame-work, we assess the performance of these models across diverse downstream tasks in music information retrieval, with a particular focus on frame-level and sequence-level classification. Our results reveal that our model demonstrates robust performance, surpassing existing models in specific key metrics. These findings contribute to the understanding of self-supervised learning in music informatics and pave the way for developing more effective and versatile foundation models in the field. A pretrained version of our model is publicly available to foster reproducibility and future research.
categories: IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing
papers.venue: IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing
papers.justification: 该论文提出音乐信息学基础模型，系统比较架构、标记化、时域分辨率等关键因素，在多个MIR任务上表现优异，与Music Information Retrieval and Representation方向高度相关，具有扎实的参考价值。

chinese_summary.problem: 解决音乐信息学领域标注数据稀缺和模型泛化困难的问题，探索构建适用于音乐任务的基础模型。
chinese_summary.method: 对多种基础模型变体进行系统的对比研究，分析模型架构、分词方法、时间分辨率、数据规模和可扩展性等关键因素的影响；模型在下游音乐信息检索任务（帧级和序列级分类）上评估。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次对音乐基础模型的关键设计要素（架构、分词、时间粒度、数据等）进行全面消融和对比，揭示各因素贡献；提出一个在关键指标上超越现有工作的强基线模型，并公开预训练模型以促进复现。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要有明确实验证据：采用评估框架在下游MIR任务上测试，模型在特定关键指标上超越现有模型，并且预训练模型已公开。但未列出具体任务、指标数值和对比对象。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未说明具体下游任务类型（如标签、和弦识别等）、性能提升幅度和对比的基准模型；仅提及分类任务，未涉及其它MIR任务（如生成、旋律提取）；数据集细节缺失，泛化性能待全文验证。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接聚焦音乐基础模型，针对音乐信息检索（MIR）下游任务，涉及自监督音频表征学习、音乐编码器架构等核心问题，与研究方向中的 music information retrieval, music representation learning, music encoder, self-supervised audio 等关键词高度匹配，且模型公开发布有利于后续研究。

papers.title: Auto-ACD: A Large-scale Dataset for Audio-Language Representation Learning
papers.summary: Recently, the AI community has made significant strides in developing powerful foundation models, driven by large-scale multimodal datasets. However, for audio representation learning, existing datasets suffer from limitations in the following aspects: insufficient volume, simplistic content, and arduous collection procedures. To establish an audio dataset with high-quality captions, we propose an innovative, automatic approach leveraging multimodal inputs, such as video frames, audio streams. Specifically, we construct a large-scale, high-quality, audio-language dataset, named as Auto-ACD, comprising over 1.5M audio-text pairs. We exploit a series of pre-trained models or APIs, to determine audio-visual synchronisation, generate image captions, object detection, or audio tags for specific videos. Subsequently, we employ LLM to paraphrase a congruent caption for each audio, guided by the extracted multi-modality clues. To demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed dataset, we train widely used models on our dataset and show performance improvement on various downstream tasks, for example, audio-language retrieval, audio captioning, zero-shot classification. In addition, we establish a novel benchmark with environmental information and provide a benchmark for audio-text tasks.
papers.justification: 提出自动构建大规模高质量音频-文本数据集Auto-ACD，显著提升音频语言表示学习，与音乐信息检索与表示方向高度相关，质量扎实。

chinese_summary.problem: 现有音频表示学习数据集存在数量不足、内容简化和收集过程繁琐等问题，论文旨在构建大规模高质量音频-语言数据集以推动音频表示学习。
chinese_summary.method: 提出自动构建方法，利用视频帧、音频流等多模态输入，通过预训练模型或API进行音画同步检测、图像描述生成、目标检测和音频标签提取，再用大语言模型将多模态线索改写为一致描述，最终构建包含超过150万音频-文本对的Auto-ACD数据集。
chinese_summary.innovation: 1) 提出自动构建音频-语言数据集的流程，避免昂贵人工标注；2) 利用多模态信息增强描述质量；3) 构建了迄今最大规模的高质量音频-语言数据集，并验证其有效性。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在Auto-ACD上训练的模型在音频-语言检索、音频字幕、零样本分类等下游任务上性能提升，但摘要未提供具体模型、量化结果和细节。
chinese_summary.limitations: 数据集内容偏向通用音频，音乐覆盖度未知；自动生成描述可能存在噪声；未与音乐数据集对比；需人工确认音乐样本数量和质量。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 该数据集涉及音频表示学习，与我的研究方向中音频表示学习、自监督音频和音频基础模型相关，但因未明确包含音乐内容且主要针对通用音频，对音乐信息检索和理解的直接适用性需人工复核。

papers.title: MuChoMusic: Evaluating Music Understanding in Multimodal Audio-Language Models
papers.summary: Multimodal models that jointly process audio and language hold great promise in audio understanding and are increasingly being adopted in the music domain. By allowing users to query via text and obtain information about a given audio input, these models have the potential to enable a variety of music understanding tasks via language-based interfaces. However, their evaluation poses considerable challenges, and it remains unclear how to effectively assess their ability to correctly interpret music-related inputs with current methods. Motivated by this, we introduce MuChoMusic, a benchmark for evaluating music understanding in multimodal language models focused on audio. MuChoMusic comprises 1,187 multiple-choice questions, all validated by human annotators, on 644 music tracks sourced from two publicly available music datasets, and covering a wide variety of genres. Questions in the benchmark are crafted to assess knowledge and reasoning abilities across several dimensions that cover fundamental musical concepts and their relation to cultural and functional contexts. Through the holistic analysis afforded by the benchmark, we evaluate five open-source models and identify several pitfalls, including an over-reliance on the language modality, pointing to a need for better multimodal integration. Data and code are open-sourced.
categories: International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference
papers.venue: International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference
papers.justification: 该工作提出了首个面向音频-语言多模态模型的音乐理解评测基准MuChoMusic，与音乐信息检索与表示方向高度相关，评测设计扎实，对于推动多模态音乐理解研究具有基础性价值，已获一定引用。

chinese_summary.problem: 当前缺乏有效评估多模态音频语言模型在音乐理解方面能力的方法，难以判断模型是否正确解释音乐相关输入。
chinese_summary.method: 构建了 MuChoMusic 基准，包含 1,187 道人工验证的多选题，覆盖 644 首不同流派的音乐曲目，问题设计旨在评估模型在基本音乐概念及文化、功能背景等多维度的知识和推理能力，并使用该基准对五个开源模型进行整体分析。
chinese_summary.innovation: 提出了首个专门针对多模态音频-语言模型音乐理解能力的综合性评估基准；以多选题形式系统评估模型的知识和推理能力，涵盖了音乐概念与文化功能维度的结合；通过人工注释保证题目质量，并揭示了模型过度依赖语言模态的缺陷，为多模态整合提供了指导。
chinese_summary.evidence: 评估了五个开源模型并识别了多个陷阱，如过度依赖语言模态；基准构建基于 644 首音乐曲目和 1,187 道人工验证问题；数据和代码已开源。
chinese_summary.limitations: 基准仅包含多选题，可能无法全面评估生成能力或更深层次音乐理解；数据集来源有限，可能影响泛化性；摘要未提供模型改进的具体建议，需阅读全文获取详细分析。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 高度匹配音乐信息检索与表示学习方向：音乐理解是 MIR 核心任务，该基准可直接用于评估音乐编码器、音频基础模型和自监督表示模型的多模态理解能力，提供量化指标并揭示模型缺陷。

papers.title: ICASSP 2023 Acoustic Echo Cancellation Challenge
papers.summary: The ICASSP 2023 Acoustic Echo Cancellation Challenge is intended to stimulate research in acoustic echo cancellation (AEC), which is an important area of speech enhancement and is still a top issue in audio communication. This is the fourth AEC challenge and it is enhanced by adding a second track for personalized acoustic echo cancellation, reducing the algorithmic + buffering latency to 20 ms, as well as including a full-band version of AECMOS (Purin et al., 2020). We open source two large datasets to train AEC models under both single talk and double talk scenarios. These datasets consist of recordings from more than 10,000 real audio devices and human speakers in real environments, as well as a synthetic dataset. We open source an online subjective test framework and provide an objective metric for researchers to quickly test their results. The winners of this challenge were selected based on the average mean opinion score (MOS) achieved across all scenarios and the word accuracy (WAcc) rate.
categories: IEEE Open Journal of Signal Processing
papers.venue: IEEE Open Journal of Signal Processing
papers.justification: 该论文是AEC挑战赛的总结，开源了大规模真实场景数据集与评估框架，为语音增强和音频前端领域的回声消除研究提供了重要基准和公共测试平台，高度相关且具基础性影响力。

chinese_summary.problem: 该论文概述了ICASSP 2023声学回声消除挑战赛的设置，旨在通过提供标准化的数据集、评估框架和竞赛平台，推动声学回声消除（AEC）领域的研究，尤其是在低延迟和个性化场景下的算法发展。
chinese_summary.method: 挑战赛引入了双轨制：通用AEC和个性化AEC，并将算法加缓冲延迟降至20ms；发布了包含超过10,000个真实音频设备录制的大型数据集（涵盖单讲和双讲场景）和合成数据集；开源了在线主观测试框架，并采用全频带AECMOS客观指标与单词准确率（WAcc）结合平均意见分（MOS）进行综合评估。
chinese_summary.innovation: 相较于往届，本届挑战赛新增个性化AEC赛道，以满足不同说话人的回声消除需求；首次将延迟要求降低至20ms，更贴近实时通信需求；引入了全频带AECMOS作为客观评价指标，丰富了评估手段。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要中明确给出了可验证的证据：开源了来自10,000多个真实设备的大规模数据集和在线主观测试框架；提供了客观评价指标（全频带AECMOS）；获胜团队基于所有场景的平均MOS和WAcc综合评定选出。
chinese_summary.limitations: 本文仅为挑战赛概述，未涉及具体AEC算法的技术细节或性能比较，需要查阅获奖方案论文才能了解前沿方法；数据集的具体特性（如混响、噪声条件）未详述，可能影响其通用性。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 直接命中研究方向关键词‘acoustic echo cancellation’和‘speech enhancement’；挑战赛提供的低延迟、个性化AEC场景与实际音频前端系统瓶颈高度吻合；开源数据集和评估工具对开发AEC模型具有直接实用价值。但需注意本文是竞赛总结而非技术论文，阅读后需进一步追踪获胜方案以获取具体方法。

papers.title: Robust Widely Linear Affine Projection M-Estimate Adaptive Algorithm: Performance Analysis and Application
papers.summary: The widely-linear affine projection algorithm (WL-APA) based on the orthogonal affine projection principle and the WL model utilizes the past multiple input signal vectors for updating the tap weights of the adaptive filter and achieves fast convergence with colored noncircular input signals while maintaining a certain steady-state estimation accuracy. However, the WL-APA suffers from significant performance degradation under impulsive interference. In this article, we propose a WL affine projection M-estimate (WL-APM) algorithm to enhance the robustness of the WL-APA against impulsive noise, which is obtained by solving a robust constrained minimization problem based on the complex-valued modified Huber (MH) function using the Lagrange multiplier method and Wirtinger Calculus (or called CR calculus). To achieve a reduction in the computational complexity of the WL-APM algorithm to facilitate its hardware implementation, a low-complexity variant based on fast recursive filtering and complex-valued leading dichotomous coordinate descent (DCD) iteration, namely DCD-WL-APM, is proposed. Then, the convergence behavior of the WL-APM algorithm is characterized by mean and mean-square stability, transient and steady-state mean-square deviation (MSD), and the stability step size conditions and MSD expressions are derived. The advantages of the proposed DCD-WL-APM algorithm in terms of computational complexity are also demonstrated in the form of picture and table. Finally, the accuracy of the theoretical analysis results and the superiority of our proposed WL-APM algorithm and its low-complexity version are verified by extensive simulations, including system identification and stereo acoustic echo cancellation (SAEC).
papers.justification: 该论文提出鲁棒的宽线性仿射投影M估计算法（WL-APM）及其低复杂度版本，直接应用于立体声回声消除（SAEC），高度匹配音频前端处理中的回声消除方向，理论分析扎实，发表在顶级期刊，可作为相关研究的基础基线。

chinese_summary.problem: 广泛线性仿射投影算法（WL-APA）在脉冲干扰下性能严重下降，难以用于实际声学回声消除等场景。
chinese_summary.method: 提出广泛线性仿射投影M估计算法（WL-APM），通过求解基于复值修正Huber函数的鲁棒约束最小化问题，使用拉格朗日乘子法和Wirtinger微积分推导。进一步采用快速递归滤波和复数引导二分坐标下降迭代，设计低复杂度变体DCD-WL-APM。
chinese_summary.innovation: 引入修正Huber函数增强对脉冲噪声的鲁棒性；推导了均值与均方意义下的收敛行为、稳态均方偏差及步长条件；提出DCD迭代的快速实现，显著降低计算复杂度。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要提及通过系统识别和立体声回声消除（SAEC）仿真验证了理论分析的准确性和算法的优越性，但未给出具体指标。有复杂度对比图表。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未说明在真实声学环境或语音质量、可懂度方面的评估，应用局限于二入二出SAEC，且缺少与深度学习方法的比较。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 关键词命中'acoustic echo cancellation'，且仿真中涉及立体声回声消除，与研究方向中的声学回声消除直接相关，但论文侧重于自适应滤波算法的鲁棒性和理论分析，并非针对语音增强或前端处理的整体系统，偏重信号处理理论。

papers.title: Speech Enhancement—A Review of Modern Methods
papers.summary: A review of techniques to improve distorted speech is presented, noting the strengths and weaknesses of common methods. Speech signals are discussed from the point of view of which features should be preserved to retain both naturalness and intelligibility. Enhancement methods range from classical spectral subtraction and Wiener filtering to recent deep neural network approaches. The difficulty of finding objective acoustic measures that approximate perceptual speech quality is discussed. Suggestions to improve these methods are made.
papers.justification: 该综述系统梳理了从经典谱减法、维纳滤波到深度学习的语音增强现代方法，并讨论了客观指标与感知质量的关系，是语音增强方向研究者必读的基础性综述。

chinese_summary.problem: 综述现代语音增强方法，评估其优缺点，并探讨如何保留语音的自然度和可懂度。
chinese_summary.method: 系统回顾从经典谱减法和维纳滤波到深度神经网络的语音增强方法，分析语音信号应保留的声学特征，并讨论客观质量评价指标的局限性。
chinese_summary.innovation: 本文作为一篇综述，没有提出具体新算法，但其创新在于全面比较了各类方法的优劣，并针对客观评价指标与主观感知的差异提出了改进思路，为后续研究提供了方向性建议。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要未提供具体实验数据或理论证明，仅提及讨论了客观声学测量的困难，并给出改进建议，需阅读全文核实具体内容。
chinese_summary.limitations: 缺乏新算法贡献；改进建议可能停留在宏观层面；覆盖的方法范围需全文确认是否包含多通道、去混响等子领域。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接覆盖我的研究方向“语音增强与音频前端”，内容涉及语音降噪、经典与神经网络方法，并讨论特征保留和评价指标，与我研究的关键词（speech enhancement, speech denoising, neural masking等）高度匹配。

papers.title: SKY-Piano: A Multimodal Piano Performance Dataset
papers.summary: Music information retrieval research on piano performance increasingly involves diverse modalities of data and annotations beyond audio and MIDI. We present SKY-Piano, a multimodal piano performance dataset that includes 11 hours of performance recordings of motion, multi-view video, audio, MIDI from 7 professional and 12 amateur pianists along with MusicXML scores. The performance pieces were selected considering playing technique, difficulty, and performer expertise on a shared core repertoire. The motion data include both hand and body motion, released in both flagged form, where samples lost to marker occlusion are marked as unreliable, and imputed form, where those gaps are reconstructed, together with Visual3D body-segment kinematics and other time-synchronized modalities. To easily browse different modalities of data at a glance, we provide an interactive web browser. In addition, we developed a fingering annotation model and tool for deriving pseudo fingering annotations from the MIDI and motion data. Lastly, we present MIDI-to-motion generation through a fine-tuning experiment as a use case of the dataset.
papers.justification: 该论文构建了多模态钢琴演奏数据集，包含音频、MIDI、运动等多模式数据及标注工具，直接服务于音乐信息检索与表示方向，工作扎实且具实用性，但作为数据集其新颖性中等，适合作为相关方向的研究资源。

chinese_summary.problem: 钢琴演奏MIR研究需要多模态数据支撑，但现有数据集多局限于音频和MIDI，缺乏运动、多视角视频等同步模态和演奏者多样性。
chinese_summary.method: 构建SKY-Piano数据集，采集11小时的专业与业余钢琴家演奏，同步记录手部和身体运动捕捉、多视角视频、音频、MIDI和MusicXML乐谱；提供遮挡标记的原始运动数据与插补后的完整数据，并导出Visual3D运动学变量；开发交互式网页浏览器便于浏览各模态，同时设计指法标注模型从MIDI和运动数据推测伪指法标签。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次公开发布包含手部和全身运动数据、多视角视频和乐谱的钢琴演奏数据集，并提供遮挡标记与插补两种运动数据处理方式；开发了基于MIDI和运动数据的自动指法标注工具，可生成大规模弱监督指法信息；通过专业与业余演奏者的对比覆盖不同技巧水平，增强数据多样性。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要明确给出11小时录音规模、19名演奏者（7专业12业余）、运动数据含手部和身体、交互式浏览器、指法标注模型以及MIDI-to-motion生成实验，但未提供模型性能指标。
chinese_summary.limitations: 数据集规模相对较小（11小时），运动捕捉遮挡问题可能影响部分数据质量；指法标注为伪标签，需人工验证可靠性；生成实验仅为微调示例，未与原方法对比。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 数据集适用于音乐生成（MIDI到运动生成）、音乐理解（演奏技巧、指法分析）和多模态表示学习（融合音频、视频、运动），与我的研究方向中音乐生成、音乐理解和自监督表示学习高度相关，可直接作为训练或评估资源，并可能扩展为音乐编码器预训练的多模态监督信号。

papers.title: Multichannel Long-Term Streaming Neural Speech Enhancement for Static and Moving Speakers
papers.summary: In this work, we extend our previously proposed offline SpatialNet for long-term streaming multichannel speech enhancement in both static and moving speaker scenarios. SpatialNet exploits spatial information, such as the spatial/steering direction of speech, for discriminating between target speech and interferences, and achieved outstanding performance. The core of SpatialNet is a narrow-band self-attention module used for learning the temporal dynamic of spatial vectors. Towards long-term streaming speech enhancement, we propose to replace the offline self-attention network with online networks that have linear inference complexity w.r.t signal length and meanwhile maintain the capability of learning long-term information. Three variants are developed based on i) masked self-attention, ii) Retention, a self-attention variant with linear inference complexity, and iii) Mamba, a structured-state-space-based RNN-like network. Moreover, we investigate the length extrapolation ability of different networks, namely test on signals that are much longer than training signals, and propose a short-signal training plus long-signal fine-tuning strategy, which largely improves the length extrapolation ability of the networks within limited training time. Overall, the proposed online SpatialNet achieves outstanding speech enhancement performance for long audio streams, and for both static and moving speakers.
papers.justification: 该论文将离线SpatialNet扩展为流式多通道语音增强，提出三种低复杂度在线网络，并针对移动说话人验证，与麦克风阵列和波束成形高度相关，方法扎实。

chinese_summary.problem: 在静态和移动说话人场景下，实现面向长音频流的在线多通道语音增强，解决传统离线方法无法实时处理长信号的问题
chinese_summary.method: 将离线SpatialNet中的窄带自注意力替换为在线网络，包括掩码自注意力、Retention和Mamba三种变体，并通过短信号训练加长信号微调策略提升网络对长序列的外推能力
chinese_summary.innovation: 提出三种线性推理复杂度的在线网络替代方案，突破离线自注意力对长信号的计算瓶颈；首次研究长度外推能力并设计短训练+长微调策略，在不显著增加训练时间下大幅增强处理长音频流的能力
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要声称在线SpatialNet在长音频流和静/动态说话人场景下均取得出色的语音增强性能，但未提供具体指标或对比基线
chinese_summary.limitations: 未提及实时处理的计算延迟和资源消耗；长信号场景下的性能提升缺乏定量结果；三种在线变体的性能差异和适用场景不明
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接聚焦多通道语音增强，涉及波束成形和空间信息利用，与我的研究方向“麦克风阵列与波束成形”中的多通道语音增强、空间滤波高度匹配，且在线处理方法适用于实际阵列系统

papers.title: Zero-Shot Face-to-Speech Synthesis via Latent Space Adaptation of a Style-Diffusion TTS Model
papers.summary: Zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) clones a voice from a short audio prompt, but this reliance on reference audio is a barrier when only visual information is available, e.g. for historical figures or video-game characters. In this work, we propose a Face-to-Speech (F2S) framework that predicts a plausible voice from a static facial image. A lightweight Face Adapter, together with soft-tuning of the face encoder's upper blocks, aligns face-recognition features with the style space of a frozen StyleTTS 2 model, kept frozen during training. We evaluate on held-out identities from LRS3, a large-scale audiovisual corpus of English TED-talk videos. The synthesized speech is highly natural (UTMOS 3.7-4.0, matching or exceeding the 3.61 of ground truth), face-to-voice retrieval is consistently above chance, and the generated voice is consistent with the target speaker. Without any retraining, an English-trained adapter also produces fluent Spanish speech, indicating that the face-to-style mapping is largely language-agnostic.
papers.justification: 论文提出基于人脸图像的零样本语音合成框架，通过适配StyleTTS 2风格空间实现跨模态映射，与生成语音技术方向高度相关，工作质量扎实，跨语言迁移特性具新颖性。

chinese_summary.problem: 在仅有人脸图像、无声参考语音的条件下，零样本生成与之匹配的说话声音。
chinese_summary.method: 提出一个面部到语音（F2S）框架，通过轻量级面部适配器将人脸识别特征对齐到冻结的StyleTTS 2扩散语音合成模型的风格空间；训练时仅软调面部编码器上层块，保持TTS模型参数不变。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次结合人脸识别与预训练扩散TTS模型实现零样本面部到语音合成，无需任何参考音频；仅需微调少量适配器参数，保留原TTS模型的高自然度；展示了跨语言泛化能力，英语训练的适配器可直接生成西班牙语语音。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在LRS3英文TED演讲视频上的评估显示，合成语音UTMOS得分3.7-4.0，达到或超过真实语音的3.61；人脸到语音检索准确率高于随机水平；英语训练的适配器可在不加训的情况下生成流利的西班牙语语音。
chinese_summary.limitations: 评估仅在LRS3数据集上进行，未见更复杂噪声环境或非英语母语说话人验证；依赖特定TTS架构（StyleTTS 2），泛化性存疑；未讨论生成语音的可懂度、语速等因素。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 涉及语音合成和扩散模型，与您研究方向中的speech synthesis、TTS及diffusion model speech有交集，但核心为跨模态视觉到语音生成，非生成式增强或神经声码器，需人工确认是否完全符合当前聚焦点。

papers.title: A Comprehensive Review of Direction-of-Arrival Estimation and Localization Approaches in Mixed-Field Sources Scenario
papers.summary: Direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation plays a crucial role in array signal processing across various domains, including radar, sonar, wireless communications, and seismic exploration. However, traditional DOA techniques often assume either far-field (FF) or near-field (NF) propagation, limiting their applicability in scenarios involving mixed-field sources. DOA estimation and localization in scenarios involving mixed NF and FF sources is a complex and dynamic field that has garnered significant research attention in recent years. This multifaceted and evolving area holds promise for addressing challenges in radar, wireless communications, and acoustic sensing applications. This review paper provides a comprehensive overview of the methodologies, techniques, and advancements in this domain. We categorize existing methodologies, discussing their advantages and limitations. Furthermore, we delve into the mathematical modeling of mixed-field sources and essential signal processing techniques for parameter estimation. Special attention is given to technical issues such as aperture loss, computational complexity, and hardware considerations. The paper discusses the various sources of noise in the mentioned scenario and highlights the importance of modeling noise accurately for effective estimation. It also explores different scenarios and assumptions considered in the literature, ranging from non-Gaussian and non-stationary noise environments to scenarios involving multipath propagation and unknown mutual coupling effects. A detailed examination of the statistical approaches used in DOA estimation and localization reveals a diverse range of methods, including higher-order statistics and second-order statistics, each with its own advantages and applications. A comparative evaluation of various approaches highlights their performance in terms of estimation accuracy, resolution, aperture loss and computational efficiency. This provides insights into the trade-offs involved in choosing between different approaches. The review also identifies promising future research directions, such as the exploration of advanced signal processing techniques like compressive sensing and deep learning, exact NF modeling, estimation based on one-bit measurements, the integration of polarization diversity, employing metasurface antennas, tracking parameters, and the utilization of full-wave or experimental data for a more realistic representation of the challenges. By reviewing advances in methodologies and techniques, as well as outlining future research directions aimed at addressing the complexities of mixed-field scenarios, this paper paves the way for the development of more robust and reliable localization systems capable of handling real-world complexities.
papers.justification: 综述了混合场源的DOA估计方法，覆盖雷达、声纳等领域，与麦克风阵列研究方向部分相关，但非语音前端核心基础，且引用数与影响力尚待积累。

papers.title: 30+ Years of Source Separation Research: Achievements and Future Challenges
papers.summary: Source separation (SS) of acoustic signals is a research field that emerged in the mid-1990s and has flourished ever since. On the occasion of ICASSP’s 50th anniversary, we review the major contributions and advancements in the past three decades in the speech, audio, and music SS research field. We will cover both single- and multi-channel SS approaches. We will also look back on key efforts to foster a culture of scientific evaluation in the research field, including challenges, performance metrics, and datasets. We will conclude by discussing current trends and future research directions.
categories: IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing
papers.venue: IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing

papers.title: SAM Audio: Segment Anything in Audio
papers.summary: General audio source separation is a key capability for multimodal AI systems that can perceive and reason about sound. Despite substantial progress in recent years, existing separation models are either domain-specific, designed for fixed categories such as speech or music, or limited in controllability, supporting only a single prompting modality such as text. In this work, we present SAM Audio, a foundation model for general audio separation that unifies text, visual, and temporal span prompting within a single framework. Built on a diffusion transformer architecture, SAM Audio is trained with flow matching on large-scale audio data spanning speech, music, and general sounds, and can flexibly separate target sources described by language, visual masks, or temporal spans. The model achieves state-of-the-art performance across a diverse suite of benchmarks, including general sound, speech, music, and musical instrument separation in both in-the-wild and professionally produced audios, substantially outperforming prior general-purpose and specialized systems. Furthermore, we introduce a new real-world separation benchmark with human-labeled multimodal prompts and a reference-free evaluation model that correlates strongly with human judgment.
papers.topic_name: Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction
papers.justification: 论文提出了SAM Audio，一个统一文本、视觉和时间提示的通用音频源分离基础模型，基于扩散变换器，覆盖语音、音乐等，在多个基准达到最优，与语音分离和提取方向高度相关，且是该领域潜在的必读工作。

papers.title: WeSep: A Scalable and Flexible Toolkit Towards Generalizable Target Speaker Extraction
papers.summary: Target speaker extraction (TSE) focuses on isolating the speech of a specific target speaker from overlapped multi-talker speech, which is a typical setup in the cocktail party problem. In recent years, TSE draws increasing attention due to its potential for various applications such as user-customized interfaces and hearing aids, or as a crutial front-end processing technologies for subsequential tasks such as speech recognition and speaker recongtion. However, there are currently few open-source toolkits or available pre-trained models for off-the-shelf usage. In this work, we introduce WeSep, a toolkit designed for research and practical applications in TSE. WeSep is featured with flexible target speaker modeling, scalable data management, effective on-the-fly data simulation, structured recipes and deployment support. The toolkit is publicly avaliable at \url{https://github.com/wenet-e2e/WeSep.}
papers.topic_name: Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction
papers.justification: 与目标说话人提取方向高度相关，提供了一个功能灵活、可扩展的开源工具包，对社区有实际贡献，但方法本身新颖性一般。

chinese_summary.problem: 论文旨在解决目标说话人提取（TSE）领域缺乏开源工具包和预训练模型的问题，以促进研究和实际应用。

papers.title: VoiceCraft: Zero-Shot Speech Editing and Text-to-Speech in the Wild
papers.summary: We introduce VoiceCraft, a token infilling neural codec language model, that achieves state-of-the-art performance on both speech editing and zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) on audiobooks, internet videos, and podcasts. VoiceCraft employs a Transformer decoder architecture and introduces a token rearrangement procedure that combines causal masking and delayed stacking to enable generation within an existing sequence. On speech editing tasks, VoiceCraft produces edited speech that is nearly indistinguishable from unedited recordings in terms of naturalness, as evaluated by humans; for zero-shot TTS, our model outperforms prior SotA models including VALLE and the popular commercial model XTTS-v2. Crucially, the models are evaluated on challenging and realistic datasets, that consist of diverse accents, speaking styles, recording conditions, and background noise and music, and our model performs consistently well compared to other models and real recordings. In particular, for speech editing evaluation, we introduce a high quality, challenging, and realistic dataset named RealEdit. We encourage readers to listen to the demos at https://jasonppy.github.io/VoiceCraft_web.
categories: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
papers.venue: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
papers.justification: 该工作提出了VoiceCraft，一种基于token填充的神经编解码语言模型，在零样本语音编辑和TTS任务上达到SOTA，引入的token重排机制和因果掩码技术具有创新性，且评估数据集真实多样，与生成式语音技术方向高度相关，是必读级工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 在真实世界多样化数据（如口音、噪声、音乐等）中，实现高质量的零样本语音编辑（插入、替换词语）和零样本文本到语音合成，并统一为单一模型。

chinese_summary.innovation: 首次将零样本语音编辑和零样本TTS统一到同一token填充框架中；设计了token重排机制以支持序列内生成；在真实挑战数据集上验证性能，并贡献了RealEdit评估集。

papers.title: Stable Autoregressive Speech Generation with Low-Frame-Rate High-Dimensional Continuous Tokens
papers.summary: Balancing sequence length, representational capacity, and long-horizon stability is a central problem in autoregressive (AR) speech and audio generation. Representations with higher frame rates or greater capacity can preserve more signal detail, but they also make streaming generation more vulnerable to distribution drift and AR error accumulation. Conversely, shorter and more compressed representations simplify AR modeling, but their limited bandwidth may discard important components and constrain the upper bound of reconstruction fidelity and generation quality. We ask whether a low-frame-rate, high-dimensional, high-bandwidth continuous representation can be co-designed with a streaming generation framework to support robust high-fidelity reconstruction, strong single-token predictability, and superior long-horizon stability. We decompose this goal into two coupled problems: what geometric and statistical properties a high-dimensional representation space should have, and how an AR continuous-token generator should be structured to resist error accumulation. Accordingly, we propose Locodec, a locally encoded codec that shapes its representation space to improve the interpolatability of a lower-dimensional core manifold and the identifiability of the native high-dimensional coordinates, thereby improving the predictability of high-dimensional high-bandwidth tokens. We also propose MP-ELD, a single-token AR flow-matching framework that uses multi-path information routing and residual classifier-free guidance to mitigate error accumulation. Experiments with 8-Hz, 768-dimensional tokens show that our design preserves reconstruction quality, improves single-token predictability, achieves competitive WER, and maintains stable long-form synthesis, without using external SSL/ASR models, pretrained text language models, or post-training stages.
papers.justification: 论文提出低帧率高维连续token的自回归语音生成框架，通过Locodec和MP-ELD提升长时稳定性与保真度，与生成式语音技术高度相关，属于前沿高质量工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 自回归语音生成中，高帧率或高容量表征虽保留细节但易导致长时生成分布漂移和误差累积，而低帧率压缩表征会丢失重要成分、限制重建保真度，难以同时平衡序列长度、表征容量和稳定性。
chinese_summary.method: 提出Locodec与MP-ELD协同框架：Locodec通过局部编码构造高维连续表征空间，提升低维核心流形的可插值性和原生高维坐标的可辨识性，增强高带宽token的可预测性；MP-ELD作为单token自回归流匹配生成器，采用多路径信息路由与残差无分类器引导，抑制误差累积，实现8Hz帧率、768维token的稳定长序列生成。
chinese_summary.innovation: 设计低帧率高维连续表征与流式生成框架的协同机制，在极低帧率下保持高带宽信息；Locodec针对性塑造表征空间的几何统计特性以提升token可预测性，区别于传统瓶颈层压缩；MP-ELD引入多路径路由和残差CFG改进AR流匹配的稳定性，无需外部SSL/ASR或预训练语言模型。
chinese_summary.evidence: 实验采用8Hz、768维token，验证了重建质量不降、单token可预测性提升、词错误率（WER）有竞争力，并实现稳定长文本合成，未依赖外部模型或后训练阶段。
chinese_summary.limitations: 未明确是否支持文本条件控制；流式实时性及计算代价未量化；泛化到多语种或噪声环境需验证；低帧率重建的感知质量上限待确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接对应研究方向中的generative speech generation与flow matching speech，核心方法涉及自回归生成、连续高维表征及流匹配框架，与生成式语音合成、神经声码器及扩散/流模型应用高度一致，关键词命中的speech generation、flow matching speech均紧密匹配。

papers.title: Mini-Omni: Language Models Can Hear, Talk While Thinking in Streaming
papers.summary: Recent advances in language models have achieved significant progress. GPT-4o, as a new milestone, has enabled real-time conversations with humans, demonstrating near-human natural fluency. Such human-computer interaction necessitates models with the capability to perform reasoning directly with the audio modality and generate output in streaming. However, this remains beyond the reach of current academic models, as they typically depend on extra TTS systems for speech synthesis, resulting in undesirable latency. This paper introduces the Mini-Omni, an audio-based end-to-end conversational model, capable of real-time speech interaction. To achieve this capability, we propose a text-instructed speech generation method, along with batch-parallel strategies during inference to further boost the performance. Our method also helps to retain the original model's language capabilities with minimal degradation, enabling other works to establish real-time interaction capabilities. We call this training method"Any Model Can Talk". We also introduce the VoiceAssistant-400K dataset to fine-tune models optimized for speech output. To our best knowledge, Mini-Omni is the first fully end-to-end, open-source model for real-time speech interaction, offering valuable potential for future research.
papers.justification: 提出首个开源端到端实时语音交互模型，为生成式语音技术提供新范式。

chinese_summary.problem: 实现端到端实时语音交互模型，消除级联语音合成系统带来的延迟。
chinese_summary.method: 提出Mini-Omni模型，采用文本指导的语音生成方法直接输出语音；利用批并行推理策略加速解码；通过“Any Model Can Talk”训练方法在保持语言能力的同时赋予模型说话能力，并使用VoiceAssistant-400K数据集进行微调。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次实现完全端到端、开源的实时语音交互模型，无需外部TTS；提出文本指导的语音生成和批并行推理，降低延迟并提升效率；设计通用训练方案使任何语言模型具备语音输出能力。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要未提供具体实验数据或系统评测指标，仅声称“据我们所知是首个”，证据不足。
chinese_summary.limitations: 缺乏定量性能评估；实时交互时的语音自然度、鲁棒性或推理效率未知；数据集VoiceAssistant-400K的规模与覆盖范围需要确认；方法可能更侧重系统集成而非生成模型的创新。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文涉及语音生成（speech generation）和语音合成（speech synthesis），匹配研究方向中的泛语音生成技术，但侧重对话系统集成，与生成方法（如扩散模型、声码器）的直接关联较弱，需人工确认其对生成式语音质量提升的具体贡献。

papers.title: GLM-4-Voice: Towards Intelligent and Human-Like End-to-End Spoken Chatbot
papers.summary: We introduce GLM-4-Voice, an intelligent and human-like end-to-end spoken chatbot. It supports both Chinese and English, engages in real-time voice conversations, and varies vocal nuances such as emotion, intonation, speech rate, and dialect according to user instructions. GLM-4-Voice uses an ultra-low bitrate (175bps), single-codebook speech tokenizer with 12.5Hz frame rate derived from an automatic speech recognition (ASR) model by incorporating a vector-quantized bottleneck into the encoder. To efficiently transfer knowledge from text to speech modalities, we synthesize speech-text interleaved data from existing text pre-training corpora using a text-to-token model. We continue pre-training from the pre-trained text language model GLM-4-9B with a combination of unsupervised speech data, interleaved speech-text data, and supervised speech-text data, scaling up to 1 trillion tokens, achieving state-of-the-art performance in both speech language modeling and spoken question answering. We then fine-tune the pre-trained model with high-quality conversational speech data, achieving superior performance compared to existing baselines in both conversational ability and speech quality. The open models can be accessed through https://github.com/THUDM/GLM-4-Voice and https://huggingface.co/THUDM/glm-4-voice-9b.
papers.justification: 提出端到端语音对话系统GLM-4-Voice，结合单码本语音分词器与预训练文本语言模型，在语音语言建模和口语问答上达到最优，与生成式语音技术方向高度相关，是必读级工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 论文旨在构建一种智能且拟人化的端到端口语对话系统，能够实时进行中英文语音交流，并根据用户指令调整情感、语调、语速和方言等副语言特征。
chinese_summary.method: 核心方法包括：利用基于ASR编码器引入向量量化瓶颈的超低码率（175 bps）单码本语音分词器，帧率12.5Hz；通过文本到标记模型将文本预训练语料转化为语音-文本交错数据；基于预训练文本语言模型GLM-4-9B，使用无监督语音数据、交错数据和监督数据继续预训练至1万亿令牌；最后在高品质对话语音数据上微调。
chinese_summary.innovation: 提出一种超低码率、单码本的语音分词器，在极低帧率下保持语音质量；设计了语音-文本交错数据生成流程，有效将文本知识迁移至语音模态；实现了在大规模多模态数据下继续预训练文本LLM，达到语音语言建模和口语问答的领先性能。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要中提及模型在语音语言建模和口语问答任务上达到state-of-the-art性能，并在对话能力和语音质量上超越现有基线；开源模型已发布。但未提供具体实验数据。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未明确语音合成或增强的分辨率限制，也未提及多说话人泛化性；低码率分词器可能丢失重要声学细节，影响生成语音的自然度；需阅读全文以确认其在语音生成质量上的客观指标。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文涉及语音生成模型和神经语音编解码，与研究方向中的语音合成、神经声码器和生成模型存在一定技术交叉，但其核心是对话系统而非语音增强或复原，相关性较弱。

papers.title: IndexTTS2: A Breakthrough in Emotionally Expressive and Duration-Controlled Auto-Regressive Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech
papers.summary: Existing autoregressive large-scale text-to-speech (TTS) models have advantages in speech naturalness, but their token-by-token generation mechanism makes it difficult to precisely control the duration of synthesized speech. This becomes a significant limitation in applications requiring strict audio-visual synchronization, such as video dubbing. This paper introduces IndexTTS2, which proposes a novel, general, and autoregressive model-friendly method for speech duration control. The method supports two generation modes: one explicitly specifies the number of generated tokens to precisely control speech duration; the other freely generates speech in an autoregressive manner without specifying the number of tokens, while faithfully reproducing the prosodic features of the input prompt. Furthermore, IndexTTS2 achieves disentanglement between emotional expression and speaker identity, enabling independent control over timbre and emotion. In the zero-shot setting, the model can accurately reconstruct the target timbre (from the timbre prompt) while perfectly reproducing the specified emotional tone (from the style prompt). To enhance speech clarity in highly emotional expressions, we incorporate GPT latent representations and design a novel three-stage training paradigm to improve the stability of the generated speech. Additionally, to lower the barrier for emotional control, we designed a soft instruction mechanism based on text descriptions by fine-tuning Qwen3, effectively guiding the generation of speech with the desired emotional orientation. Finally, experimental results on multiple datasets show that IndexTTS2 outperforms state-of-the-art zero-shot TTS models in terms of word error rate, speaker similarity, and emotional fidelity.
papers.justification: 该工作提出新颖的自回归TTS时长控制与情感解耦方法，显著提升零样本语音合成的可控性和表现力，与生成式语音技术方向高度相关，是TTS领域的重要进展。

chinese_summary.problem: 现有自回归TTS模型难以精确控制合成语音的时长，限制了在音视频同步等场景的应用。
chinese_summary.method: 提出IndexTTS2，通过指定生成token数量实现精确时长控制，同时支持自由生成模式保持韵律；将情感表达与说话人身份解耦，利用独立的音色和风格提示实现零样本可控生成；融入GPT潜在表征并设计三阶段训练提升高情感语音的清晰度和稳定性；基于Qwen3微调的文本软指令机制，支持自然语言描述引导情感控制。
chinese_summary.innovation: 提出一种通用且自回归模型友好的时长控制方法，实现精确或自由的时长生成；首次在自回归TTS中将情感与音色完全解耦，无需微调即可零样本控制两者；引入GPT潜在表征与三阶段训练提升情感语音质量；利用大语言模型实现文本软指令情感控制，降低使用门槛。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，IndexTTS2在词错误率、说话人相似度和情感保真度上均优于当前最先进的零样本TTS模型。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未提及推理速度与计算开销，情感控制的精细度与范围需要进一步验证，时长控制的具体量化指标未给出。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 研究方向明确包含语音合成与TTS，本论文聚焦零样本文本到语音的生成，属于生成式语音技术范畴；论文在情感控制、时长控制上的创新可为相关研究提供参考，但方法基于自回归模型，与研究方向中强调的扩散模型、流匹配等方法有所区别，需结合自身侧重点判断参考价值。

papers.title: AnyBand: Unified Multi-Bandwidth Speech Extension via Frequency-Aware In-Context Spectral Infilling
papers.summary: Bandwidth extension (BWE) aims to recover missing high-frequency content from band-limited speech. Existing methods often formulate BWE as a fixed or predefined bandwidth conversion problem, potentially requiring cutoff-specific models or retraining when the input bandwidth changes. This assumption limits their applicability to practical scenarios where speech may arrive with diverse cutoff frequencies. We propose AnyBand, a unified BWE framework that recasts bandwidth extension as in-context spectral infilling. Motivated by prompt-based zero-shot speech generation, AnyBand conditions high-frequency generation on the observed low-frequency spectrum, using the available band as a frequency-domain prompt that conveys content, speaker, prosodic, and spectral-envelope cues. This formulation enables a single model to perform cutoff-conditioned generation over a continuous range of input bandwidths. AnyBand is trained with missing-band conditional flow matching and an Easy-to-Balanced cutoff curriculum over continuously sampled cutoff frequencies. To better exploit the spectral prompt, we introduce a frequency-aware Diffusion Transformer that models cross-frequency interactions and long-range temporal dependencies, followed by a physically motivated multi-view adversarial refinement stage to enhance spectral realism, envelope coherence, and harmonic consistency. Experiments on multiple datasets and bandwidth settings show that AnyBand consistently improves spectral reconstruction over existing baselines while achieving competitive perceptual quality across both standard and irregular input cutoffs. Audio samples are available.
papers.justification: 提出面向任意输入带宽的统一语音扩展框架，将带宽扩展转化为上下文频谱填充任务，结合流匹配与频率感知扩散变换器，与生成式语音增强方向高度相关，方法新颖且质量扎实。

chinese_summary.problem: 解决任意截断频率的语音带宽扩展问题，从带限语音中恢复缺失高频，无需针对特定截止频率训练或重新训练模型。
chinese_summary.method: 将带宽扩展重新定义为上下文频谱填充，以观测低频作为频域提示，利用缺失带条件流匹配训练，采用从易到平衡的截止频率课程，设计频率感知扩散变换器建模跨频率交互和长时依赖，并通过多视角对抗细化提升频谱真实感、包络相干性和谐波一致性。
chinese_summary.innovation: 提出统一的 AnyBand 框架，支持连续截止频率范围的带宽扩展，不再依赖固定转换或特定模型；首次将带宽扩展形式化为频谱上下文填充，引入频域提示范式；结合条件流匹配、频率感知扩散变换器和多视角对抗细化，增强生成质量和模型泛化能力。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在多个数据集和不同带宽设置上进行实验，AnyBand 在频谱重建指标上优于现有基线，且在标准和非标准截断下均达到有竞争力的感知质量，并提供了音频样本供听感验证。
chinese_summary.limitations: 未明确提及模型计算复杂度、实时性、对极端低带宽或噪声数据的鲁棒性，需阅读全文确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 直接匹配研究方向中的生成式语音增强和带宽扩展，方法采用流匹配、扩散变换器、对抗训练等生成式技术，且针对通用截断频率，属于语音生成与恢复的核心问题。

papers.title: SAGE: Switch-Aware EEG-Guided Soft Gating for Target Speaker Extraction with In-Trial Switching
papers.summary: EEG-guided target speaker extraction is challenging under in-trial auditory attention switching, where neural noise and intrinsic latency can delay or destabilize attention tracking. Conventional methods struggle with dynamic switches and often cause discontinuities at switching points. Therefore, we propose SAGE, a switch-aware EEG-guided soft gating framework that treats in-trial switching as dynamic selection. SAGE generates two candidate speech streams with a robust separator and uses an EEG-guided switch-aware gating module to produce smooth fusion weights and suppress transition artifacts. We further integrate latency-compensated alignment and an uncertainty-driven conservative strategy to handle latency discrepancies and fluctuating EEG reliability. SAGE outperforms baselines, achieving 8.67 dB SI-SDR and 88.24% STOI while reducing average switching latency to 2.04 s. By coupling neural decoding with speech separation, it enables robust target extraction in dynamic scenarios.
papers.topic_name: Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction
papers.justification: 论文提出EEG引导的切换感知软门控框架，解决试验内听觉注意力切换下的目标说话人提取问题，与语音分离与目标说话人提取方向高度相关，方法新颖（动态选择、延迟补偿、不确定性策略），实验有效，属前沿扎实工作。

chinese_summary.problem: EEG引导的目标说话人提取在试验内听觉注意力动态切换时面临神经噪声和延迟导致的注意力跟踪不稳定，传统方法在切换点容易产生不连续或伪影。
chinese_summary.method: SAGE框架首先利用稳健分离器生成两个候选语音流，再通过EEG引导的切换感知门控模块产生平滑融合权重，同时集成延迟补偿对齐和基于不确定性的保守策略以应对EEG延迟和可靠性波动。
chinese_summary.innovation: 将试验内切换建模为动态选择问题，引入软门控替代硬切换以抑制过渡伪影；采用延迟补偿对齐和不确定性驱动策略提升EEG引导的鲁棒性；在目标说话人提取框架中融合神经解码与语音分离，实现动态场景下的连续提取。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在含切换的实验设置下，SAGE达到8.67 dB SI-SDR和88.24% STOI，平均切换延迟降至2.04秒，优于对比基线。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未说明基线方法具体构成、EEG数据规模和场景复杂度；仅给出整体指标，切换点附近的局部性能未知；框架依赖EEG可靠性，对信号质量不良场景的适应能力待验证。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接针对目标说话人提取任务，关键词高度匹配（target speaker extraction, speech separation, speaker extraction），且首次系统处理试验内切换这一实际难题，与研究方向的动态场景分离需求相关。但引入EEG信号使得方法与纯音频分离有所不同，需确认是否与个人研究路线吻合。
