papers.title: DRONEAUDIONET: Noise Suppression for Drone Audition-based Search and Rescue
papers.summary: Microphones mounted on UAVs enable aerial acoustic scene analysis applications such as search-and-rescue, wildlife monitoring, and industrial inspection. However, drone rotor noise often dominates the mixture signal at SNRs well below -10 dB, making source recovery extremely challenging. Existing enhancement and source separation methods are typically designed for near-balanced mixtures and degrade substantially in drone audition settings. In this work, we propose DRONEAUDIONET, a drone noise suppression method that reframes a source separation model as a drone noise estimator. To better model drone-dominant mixtures, we introduce a learnable mask-scaling mechanism that allows mask magnitudes beyond unity, together with an additive residual correction term for improved drone estimation and source recovery. We train and evaluate our model on a publicly available drone audition dataset and test generalizability on an out-of-domain dataset with unseen drone hardware and flight modes. Results show that DRONEAUDIONET consistently improves downstream sound classification performance, with the largest gains observed for human vocal sounds. Our findings demonstrate the importance of drone-specific modeling for robust aerial acoustic perception and highlight the potential of source separation methods for real-world drone-assisted search-and-rescue.
papers.topic_name: Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction
papers.justification: 提出面向无人机噪声的增强方法，引入可学习掩码缩放与残差校正，与语音增强和分离方向高度相关，质量扎实。

chinese_summary.problem: 在无人机搭载麦克风进行空中声学场景分析时，强转子噪声（SNR常低于-10 dB）淹没有用声源，传统增强与分离方法在无人机场景下性能严重退化。
chinese_summary.method: 将源分离模型重构为无人机噪声估计器，不直接分离目标声源，而是先估计噪声再抑制；引入可学习掩蔽缩放机制，允许掩蔽幅度超过1，并附加残差校正项以提升噪声估计和声源恢复质量。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次针对无人机极端噪声环境，将源分离范式转化为专用噪声估计器；设计了可突破传统掩蔽界限的 learnable mask-scaling 策略；同时添加残差校正模块，共同增强对无人机噪声的建模精度。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在公开无人机听觉数据集上训练和评估，并在未见过的无人机硬件和飞行模式上进行泛化测试，结果表明 DRONEAUDIONET 能持续提升下游声音分类准确率，对人声提升尤为显著。
chinese_summary.limitations: 任务聚焦于无人机噪声抑制，并非多说话人分离；评估仅基于下游分类指标，缺少直接分离质量指标（如 SI-SDR）；实际部署的实时性和计算复杂度未说明。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接使用源分离模型并改进其掩蔽机制，所提 learnable mask-scaling 与残差校正可迁移至低信噪比语音分离任务，但方向侧重噪声估计而非多源分离，与研究主题“目标说话人提取”时部分相关。

papers.title: Experience-Calibrated Contrastive Decoding for Mitigating Hallucinations in LM-Based Text-to-Speech
papers.summary: Language model-based text-to-speech (LM-based TTS) remains vulnerable to speech hallucinations that deviate from the target text. Existing mitigation mainly relies on architectural changes or additional training, while decoding-time control remains underexplored. We present a conditional information view that distinguishes text-derived alignment information from experience information supplied by acoustic context and learned speech regularities. We hypothesize that an important class of hallucinations begins when alignment support is insufficiently reflected in the selected token at a vulnerable transition. Using predictions from the same speech LM with and without text conditions, we propose Experience-Calibrated Contrastive Decoding (ECCD), a training-free method that strengthens alignment support while preserving useful experience information. ECCD preserves the original expert distribution, applies only positive alignment enhancement, and calibrates its strength using set-level experience compatibility. Across four models, ECCD reduces WER/CER by up to 55.6% in all SeedTTS-Eval settings and 24 of 25 multilingual CV3-Eval settings. A listening test yields a CMOS gain of $+0.644$ while retaining strong speaker similarity. Further analysis shows that alignment influence and decision-level gain vary within linguistic units and are lower at first-error boundaries than at matched correct boundaries. Overall, these extensive experiments and analyses identify conditional information control as a promising decoding-time direction for mitigating speech hallucination.
papers.topic_name: Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction
papers.justification: 提出无需训练的对比解码方法缓解LM-TTS幻觉，属于语音合成前沿技术，与生成式语音技术方向高度相关，实验扎实有效。

chinese_summary.problem: 论文解决语言模型驱动的语音合成（LM-based TTS）中生成的语音偏离输入文本（即语音幻觉）的问题，尤其是在解码生成阶段由于对齐信息不足导致的幻觉。
chinese_summary.method: 提出一种无需训练的解码时控制方法：Experience-Calibrated Contrastive Decoding (ECCD)。该方法利用同一个语音LM在有无文本条件下的预测，分离文本对齐信息和声学上下文经验信息，通过仅增强对齐支持（正对齐强化）并利用集级别的经验兼容性自动校准增强强度，从而在解码时缓解幻觉。
chinese_summary.innovation: 创新点：1) 将语音幻觉归因于有条件信息视角下的对齐与经验信息冲突，并定位到弱势转换点；2) 提出纯解码端控制的ECCD方法，无需修改模型架构或额外训练，仅通过对比解码动态调整对齐权重；3) 引入集级别经验兼容性自动校准机制，避免手工调参。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在4个模型上的实验显示，ECCD在SeedTTS-Eval全部设置中WER/CER最多降低55.6%，在25个多语言CV3-Eval设置中的24个取得提升；听力测试CMOS增益+0.644且保持说话人相似度；分析表明对齐影响和决策增益随语言单元变化，且在首次错误边界的增益低于正确边界。
chinese_summary.limitations: 可能仅适用于LM-based TTS框架，且解码时的对比计算可能增加推理开销；实际扩展至其他语音生成任务的泛化性尚需验证。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 研究方向为语音分离与目标说话人提取，而本论文关注TTS的幻觉缓解，两者同属语音处理领域但核心任务（分离 vs. 生成）无直接关联；仅共享深度学习和语音模态的背景，无具体关键词或场景匹配，需人工复核。

papers.title: Beyond One-Size-Fits-All: Personalized and Culturally Adaptive Emotional TTS via Interactive Optimization of Individual Emotion Perception Spaces
papers.summary: The rise of conversational AI has increased interest in emotional Text-to-Speech (TTS). Most systems rely on discrete emotion labels, which fail to capture the nuanced nature of human affect. Recent models employ dimensional representations such as Russell's arousal-valence (A-V) model, offering finer control. However, emotional perception varies across individuals and cultures, which may cause mismatches between modeled and perceived emotions. We propose a personalized and culturally adaptive emotional TTS framework that performs interactive optimization of individualized A-V perception spaces using an Interactive Genetic Algorithm. By adapting emotion representations to each listener, the system produces speech with more perceptually aligned emotional expression than models using averaged A-V values. Evaluations with Japanese, Chinese, and Indonesian participants highlight the importance of personalization and cultural adaptation for moving beyond one-size-fits-all emotional TTS.
papers.justification: 提出个性化与文化适应的情感TTS框架，通过交互式遗传算法优化个体感知空间，与生成式语音技术方向高度相关，质量扎实。

chinese_summary.problem: 传统情感TTS使用离散标签或通用维度模型，无法适应个体和文化差异导致的情感感知偏差，该论文旨在解决如何为每个听众个性化情感表达，使合成语音与听众主观感知对齐。
chinese_summary.method: 提出一种个性化与文化自适应情感TTS框架，核心是使用交互式遗传算法动态优化每个听众的唤醒-效价感知空间，迭代调整情感表达参数，生成感知对齐的语音，而不是依赖群体平均的A-V值。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次将交互式遗传算法用于情感TTS的个体感知空间优化，突破全局固定的情感表示；同时整合文化适应性，通过跨文化实验证明个性化在减少感知偏差上的优势。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要报告了日本、中国、印尼参与者的评估实验，显示该方法在情感表达感知对齐上优于基于平均A-V值的模型，但未给出具体性能指标。
chinese_summary.limitations: 实验细节不足，如交互次数、收敛标准、遗传算法参数；未对比其他个性化方法；文化样本有限，泛化性待验证。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文属于text-to-speech，与研究方向中的“speech synthesis and TTS”直接相关，并涉及情感语音生成的个性化控制，可作为个性化TTS的参考，但不涉及生成模型结构或训练方法。

papers.title: Identity-Faithful Audio-Visual Target Speaker Extraction with QIANGDA and VOXBLINK2-AVSE
papers.summary: Audio-visual target speaker extraction should return the speaker indicated by the video, yet a separator can ignore the visual cue and repeatedly output the acoustically dominant voice. We introduce QIANGDA, a Mandarin AV-TSE benchmark of jointly recorded real two-speaker mixtures with synchronized multi-view video. Each scene also contains preceding A-only and B-only stages that provide in-scene speaker references. It contains 77 scenes and 7,598 clips (11.84 hours), including 6,042 dual-annotated mixtures. After processing there leave 6,038 evaluable mixtures and 12,076 target-speaker rows. We additionally curate VOXBLINK2-AVSE from VoxBlink2, comprising 250,828 synchronized audio--lip-ROI pairs from 28,421 identities and 766.17 hours of speech. Our extractor uses frozen, 1,280-dimensional projected AV-HuBERT features, target-conditioned training, and layer-wise feature modulation. We jointly evaluate content with Qwen3-ASR-1.7B CER and target identity with WeSpeaker ResNet34 plus Overlapped Speech Detection (OSD). On the complete manifest, the best archived checkpoint obtains 0.2261 CER, 82.22% strict output correctness, and 69.53% both-output strict success.
papers.topic_name: Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction
papers.justification: 高度相关语音分离与目标说话人提取方向，提出新基准QIANGDA和数据集VOXBLINK2-AVSE，结合AV-HuBERT的视听目标说话人提取方法，评估严谨，为视听分离领域的重要工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 解决视听目标说话人提取中，分离器忽略视觉提示而重复输出声学主导话音的身份忠实性问题。
chinese_summary.method: 提出 QIANGDA 评测基准（含真实双人混合语音与同步多视角视频，每个场景有前后单人参考段）与 VOXBLINK2-AVSE 数据集，采用冻结的 1,280 维 AV-HuBERT 特征，结合目标条件训练和逐层特征调制进行目标说话人提取。
chinese_summary.innovation: 构建首个中文真实双人混合视听目标说话人提取基准 QIANGDA，提供场景内说话人参考；利用 VoxBlink2 构建大规模同步音频-唇动 ROI 数据集 VOXBLINK2-AVSE；引入身份忠实评估，联合 ASR 字错率与说话人识别指标衡量提取内容的正确性和输出身份一致性。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在完整评测集上，最佳模型取得 0.2261 CER、82.22% 严格输出正确率和 69.53% 双输出严格成功率。
chinese_summary.limitations: 中文评测集场景数有限（77 个场景）；仅提供闭集评估结果，跨数据集泛化性未验证；依赖冻结 AV-HuBERT 特征，可能限制端到端优化潜力。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接针对目标说话人提取任务，提出视听多模态基准与身份忠实性评估，研究方向完全匹配，关键词覆盖：target speaker extraction、speaker extraction、masking model（特征调制）

papers.title: Agogic: Performance-Timed Music Tokens for LLM-Native Text-to-Symbolic-Music Generation
papers.summary: Text-to-music language models begin with a choice usually made by default: how to tokenize music. Normally entangled with backbone, data, and recipe, its effect has never been measured in isolation. We fix pretrained Qwen3.5 (0.8B-27B), data, budget, and decoding, and swap only the representation across seven tokenizations, anchoring texture metrics to each representation's model-free ceiling. The ordering is clean and surprising: representation, not model size, is the binding variable for distributional fidelity. Scaling the backbone 34x barely moves Frechet Music Distance (FMD), whereas switching representation halves it. PMT, a performance-resolution stream we release (10 ms timing, per-note velocity, multi-track texture; 609 symbols), reaches FMD 159 at 0.8B against 272-286 for beat grids (1.7-1.8x lower, up to 2.8x elsewhere; non-overlapping bootstrap CIs), so a 0.8B performance-resolution model beats a 27B beat grid. It reappears on a 26M from-scratch backbone and a second performance-resolution tokenizer: a property of the class, not one lucky vocabulary. Nor is it a finer-lattice artifact: snapping PMT's onsets to the beat grids' resolution still leaves it 67-129 FMD ahead of both (n=500). The effect is distributional; whether it is audible is a separate question, left open by our probe, with a human study pre-registered. Native caption adherence is weak but separable: a lightweight decode-time constraint doubles instrument-F1 (.28 to .60) and Correct-Key (.16 to .35) at no distributional cost. We release the harness, 25+ checkpoints, two corpora (86.6k aligned across caption/MIDI/ABC/audio; 6.25M captioned, the largest for music), and an imprinting diagnostic: published text-to-MIDI systems reproduce their training distribution near-invariant to the caption (72% vs. 71% chord-time on disjoint domains). The field's next representation claim can now be measured, not asserted.
papers.justification: 提出性能定时音乐tokenization并系统比较，发现表示比模型规模对生成分布保真度影响更大，对音乐表示学习和生成方法有重要贡献，高度契合MIR研究方向。

chinese_summary.problem: 研究文本到符号音乐生成中，不同音乐标记化（tokenization）方案对生成模型分布保真度的影响，并解决现有方法中标记化选择缺乏独立测量的问题。
chinese_summary.method: 固定预训练语言模型骨架（Qwen3.5，0.8B-27B）和训练数据，仅替换七种不同的音乐标记化表示，通过比较 Frechet Music Distance (FMD) 等指标量化各表示对分布保真度的影响；提出性能时间音乐令牌（PMT），包含10ms时间精度、每个音符力度和多轨纹理（共609个符号），并提供轻量级解码约束以提升乐器一致性。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次独立分离并测量音乐标记化对文本到音乐语言模型分布保真度的影响，发现表示法（而非模型规模）是决定保真度的关键变量；提出PMT表示法，使0.8B模型在FMD上优于27B的节拍网格模型，证明性能分辨率表示可显著提升分布匹配；引入解码时约束，在不损失分布保真度的前提下，将乐器F1从0.28提升至0.60，Correct-Key从0.16提升至0.35。
chinese_summary.evidence: 7种标记化方案的对比实验，PMT在0.8B模型上FMD为159，节拍网格在0.8B和27B上分别为272-286；模型规模放大34倍对FMD改善微小，而切换表示可减半FMD；PMT onset对齐到节拍网格分辨率后仍领先67-129 FMD（n=500）；解码约束实验量化提升乐器F1和Correct-Key；发布工具包、25+检查点、两个语料库（86.6k对齐数据、6.25M有标注数据）以及印记诊断。
chinese_summary.limitations: 可听性未评估，仅关注分布指标，需后续人工研究确认实际听感；提出方法仅针对符号音乐生成，未涉及音频合成；数据集和模型为音乐领域，是否适用于其他符号序列生成尚不可知；需要阅读全文确认PMT泛化到新语言模型骨架的细节。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文属于符号音乐生成，核心为语言模型与离散标记化设计，与研究方向“Generative Speech Technology”中的语音生成、神经声码器或扩散模型无直接关联。尽管生成模型架构（如LLM）和标记化思路有间接参考价值，但研究对象、任务和评价指标（音乐分布保真度）均不匹配语音增强、合成或生成方向的关键场景。

papers.title: Separate-and-Detect: Unified Drum Transcription and Stem Generation via Latent Diffusion
papers.summary: Automatic Drum Transcription (ADT) is commonly formulated as a direct mapping from a music mixture to symbolic drum events. While effective for transcription, this formulation discards the acoustic stems that are useful for editing, remixing, and production. We revisit an alternative separate-and-detect formulation, where a drum source separation front end first produces five editable drum stems, and a fixed onset detector then converts each stem into symbolic events. The separator is built on a five-stem latent diffusion model that jointly generates kick, snare, toms, hi-hats, and cymbals in a compact VAE latent space. We further study two training-only auxiliary branches--an onset branch (OB) and a timbre branch (TB)--which shape the separator during learning but are discarded at inference. Trained on synthetic drum multitracks and evaluated on MDB Drums and ENST-Drums, the proposed pipeline consistently improves over a strong U-Net-based drum separation baseline in overall transcription F1. It also outperforms a representative end-to-end ADT system on kick and snare F1 under our evaluation protocol, while additionally providing separated audio stems. The ablation results show that OB gives the most stable transcription gains, whereas TB changes the trade-off between reconstruction, acoustic stem quality, and onset detection. These results suggest that generative drum demixing can serve not only as a source separation model, but also as a practical front end for interpretable drum transcription.
papers.topic_name: Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction
papers.justification: 将鼓源分离与自动记谱统一在潜在扩散模型中，同时生成可编辑音频茎与符号事件，在音乐信息检索和源分离方向高度相关且方法新颖，性能突出。

chinese_summary.problem: 将鼓自动转录（ADT）重新表述为分离后检测的流程：先用鼓源分离前端从音乐混合物中生成五个可编辑鼓音轨，再用固定起音检测器将各音轨转换为符号鼓事件，以同时获得可编辑音频素材和转录结果。
chinese_summary.method: 核心是分离后检测框架：前端分离器采用基于五音轨潜在扩散模型，在紧凑VAE潜空间联合生成kick、snare、toms、hi-hats和cymbals；后端起音检测器固定不变。训练时引入两个辅助分支：起音分支（OB）和音色分支（TB），仅在训练时塑造分离器性能，推理时丢弃。
chinese_summary.innovation: 1. 将鼓转录重新构建为分离后检测范式，统一了音频素材生成和符号转录任务，而非常规的混合到符号直接映射。2. 首次使用潜在扩散模型进行多轨鼓声源分离，在潜空间联合建模五种鼓音轨。3. 通过仅训练时使用的辅助分支（OB、TB）改进分离器的转录相关特征，不影响推理复杂度。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在合成鼓多轨数据上训练，在MDB Drums和ENST-Drums上评估，整体转录F1优于基于U-Net的鼓分离基线；起音和军鼓F1优于代表性端到端ADT系统；消融实验表明OB带来最稳定转录增益，TB影响重建、音质和起音检测的权衡。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未提及与现有目标说话人提取或通用语音分离方法的比较，仅限鼓声源场景；扩散模型可能计算开销较大；辅助分支对非鼓类源分离的泛化性未知；训练依赖合成数据，真实场景泛化需全文确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 该论文涉及源分离技术，命中关键词“source separation”，但研究聚焦音乐鼓声源分离与转录，并非语音分离或目标说话人提取。分离方法为潜在扩散模型，与领域主流的时域/时频掩蔽网络不同，且任务目标（生成可编辑鼓音轨）与语音分离差距较大。相关性主要在于同属源分离大范畴，但具体场景、评价指标和需求不匹配。

papers.title: Echo-Aware Modulation for Compact-Latent Frequency-Time Modeling in Lightweight Acoustic Echo Cancellation
papers.summary: Existing lightweight acoustic echo cancellation (AEC) systems often combine linear AEC with Bark-domain DNN-based suppression to lower the computational footprint. In such systems, downsampling layers further compress the input features into a compact bottleneck representation, but this compression weakens frequency-time modeling capacity and degrades performance. To mitigate this limitation, we propose MSA-EchoLite, a lightweight Bark-domain AEC framework with an asymmetric dual-branch encoder and an echo-aware frequency-time modulation (EAM) module. The EAM module enriches the compressed bottleneck representation by modeling discrepancy and correlation cues between the dual-branch microphone and echo-related latent features. Experimental results show that the Bark-domain variant of MSA-EchoLite offers a better performance-complexity trade-off than its frequency-domain counterpart but is more sensitive to feature compression. With only 26.1% additional FLOPs over its non-EAM Bark-domain variant, its EAM-enhanced version achieves 99.1% of the PESQ of the frequency-domain counterpart, which requires nearly twice the FLOPs, and even surpasses it in SDR. Overall, MSA-EchoLite outperforms state-of-the-art lightweight AEC models while using only 0.2 M parameters and 100 M FLOPs/s.
papers.justification: 该论文提出轻量级声学回声消除框架MSA-EchoLite，通过Bark域双分支编码器与回声感知频率-时间调制模块提升压缩瓶颈特征建模，与语音增强与音频前端方向高度相关，在轻量化AEC任务上取得创新与性能突破。

chinese_summary.problem: 轻量级声学回声消除（AEC）系统中，Bark域DNN抑制通过下采样压缩特征，导致时频建模能力下降，性能受限。
chinese_summary.method: 提出MSA-EchoLite轻量级Bark域AEC框架，采用非对称双分支编码器分别处理麦克风和回声信号，并引入回声感知时频调制（EAM）模块。EAM通过建模双分支潜在特征的差异和相关性线索，丰富压缩瓶颈表示，恢复丢失的时频信息，提升回声消除效果。
chinese_summary.innovation: 针对下采样压缩导致的时频建模损失，设计了回声感知调制模块，利用麦克风与回声间的互信息增强瓶颈表示；在极低参数（0.2 M）和计算量（100 M FLOPs/s）下实现与频域模型可比甚至更优的性能，显著改善轻量级AEC的性能-复杂度权衡。
chinese_summary.evidence: 实验表明，Bark域EAM增强版本相比无EAM版本仅增加26.1% FLOPs，PESQ达到频域模型（近双倍FLOPs）的99.1%，且SDR超越后者；整体优于现有轻量级AEC模型。
chinese_summary.limitations: Bark域变体对特征压缩更敏感，泛化至多通道、非平稳噪声等场景需进一步验证；非对称编码器和EAM模块的具体设计细节需阅读全文。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接针对声学回声消除（AEC），属于研究方向的核心任务，命中关键词“acoustic echo cancellation”和“residual echo suppression”；轻量级设计符合音频前端对计算效率的需求，方法涉及神经网络和特征压缩，与“neural masking, U-Net speech enhancement”等前端处理技术相关。

papers.title: GenSE: Generative Speech Enhancement via Language Models using Hierarchical Modeling
papers.summary: Semantic information refers to the meaning conveyed through words, phrases, and contextual relationships within a given linguistic structure. Humans can leverage semantic information, such as familiar linguistic patterns and contextual cues, to reconstruct incomplete or masked speech signals in noisy environments. However, existing speech enhancement (SE) approaches often overlook the rich semantic information embedded in speech, which is crucial for improving intelligibility, speaker consistency, and overall quality of enhanced speech signals. To enrich the SE model with semantic information, we employ language models as an efficient semantic learner and propose a comprehensive framework tailored for language model-based speech enhancement, called \textit{GenSE}. Specifically, we approach SE as a conditional language modeling task rather than a continuous signal regression problem defined in existing works. This is achieved by tokenizing speech signals into semantic tokens using a pre-trained self-supervised model and into acoustic tokens using a custom-designed single-quantizer neural codec model. To improve the stability of language model predictions, we propose a hierarchical modeling method that decouples the generation of clean semantic tokens and clean acoustic tokens into two distinct stages. Moreover, we introduce a token chain prompting mechanism during the acoustic token generation stage to ensure timbre consistency throughout the speech enhancement process. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our proposed approach outperforms state-of-the-art SE systems in terms of speech quality and generalization capability.
papers.justification: 提出基于语言模型的生成式语音增强框架GenSE，通过分层建模将语义与声学解耦，显著提升语音质量与泛化性，高度契合生成式语音技术方向。

chinese_summary.problem: 现有语音增强方法忽略语音中的语义信息，导致在噪声环境中恢复语音的可懂度和质量受限，本文旨在利用语言模型捕获语义信息来提升语音增强性能。
chinese_summary.method: 将语音增强转化为条件语言建模任务：首先用预训练自监督模型提取语义token，用单量化器神经编解码器提取声学token；然后分两阶段分层生成，先基于噪声语音的语义和声学token预测干净语义token，再结合干净语义token和噪声声学token生成干净声学token，并通过token链提示机制保持说话人音色一致性。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次将语音增强视为条件语言建模问题，而非传统的信号回归；提出分层建模将语义和声学token的生成解耦，提升预测稳定性；引入token链提示机制在声学token生成过程中约束说话人特征，确保音色连贯。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在基准数据集上实验，结果显示所提方法在语音质量和泛化能力上优于现有最先进系统。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未说明具体评估指标和数据集细节；分层建模可能增加推理延迟；对语义token提取模型的依赖可能影响鲁棒性；未提及在低资源或极端噪声下的表现。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接对应研究方向中的“generative speech enhancement”，采用生成式建模思路，且使用神经编解码器和语言模型，与语音合成、神经声码器等技术相通，为生成式语音处理提供新范式。

papers.title: GROW: Group-Relative Advantage-Weighted On-Policy Reinforcement Learning of Autoregressive-Diffusion Text-to-Speech model
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning for flow-matching text-to-speech is complicated by deterministic ODE sampling: trajectory-level policy-gradient methods typically convert the ODE into an SDE and track per-step likelihood ratios, introducing stochastic perturbations and substantial overhead. We propose GROW, a group-relative advantage-weighted on-policy RL method that acts directly on the standard flow-matching objective. For each prompt, GROW samples a group of on-policy utterances, separately standardizes intelligibility and speaker-similarity rewards within the group, and combines them to reweight flow-matching regression. A Wasserstein-2 velocity penalty anchors the updated model to a frozen pretrained reference. A group-mean reward baseline is introduced to convert reward weighting into advantage weighting. For strong pretrained TTS models with concentrated rewards, positive exponential weighting is dominated by reward-agnostic self-imitation, whereas a zero-mean signed advantage preserves effective within-group credit assignment. Instantiated on DiTAR and evaluated on LibriSpeech and Seed-TTS EN/ZH, GROW reduces average WER from 2.016 to 1.558 and raises speaker similarity from 0.676 to 0.715 while keeping UTMOS. With 10-NFE training rollouts and 32-NFE evaluation, GROW retains comparable performance while training 2.9x faster than 32-NFE DiTAR-GRPO. We will open-source complete GROW codes, faithful DiTAR reproduction, and all model checkpoints.
papers.justification: 提出一种针对流匹配TTS的组相对优势加权在线策略RL方法，解决确定性ODE采样难题，显著提升合成语音智能度和说话人相似度，高度匹配生成式语音技术方向。

chinese_summary.problem: 流匹配文本到语音合成中，基于轨迹策略梯度的强化学习方法需将确定性常微分方程（ODE）转换为随机微分方程（SDE），引入随机扰动和巨大计算开销，导致训练复杂且低效。
chinese_summary.method: 提出GROW，一种组相对优势加权的策略在线强化学习方法，直接作用于标准流匹配目标。对每个提示采样一组在线生成话语，在组内分别标准化可懂度和说话人相似度奖励，组合后重新加权流匹配回归损失；引入Wasserstein-2速度惩罚将更新模型锚定到冻结的预训练参考模型，并将组平均奖励作为基线转换奖励加权为优势加权；针对强预训练模型奖励集中的情况，使用零均值符号化优势避免正指数加权被自模仿主导，实现有效的组内信用分配。
chinese_summary.innovation: 1) 无需将流匹配的确定性ODE转换为SDE，直接在原始流匹配目标上进行在线策略强化学习，避免随机扰动和额外开销；2) 引入组内奖励标准化和优势加权，并针对强预训练TTS模型采用零均值符号化优势，解决奖励集中时自模仿主导问题；3) 使用Wasserstein-2速度惩罚来保持生成质量，防止模型偏离预训练参考。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在DiTAR模型上验证，LibriSpeech和Seed-TTS EN/ZH数据集上的实验结果显示，GROW将平均词错率（WER）从2.016降至1.558，说话人相似度从0.676提升至0.715，且UTMOS保持不变；训练速度比32-NFE DiTAR-GRPO快2.9倍（使用10-NFE训练rollouts和32-NFE评估）。
chinese_summary.limitations: 实验仅基于DiTAR一种模型，泛化性未知；奖励仅考虑可懂度和说话人相似度，未涵盖自然度等维度；零均值符号优势可能仅适用于奖励集中的预训练模型；仅与GRPO对比，缺乏更多基线。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 该论文针对流匹配文本到语音合成提出新的强化学习方法，直接对应研究方向中的“speech synthesis and TTS”和“flow matching speech”，可提升基于流匹配的TTS模型的语音质量，属于高度相关。

papers.title: Towards Real-world Environment-aware Zero-shot Text-to-speech Synthesis via Disentangled Audio Infilling
papers.summary: Recent zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) systems achieve remarkable naturalness and speaker similarity but typically require high-quality speaker prompts and either strip away or entangle the acoustic environment with speaker characteristics, limiting their real-world applicability. We present an extended DAIEN-TTS, an environment-aware zero-shot TTS framework that disentangles and jointly models speech, background noise, and reverberation, enabling independent control over timbre and acoustic environment through separate speaker and environment prompts. Built upon the flow-matching-based F5-TTS, it uses a speech-environment separation module to decompose environmental speech into speech, noise, and reverberation components, which are injected into the Diffusion Transformer for environment-aware generation. Training uses simulated data constructed by mixing clean speech with noise and room impulse responses, together with a cross-speaker conditioning strategy that suppresses speaker information leakage from the environment branch. When real-world data are available, the system can be further fine-tuned to bridge the simulated-to-real domain gap.At inference, a triple classifier-free guidance mechanism enables fine-grained control over speech, noise, and reverberation, and a signal-to-noise-ratio adaptation strategy aligns the synthesized speech with the environment prompt. Experiments on simulated and real-world test sets show that DAIEN-TTS generates environmental personalized speech with high naturalness, strong speaker similarity, and faithful noise and reverberation reproduction, while offering controllability beyond prior environment-aware TTS systems.
papers.justification: 该论文提出环境感知的零样本文本到语音合成框架DAIEN-TTS，通过解耦语音、噪声与混响，实现独立可控的环境生成，与生成式语音技术方向高度相关，方法新颖且实验扎实，属于必读级别工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 现有零样本TTS系统通常要求高质量说话人提示且无法独立控制语音音色和声学环境（噪声、混响），将环境与说话人特征纠缠，限制了在真实环境中的应用。
chinese_summary.method: 本文提出DAIEN-TTS，基于流匹配的F5-TTS框架，引入语音-环境分离模块，将环境语音分解为语音、噪声和混响分量，分别注入扩散变换器。训练时使用模拟数据（干净语音+噪声+房间冲激响应），并采用跨说话人条件策略，抑制环境分支中的说话人信息泄露。推理阶段结合三重无分类器引导和SNR自适应策略，实现独立的语音、噪声和混响可控生成。
chinese_summary.innovation: 针对零样本TTS，首次实现声学环境（噪声+混响）与说话人特征的解耦建模，允许独立提示控制；设计了语音-环境分离模块和跨说话人条件机制，有效防止环境分支泄露说话人信息；引入三重无分类器引导和SNR自适应，提升生成环境语音的忠实度和可控性。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在模拟和真实测试集上的实验表明，DAIEN-TTS生成的个性化环境语音具有高自然度、强说话人相似性，并能忠实地再现提示中的噪声和混响，同时可控性优于先前环境感知TTS系统。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要提到需真实数据微调以弥合模拟域到真实域的差距，且未说明对未见环境或非训练分布的泛化能力的评价；解耦模块的分离精度和计算效率需查阅全文。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 该论文专注于零样本文本到语音合成，采用流匹配生成框架，与研究方向中的语音合成、TTS、神经声码器、流匹配高度匹配。同时，其环境感知生成涉及噪声和混响的建模，与生成式语音增强和修复的思路存在关联。

papers.title: On the Geometry of Music Bandwidth Extension in Latent Spaces of Audio Codecs
papers.summary: Recent audio restoration increasingly relies on large-scale conditional latent generative modeling, including diffusion, Schrodinger Bridges, and Flow Matching variants, to invert degradations such as bandwidth limitation or noise. We present an analysis of the performance of various state-of-the-art methods compared to simple arithmetic transformations in the latent spaces of multiple neural codecs for musical bandwidth extension. We show that estimating a single transport vector between the clean and degraded latent centroids on a reference set, and adding it to degraded latents, can yield restoration performance competitive with large diffusion models. This suggests, first, that some neural codec latent spaces exhibit structure aligned with audio bandwidth; and second, that in such cases complex conditional models may offer only limited gains over a simple vector addition. We argue that these findings reveal an interesting avenue for future research whereby models could take advantage of the latent space structure in order to offer greater training and parameter efficiency, and overall better performance. Additionally, we propose to consider this simple arithmetic transformation as a baseline for music bandwidth extension research, as it allows an assessment of the contribution of learnable parameters towards restoration performance.
papers.justification: 该工作揭示了神经编解码器潜在空间与音频带宽对齐的结构特性，并提出简单算术变换作为音乐带宽扩展的强基线，与音乐信息检索及生成式语音技术方向高度相关，具有较强的洞察力和新颖性，属于必读级别。

chinese_summary.problem: 研究在音频编解码器潜在空间中，音乐带宽扩展任务上复杂条件生成模型与简单算术变换的性能差异，揭示潜在空间的几何结构特性。
chinese_summary.method: 在多种神经编解码器的潜在空间中，分别计算干净与退化音乐片段的潜在质心，获得传输向量，并直接加到退化潜在上进行带宽扩展；将该简单算术方法与扩散模型、流匹配等条件生成模型进行对比分析。
chinese_summary.innovation: 提出一种基于潜在空间质心传输向量的极简基线用于音乐带宽扩展；实验证明该方法在特定编解码器下能达到与大型扩散模型竞争的性能，表明部分潜在空间天然具备与带宽对齐的结构；呼吁将其作为基准，以区分可学习参数的贡献。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要称简单向量加法达到了与大型扩散模型竞争的性能，但未提供具体实验设置、评估指标或数值结果。
chinese_summary.limitations: 仅分析音乐场景，未验证在语音上的适用性；依赖特定编解码器，泛化性存疑；缺少量化指标和统计检验，可能仅在有限条件下成立。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 匹配关键词“bandwidth extension”，但聚焦于音乐而非语音；对生成式语音增强的潜在空间结构分析有潜在启发，但直接贡献较弱，需人工核实是否可为语音带宽扩展提供基线。

papers.title: Learning Music Style for Piano Arrangement Through Cross-Modal Bootstrapping
papers.summary: What is music style? Though often described using text labels such as "swing," "classical," or "emotional," the real style remains implicit and hidden in concrete music examples. In this paper, we introduce a cross-modal framework that learns implicit music styles from raw audio and applies them to symbolic music generation. Inspired by BLIP-2, our model leverages a Querying Transformer (Q-Former) to extract style representations from a large, pre-trained audio language model (LM), and further applies them to condition a symbolic LM for generating piano arrangements. We adopt a two-stage training strategy: contrastive learning to align auditory style with symbolic expression, followed by generative modeling for music arrangement. Our model generates piano performances jointly conditioned on a lead sheet (content) and a reference audio example (style), enabling controllable and stylistically faithful arrangement. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in piano cover generation, style transfer, and audio-to-MIDI retrieval, achieving substantial improvements in style-aware alignment and music quality.
papers.justification: 通过跨模态自举学习隐式音乐风格表示并用于钢琴编曲，与音乐信息检索与表示方向高度相关，方法新颖，实验效果显著。

chinese_summary.problem: 如何从原始音频中学习隐含的音乐风格表示，并将其应用于符号音乐生成（如钢琴编曲），实现风格可控的生成与迁移。
chinese_summary.method: 基于BLIP-2的跨模态框架，使用查询变换器（Q-Former）从预训练音频语言模型（LM）中提取风格表示，并作为条件引导符号语言模型生成钢琴编曲。训练分为两阶段：对比学习对齐听觉风格与符号表达，生成式建模进行音乐编曲。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次将BLIP-2风格的多模态对齐迁移到音乐领域，实现音频风格到符号生成的跨模态引导；通过对比学习与生成式两阶段训练，联合优化风格表示与生成质量；支持以参考音频为风格条件，结合主旋律内容进行可控、风格忠实的钢琴编曲。
chinese_summary.evidence: 实验覆盖钢琴翻奏生成、风格迁移和音频到MIDI检索任务，在风格对齐和音乐质量上均有显著提升，验证了方法的有效性。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未提及量化评估指标的具体数值；风格表示的可解释性及跨音乐类型的泛化能力需阅读全文确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 直接匹配研究方向中的音乐生成（music generation）、音频表示学习（audio representation learning）和音乐编码器（music encoder）；使用预训练音频语言模型提取风格，与自监督音频表示学习相关；涉及音乐信息检索（音频到MIDI检索）和符号音乐理解。

papers.title: Masked diffusion enables coherent beat tracking
papers.summary: Current neural networks for beat tracking generate invalid outputs, such as consecutive downbeats and erratic tempo changes, even when these are not present in the training data. Heavy post-processing techniques can alleviate these problems, but the original cause of this inconsistent behaviour remains unknown. We hypothesise that it stems from inadequate modelling of multiple plausible output beat grids, resulting in an invalid mixture of competing interpretations. We propose a masked diffusion approach that properly models multiple outputs and enables the model to build coherent predictions through iterative inference. We devise three modifications to standard masked diffusion that enable its application to beat tracking: independent masking of beats and downbeats during training and inference, a balanced masking scheduler for inference, and peak-picking across inference steps. Our approach reduces erratic behaviours and improves beat-tracking performance.
papers.justification: 论文提出掩码扩散模型用于节拍跟踪，解决输出不一致问题，属于音乐信息检索方向，与研究方向高度相关，方法新颖，质量扎实。

chinese_summary.problem: 解决节拍跟踪中现有神经网络输出不一致的问题，如产生连续重拍和不规则速度变化，即使训练数据无此模式。推测原因是模型未能对多个合理的节拍网格输出进行适当建模，导致混合了不一致的解释。
chinese_summary.method: 提出掩码扩散方法，通过迭代推理逐步生成连贯的节拍预测。核心改进包括：训练和推理时独立屏蔽节拍与重拍、设计平衡的掩码调度策略、在推理步之间执行峰值拾取。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次将掩码扩散应用于节拍跟踪，并针对该任务定制了三种关键机制：独立掩码节拍和重拍以保持其不同语义、平衡掩码调度以控制推理节奏、跨步峰值拾取融合多步预测，从而有效建模多种输出可能性并避免混合。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要声称方法减少了不稳定行为并提高了节拍跟踪性能，但未提供具体指标或消融实验，证据不足。
chinese_summary.limitations: 性能提升幅度未知，需核实实验是否在公开数据集上与先进方法对比；掩码扩散的迭代推理可能增加计算成本，实际部署效率待考察；仅针对音乐节拍任务，泛化性未提及。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文使用扩散模型，与我的研究方向中的生成式方法有方法学共性，但应用领域（音乐节拍跟踪）与语音生成完全无关，研究方向明确聚焦语音增强、合成、码器等，因此匹配度低，仅因arXiv分类重叠而获得基础分数。

papers.title: LILAC: An Idempotent Neural Speech Codec
papers.summary: Neural Audio Codecs are widely adopted in speech generation and editing. However, existing neural audio codecs are not idempotent: across the paper's twelve baseline systems, every configuration tested rewrites, on average, at least 15% of its tokens in a single decode-re-encode pass. This poses a problem for utilizing Neural Audio Codecs as token interfaces in pipelines where re-encoding decoded outputs can occur. We present LILAC, a fully convolutional 24 kHz speech codec at 9.375 Hz and 0.75 kbit/s that is codec idempotent by construction; re-encoding the decoded audio of any valid token stream returns the identical stream. LILAC achieves idempotency while maintaining competitive quality, reaching UTMOS 4.14 and 4.24 on LibriSpeech and LibriTTS-R test sets, comparable to SOTA sub-1 kbit/s Neural Audio Codecs.
papers.justification: 提出幂等神经语音编解码器LILAC，解决编解码令牌不一致问题，质量与SOTA低码率编解码器相当，与生成式语音技术方向高度相关。

chinese_summary.problem: 现有神经语音编解码器在解码-重编码过程中会改变令牌序列（平均至少15%令牌被改写），即不满足幂等性，这给在需要多次重编码的语音生成/编辑流水线中使用此类编解码器作为令牌接口带来问题。
chinese_summary.method: 提出LILAC，一个结构上保证编解码器幂等性的全卷积24 kHz语音编解码器，工作在9.375 Hz帧率、0.75 kbit/s比特率；其设计使得对任意合法令牌流解码得到的音频进行重编码后，输出令牌流与原始输入完全一致。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次构建了在结构上保证严格幂等性的神经语音编解码器，而非依赖训练或数据去近似；在极低比特率（0.75 kbit/s）下实现与当前最先进子kbit/s编解码器相当的质量，同时完全避免令牌扰动。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在LibriSpeech和LibriTTS-R测试集上UTMOS分别达到4.14和4.24，与SOTA子1 kbit/s神经音频编解码器质量可比，且重编码令牌一致率100%。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要仅提供客观MOS指标，未提及主观听力测试；未讨论在真实语音生成/编辑流水线中的端到端效果；模型限于24 kHz采样率，对更高或更低带宽场景的适应需验证。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 该工作直接服务于语音生成与编辑（摘要明确指出神经音频编解码器广泛用于此类任务），编解码器作为语音合成、TTS和声码器的核心组件，其幂等性缺陷会影响生成结果的可靠性与可复现性；我的研究方向涵盖生成式语音技术中的合成、声码器等，该编解码器可作为下游模块改善生成流水线的稳定性。

papers.title: InvFlowFD: Reference-Free and Background-Set-Free Perceptual Music Quality Metric with Flow Matching Inversion
papers.summary: Existing reference-free methods for evaluating music perceptual quality alleviate the need for paired noisy-clean data, but they still rely on a background set, which is used to compute aggregated statistics of clean audio samples. In this work, we propose a novel approach that eliminates this requirement, achieving background-set-free and reference-free quality estimation using only a pre-trained Flow Matching backbone. We demonstrate that unconditional Flow Matching inversion via simple Euler integration is sufficient to detect various artificial distortions and accurately rank music generation models against human perceptual judgments. We introduce InvFlowFD, which performs flow inversion and compares a group of inverted samples to the prior distribution. We evaluate our method against prior work, quantitatively and with a thorough human study. Results suggest that InvFlowFD is highly correlated with human perception of sound distortions, as well as generative models' quality, while being more flexible and less restrictive than existing metrics.
papers.justification: 该工作提出了一种无需参考音频和背景集的音乐感知质量指标，仅使用预训练流匹配模型的反演即可准确评估失真和生成模型质量，与研究方向中的音乐信息检索和生成质量评估高度相关，方法新颖且实验扎实。

chinese_summary.problem: 现有无参考音乐质量评估仍需依赖背景集合计算干净音频统计，论文旨在完全消除背景集合依赖，实现仅基于预训练Flow Matching模型的无参考、无背景集合音乐感知质量评估。
chinese_summary.method: 利用预训练Flow Matching模型作为主干，通过无条件Flow Matching反演（简单欧拉积分）对音频进行迭代去噪，将反演后的样本与先验分布比较以检测失真；引入InvFlowFD系统，对一组反演样本进行统计比较，输出与人类感知高度相关的质量分数。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次实现完全无参考且无背景集合的音乐质量指标，仅依赖单一预训练Flow Matching模型；证明简单的无条件流匹配反演足以区分人工失真并准确反映生成模型感知质量；无需成对数据或额外干净音频集，部署更灵活。
chinese_summary.evidence: 定量实验与详尽人类主观研究证明InvFlowFD与人类对音频失真及生成质量感知高度相关，且在灵活性上优于现有指标。
chinese_summary.limitations: 评估仅限于音乐领域，未验证对语音等其它音频的泛化能力；反演步数和先验分布的具体选择可能影响结果；与不同流匹配模型结构的耦合程度需进一步确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 工作涉及流匹配（Flow Matching）生成模型在音频质量评估的应用，流匹配模型也是您研究方向中的生成式语音方法之一，但论文核心是音乐质量度量，并非语音生成或增强技术；虽分类重合（cs.SD, cs.LG），但直接关联较弱，需人工确认是否将此类质量评估用于生成语音的客观评价。

papers.title: P-MUSE: Prompt-MIDI-Optional Model for Unified Instrumental Music Synthesis and Editing
papers.summary: MIDI-to-Music system renders the melody and rhythm of a target MIDI sequence into musical segment while cloning instrument timbre from a prompt recording. Existing systems typically adopt one of two distinct paradigms: conditional generation with prompt audio alone, which remains applicable when aligned prompt MIDI is unavailable, and In-Context Learning with paired prompt audio and MIDI, which exploits cross-modal alignment for stronger control on MIDI following and timbre similarity. We introduce P-MUSE, an instrumental MIDI-to-Music framework that unifies both paradigms via a multi-stage Curriculum-Learning supporting prompt-MIDI-optional inputs. P-MUSE further unifies music generation and local editing through a shared fill-in-the-middle formulation. Grounded in theoretical analysis and empirical study, we propose a phase-aware classifier-free guidance scheduling principle for Transcription-to-Audio systems, alongside a Tail-Drop strategy. Finally, to advance research in this field, we establish the first comprehensive benchmark, covering various prompt modes, generation/editing tasks, and four representative instruments: piano, guitar, bass, and drums. Demos are available at https://p-muse.github.io/.
papers.justification: 论文提出统一MIDI到音乐合成与编辑的框架，提出相位感知引导策略并建立新基准，与音乐信息检索与表示方向中的音乐生成相关，质量扎实。

chinese_summary.problem: 如何在统一的框架中支持可选的提示MIDI输入，同时实现音乐生成和局部编辑，并保证MIDI跟随准确度和音色克隆质量。
chinese_summary.method: P-MUSE采用多阶段课程学习，使模型能处理提示MIDI可选输入；利用统一的填充式建模将生成与编辑任务合并；提出相位感知的无分类器引导调度原则及Tail-Drop策略来优化转录到音频的合成控制。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次统一仅提示音频和配对提示两种范式，实现灵活的提示MIDI可选；通过填充公式统一音乐生成与局部编辑；针对转录到音频任务，提出相位感知CFG调度和Tail-Drop策略；建立首个覆盖多模式、多任务的综合评测基准。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要提及理论分析和实证研究，但未给出具体实验指标；已建立基准并提供Demos可访问。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未说明计算开销、多乐器泛化能力、合成自然度等，需阅读全文确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文核心属于音乐生成，与研究方向明确列出的‘music generation’高度匹配；同时音频合成中的引导方法可能间接关联音频表示学习。

papers.title: Towards Robust Version Identification in the Wild: A Dataset, Benchmark, and Fine-Tuning Study
papers.summary: Existing datasets for musical version identification (VI) are primarily derived from curated metadata sources such as SecondHandSongs and Discogs, and are therefore dominated by professionally recorded tracks. This leads to a domain mismatch with real-world scenarios, where amateur and user-generated content is prevalent. To address this limitation, we introduce DiVers, a large-scale VI dataset comprising over 1.1 million musical versions, with train-validation-test splits compatible with established datasets such as Discogs-VI-YT, SHS100K, and Da-TACOS. In addition to standard version-level annotations, DiVers provides automatically assigned tags (e.g., instrumental, live) and segment-level predictions indicating the presence or absence of music. We evaluate the proposed dataset by training state-of-the-art VI systems. Our results show that models trained on DiVers achieve substantially improved robustness to acoustically diverse and noisy inputs, while maintaining a stable performance on cleaner, studio-quality benchmarks. We release the dataset metadata, code for its construction, and all experimental pipelines to support reproducibility.
papers.justification: 该论文直接属于Music Information Retrieval方向，提出了大规模音乐版本识别数据集DiVers，包含自动标签和分割预测，提升了在真实场景中的鲁棒性，工作扎实，对MIR领域有贡献。

chinese_summary.problem: 现有音乐版本识别数据集主要源自专业录制曲目，导致模型对现实场景中业余录音、现场表演等用户生成内容的泛化能力不足。
chinese_summary.method: 构建大规模音乐版本识别数据集DiVers，含超过110万版本及自动标注（如器乐、现场）和音乐片段检测标签，拆分与已有基准兼容；在此基础上训练现有版本识别系统，验证其对声学多样和噪声输入的鲁棒性。
chinese_summary.innovation: 提出首个面向真实世界场景的大规模版本识别数据集DiVers，显著缓解域不匹配问题；自动提供器乐、现场等多维标签及片段级音乐检测，降低人工标注成本；数据拆分直接兼容Discogs-VI-YT、SHS100K等标准集，便于社区复用和基准测试。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要中报告了实验结论：在DiVers上训练的模型在声学多样且含噪输入下鲁棒性明显提升，同时在干净基准上性能稳定；但未给出具体指标，需查阅全文确认。
chinese_summary.limitations: 自动标签可能引入噪声，影响评估准确性；未涉及版本识别模型本身的改进，仅从数据角度提升鲁棒性；仅关注音乐音频，未探讨语音场景的适用性。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文专注于音乐版本识别的判别式任务，与生成式语音技术（语音增强、合成、TTS、神经声码器等）无直接关联。虽然arXiv分类cs.SD与研究方向有交集，但问题域、方法、模态均不匹配，仅泛泛相关，不建议阅读。

papers.title: Typing to Listen at the Cocktail Party: Text-Guided Target Speaker Extraction
papers.summary: Humans can easily isolate a single speaker from a complex acoustic environment, a capability referred to as the “cocktail party effect.” However, replicating this ability has been a significant challenge in the field of target speaker extraction (TSE). Traditional TSE approaches predominantly rely on voiceprints, which raise privacy concerns and face issues related to the quality and availability of enrollment samples, as well as intra-speaker variability. To address these issues, this work introduces a novel text-guided TSE paradigm named large language model (LLM)-TSE. In this paradigm, a state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLM, LLaMA 2, processes typed text input from users to extract semantic cues. We demonstrate that textual descriptions alone can effectively serve as cues for extraction, thus addressing privacy concerns and reducing dependency on voiceprints. Furthermore, our approach offers flexibility by allowing the user to specify the extraction or suppression of a speaker and enhances robustness against intra-speaker variability by incorporating context-dependent textual information. Experimental results show competitive performance with text-based cues alone and demonstrate the effectiveness of using text as a task selector. Additionally, they achieve a new SOTA when combining text-based cues with preregistered cues. This work represents the first integration of LLMs with TSE, potentially establishing a new benchmark in solving the cocktail party problem and expanding the scope of TSE applications by providing a versatile, privacy-conscious solution.
categories: IEEE Transactions on Cognitive and Developmental Systems
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Cognitive and Developmental Systems
papers.topic_name: Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction
papers.justification: 论文提出文本引导的目标说话人提取范式，首次将LLM引入TSE，与说话人分离方向高度相关，方法新颖且性能有竞争力，但引用数尚低，尚未成为广泛基线。

chinese_summary.problem: 传统目标说话人提取依赖声纹，面临隐私泄露、注册样本质量与可用性受限以及说话人内部变异等问题，本工作探索基于文本语义线索的替代方案。
chinese_summary.method: 提出 LLM-TSE 框架，利用预训练大语言模型 LLaMA 2 处理用户输入的文本描述，提取高层语义线索作为提取指导；该线索支持灵活指定提取或抑制某一说话人，并通过上下文文本信息增强对同一说话人不同发声的鲁棒性。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次将大语言模型与目标说话人提取集成，实现文本引导的提取范式；无需注册声纹，仅用文本描述解决隐私问题，并提供提取与抑制的双向控制；利用上下文文本建模缓解说话人内部变异，与预注册线索结合时达到最优性能。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要表明仅文本线索即可取得竞争性表现，并验证文本作为任务选择器的有效性；与预注册线索结合时达到新 SOTA 性能。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未给出实验数据集、评价指标和消融分析细节；依赖大语言模型可能引入额外延时，文本描述的歧义性可能影响提取精度，需阅读全文评估实际上限和实用性。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接解决目标说话人提取问题，与研究方向中的“target speaker extraction”“speaker extraction”及“cocktail party”关键词强相关，但通过文本引导替代声纹，非传统分离模型改进，属于同一任务的新输入模态探索，需人工复核是否密切关注此类方法。

papers.title: Codec Does Matter: Exploring the Semantic Shortcoming of Codec for Audio Language Model
papers.summary: Recent advancements in audio generation have been significantly propelled by the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). The existing research on audio LLM has primarily focused on enhancing the architecture and scale of audio language models, as well as leveraging larger datasets, and generally, acoustic codecs, such as EnCodec, are used for audio tokenization. However, these codecs were originally designed for audio compression, which may lead to suboptimal performance in the context of audio LLM. Our research aims to address the shortcomings of current audio LLM codecs, particularly their challenges in maintaining semantic integrity in generated audio. For instance, existing methods like VALL-E, which condition acoustic token generation on text transcriptions, often suffer from content inaccuracies and elevated word error rates (WER) due to semantic misinterpretations of acoustic tokens, resulting in word skipping and errors. To overcome these issues, we propose a straightforward yet effective approach called X-Codec. X-Codec incorporates semantic features from a pre-trained semantic encoder before the Residual Vector Quantization (RVQ) stage and introduces a semantic reconstruction loss after RVQ. By enhancing the semantic ability of the codec, X-Codec significantly reduces WER in speech synthesis tasks and extends these benefits to non-speech applications, including music and sound generation. Our experiments in text-to-speech, music continuation, and text-to-sound tasks demonstrate that integrating semantic information substantially improves the overall performance of language models in audio generation.
papers.justification: 提出X-Codec增强音频语言模型的语义完整性，显著降低语音合成WER并扩展至音乐生成，与生成式语音技术方向高度相关，是音频LLM编解码的重要改进，具有基础性和影响力。

chinese_summary.problem: 现有音频语言模型使用的声学编解码器（如EnCodec）原为音频压缩设计，在生成任务中语义完整性不足，导致语音合成中出现内容错误、丢词和高词错率（WER）等问题。
chinese_summary.method: 提出X-Codec，在残差向量量化（RVQ）之前融合预训练语义编码器的语义特征，并在RVQ后添加语义重建损失，以增强编解码器的语义保持能力。
chinese_summary.innovation: 揭示声学编解码器的语义缺陷对音频语言模型性能的关键限制；通过在量化前后引入语义特征的简单方案，显著降低语音合成WER，并首次将类似增强有效拓展至音乐和声音生成等非语音任务。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在文本到语音、音乐续写和文本到声音等任务上的实验表明，融入语义信息能大幅提升音频语言模型的整体生成性能。
chinese_summary.limitations: 未说明预训练语义编码器的具体选型及跨任务泛化性；是否适用于其他生成式框架（如扩散模型）尚需验证；实验细节（如WER具体降低幅度）和推理效率影响需阅读正文。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 该论文直接改进语音合成（text-to-speech）的关键组件，通过语义增强编解码器降低WER，与研究方向中的“speech synthesis”“text-to-speech”强匹配，并可辅助构建更可靠的生成式语音系统。

papers.title: Spark-TTS: An Efficient LLM-Based Text-to-Speech Model with Single-Stream Decoupled Speech Tokens
papers.summary: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have driven significant progress in zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis. However, existing foundation models rely on multi-stage processing or complex architectures for predicting multiple codebooks, limiting efficiency and integration flexibility. To overcome these challenges, we introduce Spark-TTS, a novel system powered by BiCodec, a single-stream speech codec that decomposes speech into two complementary token types: low-bitrate semantic tokens for linguistic content and fixed-length global tokens for speaker attributes. This disentangled representation, combined with the Qwen2.5 LLM and a chain-of-thought (CoT) generation approach, enables both coarse-grained control (e.g., gender, speaking style) and fine-grained adjustments (e.g., precise pitch values, speaking rate). To facilitate research in controllable TTS, we introduce VoxBox, a meticulously curated 100,000-hour dataset with comprehensive attribute annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Spark-TTS not only achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot voice cloning but also generates highly customizable voices that surpass the limitations of reference-based synthesis. Source code, pre-trained models, and audio samples are available at https://github.com/SparkAudio/Spark-TTS.
papers.justification: 提出基于LLM的高效TTS模型，通过解耦语义与声学token实现可控生成，零样本语音克隆达SOTA并构建大规模数据集，与生成式语音技术高度相关且具基础性影响力。

chinese_summary.problem: 现有基于大语言模型的零样本文本到语音合成依赖多阶段或复杂架构预测多个码本，导致效率和集成灵活性受限。
chinese_summary.method: 核心方法是提出 BiCodec 单流语音编解码器，将语音解耦为低比特率语义 Token（内容）和固定长度全局 Token（说话人属性），并基于 Qwen2.5 大语言模型结合链式思维（CoT）生成策略，支持粗细粒度控制。
chinese_summary.innovation: 提出 BiCodec 解耦语音表示，仅需单流网络即可同时建模内容与说话人信息，简化了架构；引入链式思维生成，实现性别、风格等粗粒度控制与基频、语速等细粒度调节；构建了 10 万小时带丰富属性标注的数据集 VoxBox，促进可控 TTS 研究。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要中提及大量实验表明 Spark-TTS 在零样本语音克隆上达到最优性能，并能生成超越参考语音合成限制的高度可定制语音。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未给出具体客观指标（如 MOS、CER）对比；链式思维生成的可解释性与鲁棒性需通过全文验证；单流编解码器在极低码率下的质量保真度需进一步确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 研究方向聚焦 TTS 与生成式语音合成，论文直接提出零样本语音克隆与可控生成方案，匹配关键词 text-to-speech、speech synthesis、neural vocoder 等，且涉及 LLM 与解耦表示，与研究方向高度相关。

papers.title: Guided Flows for Generative Modeling and Decision Making
papers.summary: Classifier-free guidance is a key component for enhancing the performance of conditional generative models across diverse tasks. While it has previously demonstrated remarkable improvements for the sample quality, it has only been exclusively employed for diffusion models. In this paper, we integrate classifier-free guidance into Flow Matching (FM) models, an alternative simulation-free approach that trains Continuous Normalizing Flows (CNFs) based on regressing vector fields. We explore the usage of \emph{Guided Flows} for a variety of downstream applications. We show that Guided Flows significantly improves the sample quality in conditional image generation and zero-shot text-to-speech synthesis, boasting state-of-the-art performance. Notably, we are the first to apply flow models for plan generation in the offline reinforcement learning setting, showcasing a 10x speedup in computation compared to diffusion models while maintaining comparable performance.
papers.justification: 首次将无分类器引导引入连续归一化流，在零样本文本到语音合成上取得最优性能，为生成式语音技术提供了新的基础方法。

chinese_summary.problem: 将原本仅用于扩散模型的分类器自由引导机制引入流匹配模型，以提升条件生成任务的样本质量。
chinese_summary.method: 在流匹配（Flow Matching）框架中集成分类器自由引导，通过调节引导尺度在条件向量场与无条件向量场之间插值，实现可控生成；将得到的Guided Flows应用于条件图像生成、零样本文本到语音合成以及离线强化学习中的行为规划。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次将分类器自由引导与流匹配相结合，打破了该技术仅限扩散模型的局面；在零样本文本到语音合成上取得最优性能，验证了引导流在音频生成中的有效性；首次将流模型用于离线强化学习规划，相比扩散模型实现了10倍速度提升。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要中提到Guided Flows在条件图像生成和零样本文本到语音合成中显著提升样本质量，达到最优性能；在离线RL规划中，相比扩散模型有10倍计算加速且性能相当，但未给出具体数据集和指标数字。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未说明引导强度调节的细节和可能带来的计算开销；零样本TTS的具体实现、评估数据和基线模型未披露；流匹配在长序列或高维语音生成上的稳定性需全文验证。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接研究流匹配（flow matching）在零样本文本到语音合成（TTS）中的应用，与研究方向中的“speech synthesis and TTS”、“flow matching speech”、“generative model audio”高度重合，提供了将引导机制引入语音生成的新思路。

papers.title: Spoken Question Answering and Speech Continuation Using Spectrogram-Powered LLM
papers.summary: We present Spectron, a novel approach to adapting pre-trained large language models (LLMs) to perform spoken question answering (QA) and speech continuation. By endowing the LLM with a pre-trained speech encoder, our model becomes able to take speech inputs and generate speech outputs. The entire system is trained end-to-end and operates directly on spectrograms, simplifying our architecture. Key to our approach is a training objective that jointly supervises speech recognition, text continuation, and speech synthesis using only paired speech-text pairs, enabling a `cross-modal' chain-of-thought within a single decoding pass. Our method surpasses existing spoken language models in speaker preservation and semantic coherence. Furthermore, the proposed model improves upon direct initialization in retaining the knowledge of the original LLM as demonstrated through spoken QA datasets. We release our audio samples (https://michelleramanovich.github.io/spectron/spectron) and spoken QA dataset (https://github.com/google-research-datasets/LLAMA1-Test-Set).
papers.justification: 将预训练LLM与语音编码器结合实现端到端语音问答与延续，对生成式语音技术有重要贡献，高度相关。

chinese_summary.problem: 如何扩展预训练大语言模型以直接处理口语问答和语音延续任务，实现端到端的语音输入和输出。
chinese_summary.method: 提出 Spectron，将预训练语音编码器赋予 LLM，使模型能接受语音输入并生成语音输出；整个系统直接在声谱图上端到端训练，训练目标联合监督语音识别、文本延续和语音合成，仅需语音-文本配对数据，在单次解码中实现跨模态思维链。
chinese_summary.innovation: 1) 首次在 LLM 中实现声谱图级别的语音输入和输出，无需显式文本中介；2) 联合训练语音识别、文本延续和语音合成，通过跨模态链式思考保持语义连贯；3) 在保留说话人身份与原始 LLM 知识上优于已有口语模型。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要表明在说话人保留和语义连贯性上超越现有模型，在口语 QA 数据集上展现出更好的知识保留，并公布了音频样本和评测数据集，但未提供具体指标数值。
chinese_summary.limitations: 未明确生成声谱图的具体方法（如是否使用神经声码器）、训练数据规模、跨领域泛化能力。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 研究方向包括语音合成与生成式语音技术，Spectron 的语音输出部分涉及端到端语音合成，且基于声谱图表示，与神经声码器、生成模型音频等子方向相关；但论文核心在于 LLM 的口语扩展而非生成模型本身的改进。

papers.title: Mega-TTS: Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech at Scale with Intrinsic Inductive Bias
papers.summary: Scaling text-to-speech to a large and wild dataset has been proven to be highly effective in achieving timbre and speech style generalization, particularly in zero-shot TTS. However, previous works usually encode speech into latent using audio codec and use autoregressive language models or diffusion models to generate it, which ignores the intrinsic nature of speech and may lead to inferior or uncontrollable results. We argue that speech can be decomposed into several attributes (e.g., content, timbre, prosody, and phase) and each of them should be modeled using a module with appropriate inductive biases. From this perspective, we carefully design a novel and large zero-shot TTS system called Mega-TTS, which is trained with large-scale wild data and models different attributes in different ways: 1) Instead of using latent encoded by audio codec as the intermediate feature, we still choose spectrogram as it separates the phase and other attributes very well. Phase can be appropriately constructed by the GAN-based vocoder and does not need to be modeled by the language model. 2) We model the timbre using global vectors since timbre is a global attribute that changes slowly over time. 3) We further use a VQGAN-based acoustic model to generate the spectrogram and a latent code language model to fit the distribution of prosody, since prosody changes quickly over time in a sentence, and language models can capture both local and long-range dependencies. We scale Mega-TTS to multi-domain datasets with 20K hours of speech and evaluate its performance on unseen speakers. Experimental results demonstrate that Mega-TTS surpasses state-of-the-art TTS systems on zero-shot TTS, speech editing, and cross-lingual TTS tasks, with superior naturalness, robustness, and speaker similarity due to the proper inductive bias of each module. Audio samples are available at https://mega-tts.github.io/demo-page.
papers.justification: 提出将语音属性分解建模的大规模零样本TTS系统，通过归纳偏置实现自然度与鲁棒性提升，是生成式语音合成领域的重要基础工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 大规模零样本TTS中，现有方法将语音编码为音频编解码隐变量并用自回归/扩散模型生成，忽略了语音的固有属性分解，导致生成结果自然度不佳或可控性差。
chinese_summary.method: 提出Mega-TTS，将语音分解为内容、音色、韵律和相位等属性，针对各属性设计异构模块：利用频谱图分离相位，由GAN声码器重构相位；使用全局向量建模缓慢变化的音色；采用VQGAN声学模型生成频谱图，并配合潜码语言模型捕获韵律的局部与长程依赖。系统在20000小时多领域野生数据上训练。
chinese_summary.innovation: 摒弃音频编解码器隐变量，保留频谱图作为中间特征，利用GAN单独处理相位信息；显式分解语音属性并赋予各模块恰当的归纳偏置（全局音色向量、韵律语言模型）；结合VQGAN与语言模型高效建模快变的韵律。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在零样本TTS、语音编辑和跨语言TTS任务上，Mega-TTS的自然度、鲁棒性和说话人相似度均超越SOTA系统，并提供在线音频样本。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未提及计算复杂度、推理效率及对极端音色/语言的支持；需阅读全文确认大规模训练的具体消融实验和局限性分析。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 研究方向涵盖TTS、神经声码器和生成式语音模型，本论文直接提出新型零样本TTS系统，采用VQGAN与语言模型联合生成，与生成式语音合成高度匹配。虽然未明确使用扩散模型，但其属性解耦与生成框架仍对研究方向有重要参考价值。

papers.title: MARBLE: Music Audio Representation Benchmark for Universal Evaluation
papers.summary: In the era of extensive intersection between art and Artificial Intelligence (AI), such as image generation and fiction co-creation, AI for music remains relatively nascent, particularly in music understanding. This is evident in the limited work on deep music representations, the scarcity of large-scale datasets, and the absence of a universal and community-driven benchmark. To address this issue, we introduce the Music Audio Representation Benchmark for universaL Evaluation, termed MARBLE. It aims to provide a benchmark for various Music Information Retrieval (MIR) tasks by defining a comprehensive taxonomy with four hierarchy levels, including acoustic, performance, score, and high-level description. We then establish a unified protocol based on 14 tasks on 8 public-available datasets, providing a fair and standard assessment of representations of all open-sourced pre-trained models developed on music recordings as baselines. Besides, MARBLE offers an easy-to-use, extendable, and reproducible suite for the community, with a clear statement on copyright issues on datasets. Results suggest recently proposed large-scale pre-trained musical language models perform the best in most tasks, with room for further improvement. The leaderboard and toolkit repository are published at https://marble-bm.shef.ac.uk to promote future music AI research.
papers.justification: 提出了首个全面的音乐音频表示基准MARBLE，定义多层级分类和统一评估协议，为音乐信息检索研究提供标准框架，与Music Information Retrieval and Representation方向高度相关且为基础性工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 当前音乐理解领域缺乏通用、社区驱动的基准来公平评估各种预训练模型在多种音乐信息检索（MIR）任务上的表示能力。
chinese_summary.method: 提出MARBLE基准，构建包含声学、演奏、乐谱、高层描述的四层级任务分类体系，基于8个公开数据集的14项MIR任务建立统一评估协议，对全部开源音乐预训练模型进行表示评估，并提供可扩展、可复现的标准化工具包。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次提出涵盖多层级音乐要素的全面任务分类法；建立统一协议和标准化流程，实现不同模型在相同条件下公平对比；提供开源、易于扩展的基准套件和公共排行榜，推动社区协同发展。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要中提及初步实验结果表明近期大规模预训练音乐语言模型在多数任务上表现最优，但仍有提升空间；已发布在线排行榜和工具仓库，可核验。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未详述具体任务定义、评估指标和参评模型的性能细节；需阅读全文以确认基准的覆盖范围、数据版权落实以及实际公平性。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接聚焦音乐信息检索和音频表示学习，所涉任务、预训练模型评估与我的研究方向‘音乐表示学习、音乐编码器、自监督音频表示’高度吻合，且基准对音乐理解与生成模型的研究具有现实参考价值。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Audio Teacher-Student Transformer for Both Clip-Level and Frame-Level Tasks
papers.summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a popular approach for learning audio representations. One goal of audio self-supervised pre-training is to transfer knowledge to downstream audio tasks, generally including clip-level and frame-level tasks. While frame-level tasks are important for fine-grained acoustic scene/event understanding, prior studies primarily evaluate on clip-level downstream tasks. In order to tackle both clip-level and frame-level tasks, this paper proposes Audio Teacher-Student Transformer (ATST), with a clip-level version (named ATST-Clip) and a frame-level version (named ATST-Frame), responsible for learning clip-level and frame-level representations, respectively. Both methods use a Transformer encoder and a teacher-student training scheme. We have carefully designed a view creation strategy for ATST-Clip and ATST-Frame. Specifically, ATST-Clip uses segment-wise data augmentations, and ATST-Frame integrates frame-wise data augmentations and masking. Experimental results show that our ATST-Frame model obtains state-of-the-art (SOTA) performances on most of the clip-level and frame-level downstream tasks. Especially, it outperforms other models by a large margin on the frame-level sound event detection task. In addition, the performance can be further improved by combining the two models through knowledge distillation.
categories: IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio Speech and Language Processing
papers.venue: IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio Speech and Language Processing
papers.justification: 提出ATST自监督模型，兼顾片段级和帧级音频表示，与音乐信息检索及自监督音频表示方向高度相关，工作扎实，成为该方向重要基线。

chinese_summary.problem: 现有音频自监督预训练主要关注片段级任务，忽视帧级任务，导致模型无法同时胜任两种粒度的下游应用。
chinese_summary.method: 提出音频师生变换器（ATST），包含ATST-Clip和ATST-Frame两个版本，分别学习片段级和帧级表示。两者均用Transformer编码器与师生训练模式，ATST-Clip采用段级数据增强，ATST-Frame采用帧级数据增强与掩码。最终可通过知识蒸馏合并两个模型。
chinese_summary.innovation: 精心设计了适配不同粒度的视图创建策略：片段级模型使用段级增强，帧级模型使用帧级增强与掩码；ATST-Frame在帧级声音事件检测任务上取得显著领先；提出通过知识蒸馏整合两类表示以进一步提升性能。
chinese_summary.evidence: 实验显示ATST-Frame在大多数片段级和帧级下游任务上取得最优性能，尤其在帧级声音事件检测上大幅超越现有模型，并且结合两个模型可进一步提升效果。
chinese_summary.limitations: 未涉及音乐特有任务，知识蒸馏的具体增益幅度未量化，训练计算开销未知，模型在长序列或实时场景的适用性待验证。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文提出了一种通用的自监督音频表示方法，理论上可迁移至音乐信息检索（如音乐标记、音乐事件检测等），与研究方向中的“self-supervised audio”关键词匹配，但摘要缺乏音乐任务验证，需人工复核实际适用性。

papers.title: AV-RIR: Audio-Visual Room Impulse Response Estimation
papers.summary: Accurate estimation of Room Impulse Response (RIR), which captures an environment's acoustic properties, is important for speech processing and AR/VR applications. We propose AV-RIR, a novel multi-modal multi-task learning approach to accurately estimate the RIR from a given reverberant speech signal and the visual cues of its corresponding environment. AV-RIR builds on a novel neural codec-based architecture that effectively captures environment geometry and materials properties and solves speech dereverberation as an auxiliary task by using multi-task learning. We also propose Geo-Mat features that augment material information into visual cues and CRIP that improves late reverberation components in the estimated RIR via image-to-RIR retrieval by 86%. Empirical results show that AV-RIR quantitatively outperforms previous audio-only and visual-only approaches by achieving 36% - 63% improvement across various acoustic metrics in RIR estimation. Additionally, it also achieves higher preference scores in human evaluation. As an auxiliary benefit, dereverbed speech from AV-RIR shows competitive performance with the state-of-the-art in various spoken language processing tasks and outperforms reverberation time error score in the real-world AVSpeech dataset. Qualitative examples of both synthesized reverberant speech and enhanced speech are available online11https://anton-jeran.github.io/AVRIR/.
papers.justification: 提出视听多模态 RIR 估计与语音去混响联合学习方法，引入 Geo-Mat 特征和 CRIP 检索改进混响尾部估计，与语音增强前端高度相关，性能显著超越纯音频方法，为该方向必读新基线

chinese_summary.problem: 论文解决从混响语音和视觉线索中准确估计房间脉冲响应（RIR）的问题，以捕获环境声学特性。
chinese_summary.method: 提出AV-RIR，一种多模态多任务学习方法。它利用神经编解码器架构融合混响语音和视觉信息，通过多任务学习将语音去混响作为辅助任务；设计Geo-Mat特征为视觉线索增强材料属性，并采用CRIP技术通过图像到RIR检索改善晚期混响成分。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次结合音频和视觉信息以多任务学习估计RIR；引入Geo-Mat特征将环境材料属性融入视觉线索；提出CRIP策略，通过图像检索大幅提升晚期混响估计精度。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要中给出定量结果：AV-RIR在RIR估计的多种声学指标上比纯音频和纯视觉方法提升36%-63%，人类评估偏好分数更高；辅助任务去混响语音在口语处理任务中竞争力强，并在真实数据集AVSpeech上优于混响时间误差指标。
chinese_summary.limitations: 依赖视觉输入，在视觉传感器不可用的场景受限；RIR估计对新环境的泛化能力未经充分验证；去混响作为辅助任务，其对纯音频前端处理的直接收益需阅读全文确认；实验基于特定数据集，实际部署性能未知。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文的辅助任务涉及语音去混响，与研究方向中的“dereverberation”匹配；估计的RIR可作为音频前端参数，间接关联“speech frontend”。但核心贡献是RIR估计且依赖视觉模态，与纯音频语音增强和前端处理的直接相关性较弱，需人工复核是否适合作为参考。

papers.title: GTCRN: A Speech Enhancement Model Requiring Ultralow Computational Resources
papers.summary: While modern deep learning-based models have significantly outperformed traditional methods in the area of speech enhancement, they often necessitate a lot of parameters and extensive computational power, making them impractical to be deployed on edge devices in real-world applications. In this paper, we introduce Grouped Temporal Convolutional Recurrent Network (GTCRN), which incorporates grouped strategies to efficiently simplify a competitive model, DPCRN. Additionally, it leverages subband feature extraction modules and temporal recurrent attention modules to enhance its performance. Remarkably, the resulting model demands ultralow computational resources, featuring only 23.7 K parameters and 39.6 MMACs per second. Experimental results show that our proposed model not only surpasses RNNoise, a typical lightweight model with similar computational burden, but also achieves competitive performance when compared to recent baseline models with significantly higher computational resources requirements.
categories: IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing
papers.venue: IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing
papers.topic_name: Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction
papers.justification: 提出超低计算资源语音增强模型GTCRN，仅23.7K参数且性能超越RNNoise，是轻量级增强的基础性工作，与语音增强方向高度相关。

chinese_summary.problem: 现有深度学习语音增强模型参数多、计算量大，难以部署在资源受限的边缘设备上。
chinese_summary.method: 提出分组时域卷积循环网络（GTCRN），通过分组策略简化DPCRN模型，并结合子带特征提取模块与时域循环注意力模块提升性能，实现超低计算资源需求。
chinese_summary.innovation: 采用分组策略精简模型结构；引入子带特征提取模块处理不同频带信息；设计时域循环注意力模块增强时序建模能力。
chinese_summary.evidence: 模型仅23.7K参数，每秒39.6M乘累加运算；在同等计算量下性能超越RNNoise，且与计算量显著更大的基线模型相比具有竞争力。
chinese_summary.limitations: 论文仅涉及语音增强任务，未验证在语音分离或目标说话人提取上的适用性；实际部署的实时性和泛化性仍需阅读全文确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文专注于语音增强，虽与语音分离在噪声抑制角度有浅层关联，但其核心任务、评价指标和优化目标与研究方向中的语音分离及目标说话人提取不直接匹配，技术组件（如分组时域卷积）有潜在借鉴价值，但整体相关性弱。

papers.title: LLaSE-G1: Incentivizing Generalization Capability for LLaMA-based Speech Enhancement
papers.summary: Recent advancements in language models (LMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in semantic understanding and contextual modeling, which have flourished in generative speech enhancement (SE). However, many LM-based SE approaches primarily focus on semantic information, often neglecting the critical role of acoustic information, which leads to acoustic inconsistency after enhancement and limited generalization across diverse SE tasks. In this paper, we introduce LLaSE-G1, a LLaMA-based language model that incentivizes generalization capabilities for speech enhancement. LLaSE-G1 offers the following key contributions: First, to mitigate acoustic inconsistency, LLaSE-G1 employs continuous representations from WavLM as input and predicts speech tokens from X-Codec2, maximizing acoustic preservation. Second, to promote generalization capability, LLaSE-G1 introduces dual-channel inputs and outputs, unifying multiple SE tasks without requiring task-specific IDs. Third, LLaSE-G1 outperforms prior task-specific discriminative and generative SE models, demonstrating scaling effects at test time and emerging capabilities for unseen SE tasks. Additionally, we release our code and models to support further research in this area.
categories: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
papers.venue: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
papers.justification: 与生成式语音增强高度相关，提出基于LLaMA的统一多任务增强框架，贡献明确且效果突出，但作为近期工作，经典性和影响力尚需时间沉淀。

chinese_summary.problem: 现有基于语言模型的语音增强方法侧重语义而忽视声学信息，导致增强后语音声学不一致，且在不同语音增强任务上泛化能力有限。
chinese_summary.method: 基于LLaMA构建生成式语音增强模型，使用WavLM提取的连续声学表示作为输入，预测X-Codec2的离散语音token以保持声学一致性；采用双通道输入输出统一多种语音增强任务，避免依赖任务特定标识。
chinese_summary.innovation: 引入WavLM连续表示和X-Codec2语音token，显式保留声学细节，缓解增强后的失真；通过双通道设计将降噪、去混响等多种任务统一到同一框架，无需任务ID即可激励泛化；模型展现测试时缩放效应和对未见语音增强任务的新兴能力，性能超越任务特化的判别式和生成式模型。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要声明LLaSE-G1优于先前的任务特化模型，并观察到缩放效应和新兴能力，但未提供具体实验指标或数据集。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未报告具体性能数值、对比基线细节、未见任务类型和测试时缩放的具体表现，需阅读全文确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接聚焦生成式语音增强，采用的LLaMA与离散token建模属于生成式语音技术范畴；统一多任务的方案可涵盖语音修复、带宽扩展等子任务，与我的研究方向高度匹配。

papers.title: SemBridge: Semantic Token Anchoring for Continuous-Latent Autoregressive Speech Generation
papers.summary: Continuous-latent autoregressive speech generation has emerged as a promising alternative to discrete-token modeling by avoiding quantization loss and preserving richer acoustic information. However, continuous acoustic targets do not ex- pose linguistic structure as explicit token-level prediction tar- gets. Consequently, the autoregressive language model (LM) must acquire linguistic structure indirectly through acous- tic prediction, which can compromise the content fidelity of generated speech. We propose SemBridge, a training-only semantic-token anchoring framework for continuous-latent autoregressive speech generation. SemBridge uses discrete se- mantic tokens to directly supervise autoregressive LM states and employs a Semantic-Aligned Acoustic VAE to organize the continuous target space under the same semantic refer- ence. The semantic supervision is used only during train- ing, while inference remains entirely continuous. We evalu- ate SemBridge on zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) and score- conditioned singing voice synthesis (SVS). Across multi- ple benchmarks, SemBridge improves content accuracy, as measured by word and character error rates (WER/CER), while maintaining competitive speaker similarity and percep- tual quality. Experimental results demonstrate that explicit semantic-token supervision for autoregressive state learning is an effective and general direction for continuous speech generation. Speech samples are available.1 The model code and checkpoints will be available at https://github.com/ASLP- lab/SemBridge
papers.justification: 提出SemBridge框架，通过在训练时用离散语义token锚定自回归语言模型状态，提升连续潜在语音生成的内容保真度，属于生成式语音技术的扎实工作。

chinese_summary.problem: 连续潜在自回归语音生成中，自回归语言模型需间接从声学预测中学习语言结构，导致生成内容的语言内容保真度不足。
chinese_summary.method: 提出SemBridge框架，在训练阶段利用离散语义标记直接监督自回归语言模型的隐状态，并设计语义对齐的声学VAE在统一的语义参照下组织连续目标空间；推理阶段完全连续，不使用语义标记。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次在连续潜在自回归语音生成中引入离散语义标记作为显式训练监督，弥补语言结构学习不足；提出语义对齐的声学VAE，确保连续声学潜在空间与语义结构一致；实现了仅训练阶段使用语义先验、推理保持连续的高保真生成范式。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在零样本文本到语音（TTS）和分数条件的歌唱声音合成（SVS）任务上评估，多个基准上词错误率和字错误率显著降低，同时说话人相似度和感知质量保持竞争力。
chinese_summary.limitations: 语义标记的具体来源与对齐方式未知；训练中语义监督的权重与时序策略未明确；未提及流式场景或长序列生成中的稳定性。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 直接匹配研究方向中的语音合成（TTS）和生成式语音自回归建模，其核心关于自回归连续潜在生成与内容保真度，属于生成语音技术的关键进展。

papers.title: Cloud-Boosted Low-Compute Multi-Channel Speech Enhancement
papers.summary: Low-latency, low-compute speech enhancement is essential for wearable devices with real-time communication requirements, but strict computational constraints significantly limit on-device performance. Knowledge Boosting has been proposed as an effective approach to improve edge model performance by leveraging a more capable server-side model, but performance gains for speech enhancement have been limited. We propose a collaborative framework incorporating three techniques: (1) delayed server output as additional input, (2) layerwise feature boosting that transfers intermediate server representations to guide edge inference, and (3) collaborative multichannel Wiener filtering, which fuses weighted covariance matrices estimated from both server and edge models for improved beamforming. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed collaborative framework significantly outperforms the edge-only baseline with minimal additional computational overhead.
papers.justification: 论文提出云端增强的多通道语音增强框架，结合特征增强与协作维纳滤波，与语音增强和波束形成方向高度相关，方法扎实新颖，适合实时可穿戴设备。

chinese_summary.problem: 在穿戴设备等低算力、低延迟场景下，如何在严格计算约束下实现高性能多通道语音增强。
chinese_summary.method: 提出云-端协同增强框架：将服务器端模型的延迟输出作为附加输入，通过逐层特征增强传递服务器中间表示来引导边缘推理，并融合双方估计的加权协方差矩阵进行协作多通道维纳滤波。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次将知识增强机制扩展到多通道语音增强的逐层特征层面；提出协作多通道维纳滤波，利用服务器和边缘模型共同估计的协方差矩阵改善波束成形；在几乎不增加边缘计算开销的前提下显著提升增强性能。
chinese_summary.evidence: 实验显示所提框架相比纯边缘基线有显著性能提升，且额外计算开销极小。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未给出具体评价指标、数据集和对比方法，也未说明服务器端延迟对实时性的影响程度，需要阅读全文确认。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 直接针对多通道语音增强，涉及噪声抑制和波束成形，与研究方向中的‘多通道语音增强’、‘噪声抑制’、‘去混响’高度匹配，且方法包括前端处理流程，符合‘音频前端’范畴。

papers.title: Separate And Diffuse: Using a Pretrained Diffusion Model for Improving Source Separation
papers.summary: The problem of speech separation, also known as the cocktail party problem, refers to the task of isolating a single speech signal from a mixture of speech signals. Previous work on source separation derived an upper bound for the source separation task in the domain of human speech. This bound is derived for deterministic models. Recent advancements in generative models challenge this bound. We show how the upper bound can be generalized to the case of random generative models. Applying a diffusion model Vocoder that was pretrained to model single-speaker voices on the output of a deterministic separation model leads to state-of-the-art separation results. It is shown that this requires one to combine the output of the separation model with that of the diffusion model. In our method, a linear combination is performed, in the frequency domain, using weights that are inferred by a learned model. We show state-of-the-art results on 2, 3, 5, 10, and 20 speakers on multiple benchmarks. In particular, for two speakers, our method is able to surpass what was previously considered the upper performance bound.
papers.topic_name: Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction
papers.justification: 论文将预训练扩散声码器用于改进确定性语音分离，通过线性组合在频域融合，在2到20说话人场景达到最优，颠覆传统上界，与语音分离和生成式语音方向高度相关，方法新颖，但引用数尚不高。

chinese_summary.problem: 在确定性模型上界限制下，进一步提升语音分离性能，突破传统源分离任务在人类语音域中的性能上界。
chinese_summary.method: 先利用确定性分离模型生成初步估计，再通过预训练的单说话人扩散模型声码器增强该输出，最后在频域由学习到的模型推得权重，对两者进行线性组合，获得最终分离信号。
chinese_summary.innovation: 将源分离性能上界的理论分析从确定性模型推广到随机生成模型；提出分离模型与扩散模型输出在频域的加权线性组合策略，权重通过可学习方式确定；结合预训练扩散模型作为后处理模块，首次在2说话人场景下超越此前公认的性能上界。
chinese_summary.evidence: 摘要声称在2、3、5、10、20个说话人的多个基准测试上取得最先进结果，并特别指出在两说话人场景下超越了之前认为的性能上界，但未提供具体数据集、评价指标或数值结果。
chinese_summary.limitations: 实验细节（如数据集、评价指标）未在摘要中给出；扩散模型与分离模型的组合方式可能对预训练模型有强依赖；未提及该方法在混响、噪声等复杂环境下的表现；需确认是否仅适用于已知说话人数目的场景。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接针对语音分离任务，解决鸡尾酒会问题，与研究方向中的语音分离、盲源分离、掩蔽方法等关键词高度契合，提出的扩散增强方法可为时间域或时频域分离框架提供新的后处理思路。

papers.title: Generative Speech Foundation Model Pretraining for High-Quality Speech Extraction and Restoration
papers.summary: This paper proposes a generative pretraining foundation model for high-quality speech restoration tasks. By directly operating on complex-valued short-time Fourier transform coefficients, our model does not rely on any vocoders for time-domain signal reconstruction. As a result, our model simplifies the synthesis process and removes the quality upper-bound introduced by any mel-spectrogram vocoder compared to prior work SpeechFlow. The proposed method is evaluated on multiple speech restoration tasks, including speech denoising, bandwidth extension, codec artifact removal, and target speaker extraction. In all scenarios, finetuning our pretrained model results in superior performance over strong baselines. Notably, in the target speaker extraction task, our model outperforms existing systems, including those leveraging SSL-pretrained encoders like WavLM. The code and the pretrained checkpoints are publicly available in the NVIDIA NeMo framework.
categories: IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing
papers.venue: IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing
papers.topic_name: Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction
papers.justification: 提出在复数STFT域进行生成式预训练的基础模型，无需声码器即实现语音去噪、扩展和目标说话人提取等任务，性能超越WavLM等基线，与语音增强、分离与生成式方向高度相关。

chinese_summary.problem: 论文要解决高质量语音提取与恢复任务，包括语音去噪、带宽扩展、编解码伪影去除和目标说话人提取，旨在通过生成式预训练基础模型提升合成质量。
chinese_summary.method: 提出一种生成式预训练基础模型，直接在复数短时傅里叶变换系数上操作，无需声码器即可重构时域信号；模型在通用语音数据上预训练后，针对具体任务微调，简化合成流程并消除mel谱声码器带来的质量上限。
chinese_summary.innovation: 与先前方法SpeechFlow相比，本模型直接处理复数STFT系数，彻底摆脱了声码器依赖，从而避免声码器引入的重建质量瓶颈；采用生成式基础模型预训练范式，在多任务上微调均取得最优性能；在目标说话人提取任务中，性能超越基于WavLM等自监督预训练编码器的现有系统。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在多个语音恢复任务上微调后性能超过强基线；目标说话人提取任务中明确优于现有系统（包括使用WavLM的模型）；代码与预训练模型已在NVIDIA NeMo框架公开。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未提及模型规模、计算效率、预训练数据量及域匹配细节；未说明对复杂声学场景（如低信噪比或多说话人重叠）的鲁棒性；对提取任务仅给出相对提升，缺乏绝对指标。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接将目标说话人提取作为核心评测任务，并声称性能最优，与研究方向中的target speaker extraction和speaker extraction高度吻合；其基于频谱域生成式建模的思路也为语音分离研究提供了新视角。

papers.title: Multi-Channel Target Speaker Extraction with Refinement: The WavLab Submission to the Second Clarity Enhancement Challenge
papers.summary: This paper describes our submission to the Second Clarity Enhancement Challenge (CEC2), which consists of target speech enhancement for hearing-aid (HA) devices in noisy-reverberant environments with multiple interferers such as music and competing speakers. Our approach builds upon the powerful iterative neural/beamforming enhancement (iNeuBe) framework introduced in our recent work, and this paper extends it for target speaker extraction. We therefore name the proposed approach as iNeuBe-X, where the X stands for extraction. To address the challenges encountered in the CEC2 setting, we introduce four major novelties: (1) we extend the state-of-the-art TF-GridNet model, originally designed for monaural speaker separation, for multi-channel, causal speech enhancement, and large improvements are observed by replacing the TCNDenseNet used in iNeuBe with this new architecture; (2) we leverage a recent dual window size approach with future-frame prediction to ensure that iNueBe-X satisfies the 5 ms constraint on algorithmic latency required by CEC2; (3) we introduce a novel speaker-conditioning branch for TF-GridNet to achieve target speaker extraction; (4) we propose a fine-tuning step, where we compute an additional loss with respect to the target speaker signal compensated with the listener audiogram. Without using external data, on the official development set our best model reaches a hearing-aid speech perception index (HASPI) score of 0.942 and a scale-invariant signal-to-distortion ratio improvement (SI-SDRi) of 18.8 dB. These results are promising given the fact that the CEC2 data is extremely challenging (e.g., on the development set the mixture SI-SDR is -12.3 dB). A demo of our submitted system is available at WAVLab CEC2 demo.
papers.topic_name: Speech Separation and Target Speaker Extraction
papers.justification: 该论文提出iNeuBe-X，将TF-GridNet扩展至多通道因果目标说话人提取，在Clarity Challenge中表现突出，与目标说话人提取方向高度相关，方法新颖扎实，但引用数尚低（21），尚未成为经典基线，给予8分。

chinese_summary.problem: 针对助听器场景下的多通道目标说话人提取任务，需在强混响、多噪声干扰（音乐、竞争说话人）条件下工作，并严格满足5ms算法延迟要求。
chinese_summary.method: 基于iNeuBe框架扩展的iNeuBe-X方法，核心将单通道TF-GridNet改造为多通道因果语音增强网络，替代原有TCNDenseNet；采用双窗口大小结合未来帧预测技术满足低延迟约束；新增说话人条件分支使TF-GridNet具备目标说话人提取能力，并通过以听者听力图补偿的目标信号为指导的微调步骤优化最终性能。
chinese_summary.innovation: 首次将TF-GridNet从单通道说话人分离扩展至多通道、因果、低延迟的语音增强，并引入说话人条件分支实现目标提取，不同于常规条件方法；创新地采用双窗口与未来帧预测实现5ms算法延迟，满足助听器实时性需求；微调阶段利用听者听力图补偿损失函数，使系统输出适配听损用户的感知特性。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在官方开发集上，最佳模型达到HASPI 0.942、SI-SDRi 18.8 dB，而混合物SI-SDR低至-12.3 dB，性能提升显著；提供在线demo可核验效果。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未详述多通道融合机制及说话人条件的具体形式（如注册语音的使用）；仅在CEC2数据集上验证，通用性未知；微调步骤依赖个性化听力图数据，实际部署需额外采集。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接解决目标说话人提取（target speaker extraction），方法涉及时域双路径网络（TF-GridNet）、掩蔽模型、因果实时推理，与研究方向“目标说话人提取”“时域分离网络”“掩蔽模型”及鸡尾酒会问题高度吻合；低延迟多通道提取对实际应用场景有参考价值。

papers.title: CuteTTS: Efficient and High-Quality Speech Synthesis via Autoregressive Modeling of Continuous Latents
papers.summary: Zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) now supports interactive assistants, personalized media, and accessibility tools. All TTS systems require faithful linguistic rendering, consistent speaker identity, and low-latency response. Yet compact streaming systems must preserve sufficient acoustic detail in a predictable low-rate latent sequence, while iterative diffusion sampling and classifier-free guidance multiply inference cost at every autoregressive step. To strike a balance between high-fidelity synthesis and low-latency inference, we present CuteTTS, a compact continuous-autoregressive TTS system. It combines semantically aligned causal VAE latents with patch-level autoregression, explicit speaker conditioning, and a bidirectional flow-matching head. We further introduce guidance-step distillation, which absorbs classifier-free guidance and multiple solver steps into a single interval-conditioned student. Evaluations on LibriSpeech and Seed-TTS-Eval demonstrate competitive intelligibility and speaker similarity in zero-shot voice cloning, while distillation lowers first-audio latency by 23.3% and real-time factor by 40.8% relative to the base model with comparable objective and subjective quality. These results provide a practical path toward continuous-autoregressive TTS that reconciles high-fidelity generation with the latency demands of real-time interaction.
papers.justification: 该论文提出CuteTTS，一种融合连续自回归建模与流匹配的高效零样本文本-语音合成方法，通过引导步蒸馏显著降低延迟，与生成式语音技术方向高度相关，质量扎实，值得关注。

chinese_summary.problem: 零样本文本到语音（TTS）需要在低延迟要求下同时保持高保真合成和说话人身份一致性。现有系统在连续自回归建模中难以平衡细节保留与推理速度，特别是迭代扩散采样和分类器无引导在每个自回归步骤都会增加推理成本。
chinese_summary.method: 提出CuteTTS，一种紧凑的连续自回归TTS系统。它结合语义对齐的因果VAE潜变量表示与补丁级自回归，并引入显式说话人条件控制说话人身份。生成头采用双向流匹配模型，实现高质量合成。为了加速推理，提出引导步骤蒸馏，将多个扩散采样步骤和分类器无引导融合到单一间隔条件学生模型中。
chinese_summary.innovation: 1) 将连续潜变量自回归建模与补丁级序列建模相结合，实现高效的语音合成；2) 在自回归框架中集成流匹配生成头，替代传统的扩散模型，平衡质量与速度；3) 提出引导步骤蒸馏技术，将分类器无引导和多步求解器蒸馏为一个单步学生，显著降低推理延迟。
chinese_summary.evidence: 在LibriSpeech和Seed-TTS-Eval上评估，零样本语音克隆的可懂度和说话人相似度具有竞争力；蒸馏后首次音频延迟降低23.3%，实时因子降低40.8%，且客观和主观质量与基模型相当。
chinese_summary.limitations: 摘要未提供蒸馏后质量是否完全无损的详细对比数据；未提及系统在超低延迟或流式场景下的具体性能极限；未说明说话人条件的具体实现方式（如说话人嵌入或声学特征）。
chinese_summary.why_relevant: 论文直接匹配研究方向中的“语音合成与TTS”以及“流匹配在语音中的应用”，属于生成式语音技术核心范畴。它提出了基于连续自回归和流匹配的高效TTS系统，解决了生成质量与推理速度的权衡问题，对本方向的生成式语音建模和实时应用具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: ReLMCodec: Designing Predictable Speech Tokens from Pre-Quantization Phoneme Structure
papers.summary: Neural speech codecs face a fundamental tension in the language-model era: tokens that support high-fidelity reconstruction are not necessarily easy for autoregressive models to predict. Our controlled analysis of diverse codec and self-supervised speech representations shows that clearer phoneme structure before discrete code assignment is consistently associated with easier autoregressive token prediction. Yet phoneme structure alone is insufficient for high-fidelity reconstruction, which also requires reconstruction-relevant acoustic detail. Guided by this observation, we introduce ReLMCodec, a low-bitrate single-codebook speech codec built upon a preserve--control--refine principle: it preserves the linguistic organization of frozen self-supervised learning (SSL) features at the quantizer input, controls reconstruction-driven drift through Pre-quantization Anchor-Preserving Adaptation (PAPA), and refines the quantized latent space with a training-only WavLM-Large L24 teacher to reduce phoneme-level token fragmentation. Together, these components allow acoustic detail to support waveform reconstruction while keeping the resulting token sequence predictable for autoregressive models. At 650 and 800 bps, ReLMCodec moves the empirical single-stream predictability--reconstruction frontier in our evaluations, with gains that carry over to downstream text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis in both intelligibility and speaker similarity.
papers.justification: 该文提出 ReLMCodec，一种旨在生成可预测语音标记的低比特率编解码器，通过融合音素结构与声学细节，改善自回归模型预测并应用于 TTS 合成，与生成式语音技术方向高度契合，方法新颖且实验可靠。

chinese_summary.problem: 神经语音编解码器在语言模型时代面临重建质量与标记可预测性之间的权衡：高保真重建的标记序列往往难以被自回归模型准确预测。
